meanings_summary.en: Chinese idiom; four-character set phrase; proverb derived from classical literature
meanings_summary.es: modismo chino; frase hecha clásica; proverbio de cuatro caracteres con origen histórico

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Words (语) that have become firmly established (成) through centuries of literary wisdom constitute a timeless Chinese idiom (成语).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Palabras (语) que han quedado consolidadas y logradas (成) tras siglos de historia forman un modismo clásico (成语).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Chinese chéngyǔ (成语) typically distill multi-page classical historical narratives (典故) from texts like the Shiji or Zhuangzi into strict 4-character phonetic balanced tetrasyllables, serving as cultural shorthand across centuries.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone 'chéng' (35) followed by dipping 3rd tone 'yǔ' (214). Keep the rising pitch steady before allowing the vocal tone to dip smoothly into the chest register.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 成语 designates a classical, fixed 4-character phrase anchored in historical literature, distinct from vernacular proverbs or slang.

contrasts.analysis: 成语 are classical, refined idioms almost always 4 characters long with literary allusions, whereas 俗语 are colloquial folk sayings and colloquialisms originating from common folk speech.
成语 function syntactically as lexical items (nouns, verbs, adjectives) inside sentences, while 谚语 are complete autonomous moral proverbs or agrarian aphorisms (e.g., '一分耕耘，一分收获').
成语 carry direct metaphorical significance derived from historical records, while 歇后语 are two-part allegorical puns where the first clause sets up a riddle and the second supplies the witty punchline.

Has speech radical 讠 on the left

senses.definition_en: a traditional Chinese idiomatic expression, typically four characters in length, rooted in classical history, literature, or folklore
senses.definition_es: locución o modismo tradicional chino, casi siempre de cuatro caracteres, arraigado en la literatura clásica o fábulas históricas

example_sentences.hanzi: 学习汉语成语不仅能丰富表达，更能让我们深入了解古代中国的历史典故与处世哲学。
example_sentences.pinyin: Xuéxí Hànyǔ chéngyǔ bùjǐn néng fēngfù biǎodá, gèng néng ràng wǒmen shēnrù liǎojiě gǔdài Zhōngguó de lìshǐ diǎngù yǔ chǔshì zhéxué.
example_sentences.en: Studying Chinese idioms not only enriches our expression, but also allows us to deeply understand ancient Chinese historical allusions and life philosophies.
example_sentences.es: Estudiar modismos chinos no solo enriquece nuestra expresión, sino que nos permite comprender profundamente las fábulas históricas y la filosofía de vida de la China antigua.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在学术论文或正式演讲中，恰如其分地引用成语往往能使论述更加凝练精辟、富有说服力。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài xuéshù lùnwén huò zhèngshì yǎnjiǎng zhōng, qiàrúqífèn de yǐnyòng chéngyǔ wǎngwǎng néng shǐ lùnshù gèngjiā níngliàn jīngpì, fùyǒu shuōfúlì.
example_sentences.en: In academic essays or formal speeches, appropriately citing idioms often makes arguments more concise, incisive, and persuasive.
example_sentences.es: En ensayos académicos o discursos formales, citar modismos con precisión y mesura hace que la argumentación sea más concisa, elocuente y convincente.

collocations.en: idiom story; fable behind an idiom

idioms.meaning_en: two classical idiom stories
speak with literary grace; articulate thoughts brilliantly
speak insincerely; words not coming from the heart
speak with sincere, earnest words and weighty advice

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Originally represented a ritual axe sealing an official covenant upon achieving victory or establishing order.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A victorious spear (戈) thrusts downward to plant the boundary marker of accomplishment (成).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una lanza triunfal (戈) se alza firme sellando con honor el pacto del éxito alcanzado (成).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: speech radical 讠 combined with personal pronoun 吾, literally 'words spoken from my own voice'.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Words (讠) spoken directly from the five (五) senses of my true mouth (口) form genuine spoken language (语).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Palabras (讠) brotadas con sinceridad de mi propia voz (吾) para dar vida al lenguaje humano (语).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 汉语中的成语是凝固的华夏历史。每一个四字成语的背后，往往深藏着一段跌宕起伏的历史风云或引人深省的寓言故事。细细品读成语，我们仿佛在与古人进行跨越千年的心灵对话，感悟生命的大智慧。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Hànyǔ zhōng de chéngyǔ shì nínggù de Huáxià lìshǐ. Měi yí gè sì zì chéngyǔ de bèihòu, wǎngwǎng shēncáng zhe yí duàn diēdàng-qǐfú de lìshǐ fēngyún huò yǐnrén shēnxǐng de yùyán gùshì. Xìxì pǐndú chéngyǔ, wǒmen fǎngfú zài yǔ gǔrén jìnxíng kuàyuè qiānnián de xīnlíng duìhuà, gǎnwù shēngmìng de dà zhìhuì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Idioms in Chinese are frozen facets of Cathayan history. Behind each four-character idiom often lies a tumultuous historical drama or a thought-provoking allegory. Delicately savoring idioms feels like engaging in a spiritual dialogue across millennia with ancient sages, intuiting profound wisdom of life.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los modismos del idioma chino son historia viva petrificada en cuatro caracteres. Tras cada uno se oculta un relato fascinante o una fábula moral. Leerlos con calma es conversar a través de los siglos con sabios remotos, captando lecciones indelebles sobre la condición humana.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在当代跨文化交流中，成语既是汉语学习者的理解难点，也是打开中华传统文化宝库的金钥匙。准确运用成语不仅能够使跨文化沟通更加生动典雅，更能展现出深厚的人文积淀与纯正的语言审美素养。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài dāngdài kuà-wénhuà jiāoliú zhōng, chéngyǔ jì shì Hànyǔ xuéxízhě de lǐjiě nándiǎn, yěshì dǎkāi Zhōnghuá chuántǒng wénhuà bǎokù de jīn yàoshi. Zhǔnquè yùnyòng chéngyǔ bùjǐn nénggòu shǐ kuà-wénhuà gōutōng gèngjiā shēngdòng diǎnyǎ, gèng néng zhǎnxiàn chū shēnhòu de rénwén jīdiàn yǔ chúnzhèng de yǔyán shěnměi sùyǎng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In contemporary cross-cultural communication, idioms represent both a comprehension hurdle for learners and a golden key unlocking China's cultural treasury. Accurately deploying idioms renders intercultural exchange vivid and elegant, while manifesting cultural depth and refined linguistic aesthetics.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la comunicación intercultural actual, los modismos suponen tanto un reto como una llave maestra al legado de la civilización china. Su empleo diestro y certero infunde elegancia y viveza al diálogo, revelando una genuina solvencia humanística y una alta sensibilidad lingüística.

meanings_summary.en: measure word for pieces of news, stories, regulations, or advertisements; standard; rule
meanings_summary.es: clasificador para noticias, fábulas, artículos o reglamentos; norma; regla

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A legal carver incises rules and measures onto valuable tablets with a sharp knife (刂), producing each distinct measured article or story (则).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Con un cuchillo afilado (刂) se graba una valiosa norma (贝), dando origen a una regla o a una pieza escrita singular (则).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient legalism and epigraphy, decrees were carved onto valuable bronze vessels with bronze knives. Thus 'zé' evolved from 'inscribed legal statutes' into a counting measure for discrete written clauses, journalistic dispatches, and classical stories.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High-rising 2nd tone 'zé' (35). The pitch glides steadily upward from mid register (3) to upper register (5).

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 则 is an elegant, formal measure word dedicated to counting discrete textual, regulatory, or journalistic units.

contrasts.analysis: 则 is used strictly for written textual narratives, fables, announcements, and news dispatches (e.g. 一则消息), whereas 条 is far broader, classifying long slender physical items (绳子, 鱼) as well as legal clauses (一条规定).
则 classifies short standalone announcements, notices, or micro-stories within a larger collection, whereas 篇 classifies complete, extensive standalone essays, articles, or chapters (一篇论文, 一篇文章).
则 confers a formal, literary, or journalistic register appropriate for published entries, whereas 个 is the generic colloquial classifier (一个故事).

senses.definition_en: used as a counting unit for distinct textual items such as stories, fables, news reports, announcements, or written rules
senses.definition_es: clasificador para contar piezas textuales autónomas como noticias, fábulas, artículos breves o anuncios

senses.definition_en: conjunction indicating contrast or logical consequence (equivalent to 'then', 'on the other hand', or 'in contrast')
senses.definition_es: conjunción literaria que expresa contraste o consecuencia lógica (por su parte, en cambio, entonces)
senses.example_phrase: 穷则变，变则通 (in extremity there is change)

example_sentences.hanzi: 今天的早报刊登了一则关于野生大象迁徙的新闻，引起了许多环保爱好者的热烈讨论。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jīntiān de zǎobào kāndēng le yì zé guānyú yěshēng dàxiàng qiānxǐ de xīnwén, yǐnqǐ le xǔduō huánbǎo àihàozhě de rèliè tǎolùn.
example_sentences.en: Today's morning paper published a news item regarding wild elephant migration, sparking lively discussion among environmentalists.
example_sentences.es: El periódico matutino publicó hoy una noticia sobre la migración de elefantes salvajes, suscitando un animado debate entre los ecologistas.

example_sentences.hanzi: 这两则流传千古的寓言故事短小精悍，却以生动的比喻阐明了不可片面看问题的深刻哲理。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhè liǎng zé liúchuán qiāngǔ de yùyán gùshì duǎnxiǎo jīnghàn, què yǐ shēngdòng de bǐyù chǎnmíng le bùkě piànmiàn kàn wèntí de shēnkè zhélǐ.
example_sentences.en: These two time-honored fables are concise yet punchy, using vivid metaphors to elucidate profound philosophical truths against viewing issues one-sidedly.
example_sentences.es: Estas dos fábulas transmitidas por generaciones son breves y certeras, y valiéndose de elocuentes metáforas aclaran la honda lección de no juzgar las cosas de forma parcial.

collocations.en: an item of news; a news story

idioms.meaning_en: lead by personal example; serve as a model
correct errors if you have committed them
success makes a hero; might is right
adhere to clear, unambiguous principles

character_decomposition.meaning_en: rule; standard; measure word for items
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Originally depicted a sharp knife (刂) incising legal codes and regulations onto bronze ritual vessels or cowrie records (贝).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A sharp carver's knife (刂) precisely engraves an essential standard of value (贝) to create a binding rule (则).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un cuchillo afilado (刂) graba con exactitud una norma valiosa (贝), fijando una regla o artículo indeleble (则).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 随手翻阅古典笔记，几则意蕴幽深的小故事跃然纸上。古人用极为简练的笔墨勾勒出世态炎凉，每一则都闪烁着理性的光芒。这种凝练的文字力量，跨越时空依然能够直击现代读者的心灵深处。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suíshǒu fānyuè gǔdiǎn bǐjì, jǐ zé yìyùn yōushēn de xiǎo gùshì yuèrán zhǐ shàng. Gǔrén yòng jíwéi jiǎnliàn de bǐmò gōulè chū shìtài-yánliáng, měi yì zé dōu shǎnshuò zhe lǐxìng de guāngmáng. Zhè zhǒng níngliàn de wénzì lìliàng, kuàyuè shíkōng yīrán nénggòu zhíjī xiàndài dúzhě de xīnlíng shēnchù.
extended_reading_passages.en: Leafing through classical anthologies at leisure, several deeply suggestive micro-tales leap from the page. Ancient authors outlined the vicissitudes of human affairs with minimal brushstrokes, each item radiating the brilliance of reason. Such condensed literary power transcends time, directly touching modern readers.
extended_reading_passages.es: Hojeando relatos clásicos, varias viñetas de hondo significado cobran vida en el papel. Los antiguos esbozaban la complejidad humana con trazos sucintos; cada pasaje irradia lucidez racional. Esta admirable economía verbal trasciende las épocas y conmueve hondamente la sensibilidad del lector contemporáneo.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 现代传媒环境下，每天都有成千上万则资讯通过算法推送到受众眼前。面对纷繁复杂的信息洪流，如何保持独立思考、从浩瀚的数据中甄别出有价值的内容，成为衡量现代公民信息素养的重要准则。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xiàndài chuánméi huánjìng xià, měitiān dōu yǒu chéngqiān-shàngwàn zé zīxùn tōngguò suànfǎ tuīsòng dào shòuzhòng yǎnqián. Miànduì fēnfán fùzá de xìnxī hóngliú, rúhé bǎochí dúlì sīkǎo, cóng hàohàn de shùjù zhōng zhēnbié chū yǒu jiàzhí de nèiróng, chéngwéi héngliáng xiàndài gōngmín xìnxī sùyǎng de zhòngyào zhǔnzé.
extended_reading_passages.en: In modern media environments, tens of thousands of news dispatches are pushed before audiences daily by algorithms. Facing this torrent, maintaining independent reflection and discerning truly valuable content from vast data streams has become an essential benchmark of information literacy.
extended_reading_passages.es: En los entornos digitales contemporáneos, miles de noticias y avisos son suministrados a diario a los usuarios. Ante esta marea informativa, preservar el juicio crítico e identificar el saber valioso entre la avalancha de datos se erige en pauta esencial de madurez intelectual.

meanings_summary.en: blind person; visually impaired individual; person without sight
meanings_summary.es: persona ciega; invidente; persona con discapacidad visual

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A person (人) whose eyes have lost vision (盲) experiences the physical world through touch and sound as a blind person (盲人).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Una persona (人) cuyos ojos han perdido la visión (盲) percibe el entorno a través del tacto y el oído como invidente (盲人).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In classical Chinese epistemology, 盲 denotes optical sightlessness, but is frequently expanded into philosophical metaphors for cognitive bias (盲目, 盲从). The famous fable of 盲人摸象 from Buddhist sutras (涅槃经) established 盲人 as the archetypal symbol of epistemological limitation.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dual rising 2nd tones: 'máng rén' (35-35). Ensure smooth melodious elevation on both syllables without dropping tone mid-way.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 盲人 is the standard, respectful noun for a person with visual impairment, used neutrally in both social and allegorical contexts.

contrasts.analysis: 盲人 is the formal, respectful, and standard societal term used in education, law, and literature, whereas 瞎子 is colloquial and can easily sound blunt, abrasive, or derogatory if misused.
盲人 primarily denotes individuals with total or near-total blindness, whereas 视障者 (visually impaired persons) is a modern clinical umbrella term including low-vision and partial visual impairments.
盲人 specifies visual disability exclusively, whereas 残疾人 is the broad generic term encompassing all physical, sensory, and intellectual disabilities.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 女 (woman) below 亡 instead of 目
Has 心 (heart) below 亡 instead of 目
Has grass radical 艹 above 亡
Has heart radical 忄 next to 亡
Has 月 (flesh) below 亡 instead of 目

senses.definition_en: a person who has lost or lacks visual perception; visually impaired individual
senses.definition_es: persona privada de la vista o que presenta una ceguera total o severa
senses.example_phrase: 盲人摸象 (blind men touching an elephant)

example_sentences.hanzi: 城市在主干道上铺设了连续平整的盲道，为盲人日常独立出行提供了坚实的安全保障。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chéngshì zài zhǔgàndào shàng pūshè le liánxù píngzhěng de mángdào, wèi mángrén rìcháng dúlì chūxíng tígōng le jiānshí de ānquán bǎozhàng.
example_sentences.en: The city laid continuous, flat tactile paving along major avenues, offering solid safety protection for blind people's daily independent travel.
example_sentences.es: La ciudad pavimentó guías táctiles continuas en las avenidas principales, brindando una sólida garantía de seguridad para el tránsito autónomo de las personas ciegas.

example_sentences.hanzi: 《盲人摸象》这一经典寓言以盲人认知外界的局限为喻，生动警示人们切莫以偏概全。
example_sentences.pinyin: 《Mángrén Mō Xiàng》 zhè yì jīngdiǎn yùyán yǐ mángrén rènzhī wàijiè de júxiàn wéi yù, shēngdòng jǐngshì rénmen qièmò yǐpiān-gàiquán.
example_sentences.en: The classic allegory 'The Blind Men and the Elephant' uses the sensory constraints of blind people as a metaphor, vividly warning against confusing partial impressions with the whole.
example_sentences.es: La fábula clásica de los ciegos y el elefante toma como metáfora la percepción parcial del invidente para alertar contra el error de juzgar el todo por una parte aislada.

collocations.en: blind men feeling an elephant (taking parts for whole)
care for and support visually impaired individuals

idioms.meaning_en: blind men groping an elephant; take a part for the whole
a blind man on a blind horse; rushing headlong into grave danger
follow blindly without discernment
blind of eye but clear of heart; intuitive wisdom

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 亡 (loss, destruction) sitting atop 目 (eye), signifying that sight in the eyes has been extinguished.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: When sight perishes (亡) from above the physical eye (目), total darkness renders one blind (盲).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Cuando la luz fenece y muere (亡) sobre el órgano del ojo (目), la mirada queda a oscuras, creando la ceguera (盲).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Pictogram depicting a human standing upright on two legs, representing moral agency and social humanity.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Two stable strokes leaning together like a human walking upright on the fertile soil of the earth (人).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Dos trazos que se apoyan mutuamente evocando la silueta erguida de un ser humano en camino (人).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 盲人的世界虽然没有斑斓的色彩，但他们的指尖却能触摸到常人难以察觉的细腻肌理。用耳朵倾听风声，用内心体察人情，失明并没有遮蔽他们对生活的热爱，反而让灵魂沉淀得更为纯粹澄澈。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Mángrén de shìjiè suīrán méiyǒu bānlán de sècǎi, dàn tāmen de zhǐjiān què néng chùmō dào chángrén nányǐ chájào de xìnì jīlǐ. Yòng ěrduo qīngtīng fēngshēng, yòng nèixīn tǐchá rénqíng, shīmíng bìng méiyǒu zhēbì tāmen duì shēnghuó de rè'ài, fǎn'ér ràng línghún chéndiàn de gèngwéi chúncuì chéngchè.
extended_reading_passages.en: Although the world of blind people lacks resplendent colors, their fingertips can perceive delicate textures imperceptible to others. Listening to winds and intuiting human warmth, blindness never dims their love of life; rather, it distills their souls into pure lucidity.
extended_reading_passages.es: Aunque el mundo de los invidentes carezca de colores vivos, la yema de sus dedos capta texturas sutiles inadvertidas para la vista. Al escuchar el viento y auscultar el sentir ajeno, la ceguera no apaga su amor por la existencia, sino que dota a su espíritu de serena transparencia.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在无障碍智慧城市建设中，保障盲人群体的出行与数字权益已成为文明发展的重要指标。通过引入高精度语音导航系统与智能触觉感知设备，现代科技正在打破感官隔阂，协助视障人士更加自信从容地融入社会生活。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài wúzhàng'ài zhìhuì chéngshì jiànshè zhōng, bǎozhàng mángrén qúntǐ de chūxíng yǔ shùzì quányì yǐ chéngwéi wénmíng fāzhǎn de zhòngyào zhǐbiāo. Tōngguò yǐnrù gāojīngdù yǔyīn dǎoháng xìtǒng yǔ zhìnéng chùjué gǎnzhī shèbèi, xiàndài kējì zhèngzài dǎpò gǎnguān géhé, xiézhù shìzhàng rénshì gèngjiā zìxìn cóngróng de róngrù shèhuì shēnghuó.
extended_reading_passages.en: In building barrier-free smart cities, safeguarding the mobility and digital rights of the blind has become a vital benchmark of progress. By introducing precision voice navigation and tactile sensory devices, technology bridges sensory divides, empowering blind citizens to integrate into society.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el desarrollo de urbes inteligentes e inclusivas, velar por la movilidad y los derechos digitales de los invidentes es signo de madurez social. La navegación por voz y los sensores hápticos derriban barreras sensoriales, permitiendo a las personas con ceguera desenvolverse con plena autonomía.

meanings_summary.en: to touch; to stroke; to feel with hands; to grope for; to fathom or probe
meanings_summary.es: tocar; palpar; acariciar; tantear; buscar a tientas; sondear o averiguar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: In the absence of sunlight (莫), you must stretch out your hands (扌) to touch and grope your way forward (摸).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: En la penumbra cuando el sol declina (莫), la mano (扌) se alarga para tocar y tantear el camino (摸).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The character 摸 merges physical haptic exploration with mental conjecture. In Chinese cognitive metaphor, 'feeling an object with hands' (触觉) directly maps onto 'fathoming intangible human motives or systemic laws' (摸底, 摸索, 捉摸).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone 'mō' (55). Pronounced with an even, sustained, clear acoustic pitch contour.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 摸 stresses tactile exploration through hands and fingers, or figurative probing to ascertain unknown circumstances.

contrasts.analysis: 摸 involves deliberate, continuous manual rubbing or feeling to assess texture, whereas 碰 denotes a brief, abrupt collision or casual contact (碰见, 碰杯).
摸 is gentle, exploratory, and sensory (palping surface texture), whereas 抓 is a forceful, grasping action using curled fingers to seize or clutch an object firmly.
摸 is the direct monosyllabic physical verb (摸额头), while 摸索 is an abstract disyllabic verb emphasizing painstaking, trial-and-error exploration over time to overcome unfamiliar challenges.

senses.definition_en: to physically place hands or fingers upon an object to perceive texture, temperature, or shape; to feel or stroke
senses.definition_es: palpar o poner la mano sobre un objeto para percibir su textura, temperatura o contorno; tocar

senses.definition_en: to probe, fathom, search out, or ascertain an underlying situation or regular pattern
senses.definition_es: sondear, averiguar o descifrar a tientas una situación, pauta o ánimo
senses.example_phrase: 摸清底细 (fathom the real background)

example_sentences.hanzi: 母亲伸出手轻轻摸了摸孩子的额头，确定他烧已经退了，这才欣慰地松了一口气。
example_sentences.pinyin: Mǔqīn shēnchū shǒu qīngqīng mō le mō háizi de étóu, quèdìng tā shāo yǐjīng tuì le, zhè cái xīnwèi de sōng le yì kǒuqì.
example_sentences.en: The mother reached out and gently felt the child's forehead, and relieved to confirm his fever had subsided, she breathed a sigh of ease.
example_sentences.es: La madre extendió la mano y palpó con ternura la frente del niño; al comprobar que la fiebre había remitido, suspiró aliviada.

example_sentences.hanzi: 经过深入细致的实地调研，团队终于摸清了当地消费市场的真实需求与潜在增长点。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò shēnrù xìzhì de shídì diàoyán, tuánduì zhōngyú mōqīng le dāngdì xiāofèi shìchǎng de zhēnshí xūqiú yǔ qiánzài zēngzhǎngdiǎn.
example_sentences.en: Following thorough and meticulous field research, the team finally fathomed the local market's genuine consumer demands and potential growth avenues.
example_sentences.es: Tras minuciosas pesquisas sobre el terreno, el equipo logró al fin sondear y clarificar las auténticas demandas de los consumidores locales y sus nichos de expansión.

collocations.en: fumble for and discover regular patterns
ascertain the real facts; probe bottom lines

idioms.meaning_en: blind men feeling an elephant; taking a part for the whole
hard to fathom; unpredictable; elusive
go through arduous trials and grueling practice
surreptitious; sneaky; underhanded

character_decomposition.sound_component: 莫 (mò, sunset dusk / absence of light)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: hand radical 扌 indicates tactile physical contact, while 莫 (dusk / searching when the sun sinks into grass) conveys groping in dimness.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: When darkness falls across the grass (莫), one stretches out a gentle hand (扌) to feel and grope one's way along (摸).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Al caer la penumbra entre los pastos (莫), la mano (扌) se extiende prudente tanteando el sendero a ciegas (摸).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 穿过幽暗曲折的长廊，他只能伸出双手在潮湿的石壁上小心摸索。指尖触碰到的冰冷岩石凹凸不平，隐约传来的微弱风声指引着前进的方向。在黑暗中慢慢摸索，每一步都充满对未知的敬畏。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chuānguò yōu'àn qūzhé de chángláng, tā zhǐ néng shēnchū shuāngshǒu zài cháoshī de shíbì shàng xiǎoxīn mōsuǒ. Zhǐjiān chùpèng dào de bīnglěng yánshí āotū-bùpíng, yǐnyuē chuánlái de wēiruò fēngshēng zhǐyǐn zhe qiánjìn de fāngxiàng. Zài hēi'àn zhōng mànmàn mōsuǒ, měi yí bù dōu chōngmǎn duì wèizhī de jìngwèi.
extended_reading_passages.en: Traversing the dim, winding corridor, he could only extend both hands to carefully grope along the damp stone wall. The cold, jagged rock touched by his fingertips and faint breezes hinted at the path ahead. Fumbling patiently in the dark, every step was fraught with awe toward the unknown.
extended_reading_passages.es: Cruzando el oscuro y tortuoso corredor, no le quedaba más remedio que alargar las manos y tantear la húmeda pared de roca. El tacto gélido y desigual de la piedra y el leve rumor de una corriente guiaron sus pasos. Avanzar a tientas en las sombras colmaba cada pisada de respeto hacia lo ignoto.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 任何新兴科学领域的探索，初期都宛如盲人摸象，科学家们只能凭借有限的实验数据逐步摸清其内在逻辑。唯有汇聚多学科的智慧并进行反复验证，才能拼凑出客观规律的完整图景。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Rènhé xīnxīng kēxué lǐngyù de tànsuǒ, chūqī dōu wǎnrú mángrén mō xiàng, kēxuéjiāmen zhǐ néng píngjiè yǒuxiàn de shíyàn shùjù zhúbù mōqīng qí nèizài luóji. Wéiyǒu huìjù duō-kēxué de zhìhuì bìng jìnxíng fǎnfù yànzhèng, cáinéng pīncòu chū kèguān guīlǜ de wánzhěng tújǐng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Explorations into emergent scientific fields initially resemble blind men feeling an elephant; researchers must deduce intrinsic mechanisms through limited experimental data. Only by pooling interdisciplinary wisdom and reiterating tests can a coherent panorama of objective laws be pieced together.
extended_reading_passages.es: Explorar una disciplina científica incipiente se asemeja al tanteo de los ciegos ante el elefante: los científicos infieren la lógica subyacente con escasos datos empíricos. Solo combinando múltiples ramas del saber y verificando hipótesis se logra reconstruir la fisonomía íntegra de la realidad objetiva.

meanings_summary.en: elephant; large herbivorous pachyderm mammal
meanings_summary.es: elefante; gran mamífero paquidermo herbívoro de trompa prensil

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: An elephant is the greatest and biggest (大) living land beast, presenting an imposing, unforgettable bodily appearance (象) as the elephant (大象).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: El elefante es la criatura terrestre más grande (大) cuya imponente silueta corporal (象) define al colosal elefante (大象).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The character 象 is one of China's most ancient pictograms. In antiquity, wild elephants roamed the Yellow River basin (Henan's ancient abbreviation is 豫, showing a human leading an elephant). Because living elephants later became rare in northern China, people reconstructed their shape from tusks, so 象 expanded semantically from 'elephant' to 'mental image, symbol, phenomenon' (气象, 形象, 想象).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dual falling 4th tones: 'dà xiàng' (51-51). The first 4th tone starts high and drops decisively, followed immediately by a crisp, emphatic second falling contour.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 大象 refers specifically to the zoological biological animal, while 象 alone often acts as an abstract root for image, form, or manifestation.

contrasts.analysis: 大象 is the concrete zoological noun for the living animal, whereas 象 alone is polysemous in compound words, often meaning image, symbol, phenomenon, or likeness (现象, 气象, 意象).
大象 identifies the specific proboscidean species, whereas 巨兽 is a literary or mythological term describing any mammoth prehistoric or predatory monster.
大象 describes a gentle herbivore often domesticated in southern Asia, while 野兽 refers generally to untamed, ferocious beasts of prey.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has person radical 亻 on the left
Has 予 on the left instead of standalone 象
Has roof 宀 with pig 豕 below without the trunk hook
Has 亠 and 口 at top instead of elephant's trunk
Has 耳 (ear) and 又 (hand) with 豕 below

senses.definition_en: a huge four-legged herbivorous mammal with a long flexible trunk, prominent tusks, and thick skin, native to Africa and Asia
senses.definition_es: mamífero terrestre de gran corpulencia, piel gruesa, grandes orejas y larga trompa móvil, propio de Asia y África

example_sentences.hanzi: 在云南热带雨林保护区，一群野生大象悠闲地漫步在河边饮水嬉戏，引来无数观光客驻足。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài Yúnnán rèdài yǔlín bǎohùqū, yì qún yěshēng dàxiàng yōuxián de mànbù zài hébiān yǐnshuǐ xīxì, yǐnlái wúshù guānguāngkè zhùzú.
example_sentences.en: In the Yunnan rainforest reserve, a herd of wild elephants leisurely ambled by the river drinking and splashing, drawing countless visitors to halt and watch.
example_sentences.es: En la reserva de la selva tropical de Yunnan, una manada de elefantes salvajes paseaba plácidamente junto al río bebiendo y retozando, atrayendo las miradas de los turistas.

example_sentences.hanzi: 大象具有高度发达的情感与群体记忆力，它们彼此照顾、尊重年长者的社交习性令人赞叹不已。
example_sentences.pinyin: Dàxiàng jùyǒu gāodù fādá de qínggǎn yǔ qúntǐ jìyìlì, tāmen bǐcǐ zhàogù, zūnzhòng niánzhǎngzhě de shèjiāo xíxìng lìng rén zàntàn bùyǐ.
example_sentences.en: Elephants possess highly developed emotional capacities and collective memories; their social habits of mutually caring and honoring matriarchs are truly marvelous.
example_sentences.es: Los elefantes poseen un extraordinario desarrollo emocional y una viva memoria colectiva; sus hábitos sociales de protegerse entre sí y acatar a los ancianos suscitan honda admiración.

idioms.meaning_en: blind men feeling an elephant; taking a partial view for the whole
a colossal object; a formidable giant beast
embrace all phenomena; all-inclusive
ivory tower; secluded sanctuary of academic life

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 大 (human spreading arms and legs wide)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Pictogram of an adult human spreading arms and legs as wide as possible to signify immense scale.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A human stretches arms and legs outward across the sky to show just how big (大) the world can be.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un ser humano extiende los brazos y piernas abiertos de par en par para abarcar la mayor grandeza (大).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 象 (long trunk, large ears, four legs, tail)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient oracle bone pictogram depicting a live elephant with an elongated trunk, large head, tusks, and sturdy torso.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Look at the curling upper trunk (⺈), mouth, heavy body (豕), and tail of an enormous wild elephant (象).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: La silueta arcaica muestra la trompa curvada en lo alto (⺈), el lomo robusto (豕) y la zanca del elefante (象).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 晨光穿透浓密的原始丛林，几头体型庞大的大象迈着从容稳健的步伐穿行在绿野之间。它们用修长的鼻子卷起青草，彼此发出低沉温和的鸣叫，与静谧的大自然共同谱写出动人心弦的和谐乐章。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chénguāng chuāntòu nóngmì de yuánshǐ cónglín, jǐ tóu tǐxíng pángdà de dàxiàng màizhe cóngróng wěnjiàn de bùfá chuānxíng zài lǜyě zhījiān. Tāmen yòng xiūcháng de bízi juǎnqǐ qīngcǎo, bǐcǐ fāchū dīchén wēnhé de míngjiào, yǔ jìngmì de dàzìrán gòngtóng pǔxiě chū dòngrén xīnxxián de héxié yuèzhāng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Morning sunlight pierces dense primeval jungles as several colossal elephants tread through verdant clearings with composed, steady strides. Curling fresh foliage with long trunks and trading low gentle rumbles, they compose a moving symphony of harmony with serene nature.
extended_reading_passages.es: La luz del alba cruza la selva virgen mientras varios elefantes colosales caminan con porte sereno por las praderas. Enrollando tierna hierba con sus largas trompas e intercambiando graves barritos, conciertan con la naturaleza un entrañable cántico de quietud y armonía.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在亚洲传统生态文化中，大象不仅是森林生态系统的基石物种，更是吉祥与智慧的化身。保护野象的栖息环境与迁徙通道，不仅关乎生物多样性的维系，更生动体现了人与自然休戚与共的现代生态智慧。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài Yàzhōu chuántǒng shēngtài wénhuà zhōng, dàxiàng bùjǐn shì sēnlín shēngtài xìtǒng de jīshí wùzhǒng, gèng shì jíxiáng yǔ zhìhuì de huàshēn. Bǎohù yěxiàng de qīxī huánjìng yǔ qiānxǐ tōngdào, bùjǐn guānhū shēngwù duōyàngxìng de wéixì, gèng shēngdòng tǐxiàn le rén yǔ zìrán xiūqī-yǔgòng de xiàndài shēngtài zhìhuì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In traditional Asian ecological culture, elephants are not only keystone species of forest biomes, but also incarnations of auspiciousness and wisdom. Protecting their habitats and corridors preserves biodiversity and embodies the ecological wisdom of human-nature coexistence.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la tradición ecológica asiática, los elefantes son tanto especies clave del ecosistema como emblemas de ventura y entendimiento. Preservar sus hábitats y sendas migratorias salvaguarda la biodiversidad y atestigua el noble compromiso de coexistir en armonía con el entorno natural.

meanings_summary.en: wisdom; intelligence; sagacity; discernment
meanings_summary.es: sabiduría; entendimiento; discernimiento; inteligencia profunda

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Knowledge lit by the sun (智) paired with a mind swept clear of ignorance (慧) produces true philosophical wisdom (智慧).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: El saber iluminado por el sol (智) unido a un corazón limpio de ofuscación (慧) engendra la auténtica sabiduría (智慧).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Confucian and Buddhist traditions, 智 represents rational cognition and learning, while 慧 (prajñā) denotes intuitive enlightenment and spiritual discernment. Together, 智慧 signifies holistic comprehension spanning empirical acuity and moral depth.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dual falling 4th tones: 'zhì huì' (51-51). Pronounce each syllable with firm, crisp falling intonation.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 智慧 represents deep, holistic life philosophy and discernment, far deeper than mere cleverness or raw intellectual capacity.

contrasts.analysis: 智慧 is profound philosophical insight and ethical maturity gained through experience, whereas 聪明 denotes quick wit, sharp senses, and academic agility (聪=keen ears, 明=clear eyes).
智慧 is the ability to apply principles and understand life's deeper truths, whereas 知识 refers to learned factual information, academic data, or technical skills.
智慧 is enduring and serene depth of character, while 机智 emphasizes lightning-fast tactical wit in responding to immediate emergencies or humor.

senses.definition_en: the ability to understand, judge, perceive truth, and act wisely based on knowledge and experience
senses.definition_es: capacidad de discernir, comprender las causas profundas y actuar con prudencia y agudeza

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对错综复杂的生活变故，保持内心的从容淡定需要非凡的人生智慧与胸襟。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì cuòzōng-fùzá de shēnghuó biàngù, bǎochí nèixīn de cóngróng dàndìng xūyào fēifán de rénshēng zhìhuì yǔ xiōngjīn.
example_sentences.en: When facing intricate twists of fate, maintaining inner composure and tranquility requires extraordinary life wisdom and breadth of mind.
example_sentences.es: Ante los complejos avatares del destino, conservar la serenidad y la paz interior exige una extraordinaria sabiduría vital y una noble amplitud de miras.

example_sentences.hanzi: 这部古典著作凝聚了古代思想家的卓越智慧，为解决现代社会的可持续发展问题提供了深刻启迪。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhè bù gǔdiǎn zhùzuò níngjù le gǔdài sīxiǎngjiā de zhuóyuè zhìhuì, wèi jiějué xiàndài shèhuì de kěchíxù fāzhǎn wèntí tígōng le shēnkè qǐdí.
example_sentences.en: This classical opus crystallizes the remarkable wisdom of ancient thinkers, offering profound inspiration for solving modern sustainability challenges.
example_sentences.es: Esta obra clásica condensa la preclara sabiduría de los pensadores antiguos, brindando fecunda inspiración para encarar el desarrollo sostenible del mundo contemporáneo.

collocations.en: bring one's wisdom into full play

idioms.meaning_en: great wisdom often appears as folly; true sages remain unassuming
wise and resourceful; full of stratagems
possessing both wisdom and courage
hit upon a brilliant idea in a crisis

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogram: knowledge 知 illuminated beneath the radiant sun 日, signifying enlightened, clear discernment.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: When true knowledge (知) is held up to the radiant light of the sun (日), it becomes illuminating wisdom (智).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Cuando el saber verdadero (知) se baña en la claridad del sol (日), florece el discernimiento sabio (智).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: broom 彗 above heart 心, denoting sweeping away ignorance from the mind to achieve lucidity.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Sweeping away inner dust with a broom (彗) cleanses the perceptual heart (心) to foster bright intelligence (慧).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Barrer la ignorancia con una escoba (彗) purifica el corazón y la mente (心), dejando brotar la inteligencia viva (慧).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 真正的智慧并非炫耀渊博的学识，而是在纷扰的世界中洞察事物的本质。懂得适时止步，懂得包容异己，在看似平凡的柴米油盐中体会生命的深沉与从容，这才是最可宝贵的人生大智慧。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de zhìhuì bìng fēi xuànyào yuānbó de xuéshí, érshì zài fēnrǎo de shìjiè zhōng dòngchá shìwù de běnzhì. Dǒngdé shìshí zhǐbù, dǒngdé bāoróng yìjǐ, zài kànsì píngfán de cháimǐyóuyán zhōng tǐhuì shēngmìng de shēnchén yǔ cóngróng, zhè cái shì zuì kě bǎoguì de rénshēng dà zhìhuì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Genuine wisdom does not flaunt erudite scholarship, but penetrates to the essence of things amid a chaotic world. Knowing when to pause, embracing differences, and perceiving depth in ordinary daily life constitute the most precious life wisdom.
extended_reading_passages.es: La verdadera sabiduría no alardea de vasta erudición, sino que discierne la esencia de las cosas en medio del tumulto. Saber detenerse a tiempo, acoger la discrepancia y apreciar la hondura de lo cotidiano forjan la más valiosa de las virtudes humanas.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在人工智能飞速演进的时代，人类的独特价值不仅在于强大的计算逻辑，更在于饱含道德同理心与生命体验的文化智慧。唯有将科技发展根植于人类文明的智慧土壤，才能确保技术造福于整个社会的和谐进步。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài réngōng zhìnéng fēisù yǎnjìn de shídài, rénlèi de dútè jiàzhí bùjǐn zàiyú qiángdà de jìsuàn luóji, gèng zàiyú bǎohán dàodé tónglǐxīn yǔ shēngmìng tǐyàn de wénhuà zhìhuì. Wéiyǒu jiāng kējì fāzhǎn gēnzhí yú rénlèi wénmíng de zhìhuì tǔrǎng, cáinéng quèbǎo jìshù zàofú yú zhěnggè shèhuì de héxié jìnbù.
extended_reading_passages.en: In an era of rapid AI evolution, unique human worth lies not just in computing prowess, but in cultural wisdom imbued with empathy and lived experience. Only by rooting tech progress in civilizational wisdom can we ensure it enriches harmonious social progress.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la era del auge vertiginoso de la inteligencia artificial, el valor irreemplazable del ser humano radica en su empatía moral y sabiduría existencial. Solo anclando la innovación tecnológica en el acervo ético de la civilización se garantizará un progreso armónico para toda la sociedad.

meanings_summary.en: soldier; private; rank-and-file serviceman; combatant
meanings_summary.es: soldado; militar raso; combatiente; miembro de las fuerzas armadas

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: An honorable warrior (士) who grips his battle weapon (兵) with courage serves as a valiant soldier (士兵).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un noble combatiente (士) que empuña su arma de combate (兵) sirve con honor como leal soldado (士兵).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Zhou society, 士 represented the class of noble scholar-warriors proficient in the Six Arts (六艺). Over centuries, 兵 (hands holding an axe) combined with 士 to denote the modern armed serviceman who unites moral discipline with battlefield prowess.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone followed by high level 1st tone: 'shì bīng' (51-55). Strike 'shì' downward firmly, then leap into a level, sustained 'bīng'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 士兵 specifically designates an enlisted fighter or rank-and-file private, contrasted with commanders and officers.

contrasts.analysis: 士兵 are the rank-and-file enlisted troops carrying out battlefield orders, whereas 将军 is a high-ranking general responsible for overarching strategic command.
士兵 refers specifically to lower-rank enlisted personnel, whereas 军人 is a comprehensive umbrella term for any service member regardless of rank or role.
士兵 is an objective military rank/role descriptor, while 战士 carries an emotional, heroic, or ideological connotation of a brave fighter.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has a short top horizontal stroke and long bottom stroke
Has 丘 on top of 山 instead of 兵
Has a single top stroke and curved base without 八
Missing the right leg stroke of 兵
Missing the left leg stroke of 兵

senses.definition_en: an enlisted member of an army or armed forces below the rank of officer
senses.definition_es: miembro de las tropas de un ejército de rango inferior a la oficialidad; combatiente

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对突如其来的洪涝灾害，数千名年轻士兵奋不顾身地跳入冰冷刺骨的洪水中抢修堤坝。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì tūrúqílái de hónglào zāihài, shù qiān míng niánqīng shìbīng fènbùgùshēn de tiàorù bīnglěng cìgǔ de hóngshuǐ zhōng qiǎngxiū dībà.
example_sentences.en: In the face of sudden torrential floods, thousands of young soldiers jumped fearlessly into bone-chilling floodwaters to repair the dykes.
example_sentences.es: Ante las repentinas inundaciones, miles de jóvenes soldados se arrojaron valerosamente a las gélidas aguas torrenciales para reforzar los diques.

example_sentences.hanzi: 将军深知，一支纪律严明、士气高昂的军队，其力量源泉正是每一位恪尽职守的普通士兵。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jiāngjūn shēnzhī, yì zhī jìlǜ yánmíng, shìqì gāo'áng de jūnduì, qí lìliàng yuánquán zhèng shì měi yí wèi kèjìn-zhíshǒu de pǔtōng shìbīng.
example_sentences.en: The general knew well that the fountainhead of an army's iron discipline and high morale is each ordinary soldier fulfilling duty conscientiously.
example_sentences.es: El general sabía que el manantial de fuerza de un ejército disciplinado y resuelto reside en cada soldado raso que cumple su deber con abnegación.

idioms.meaning_en: speed is precious in warfare; act with rapid dispatch
hone weapons and feed horses; prepare intensively for battle
engage in hand-to-hand combat; fight at close quarters
hold troops back; bide one's time without taking action

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient bronze pictogram of an axe or ceremonial battle weapon standing upright, symbolizing martial status and noble duty.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An upright, resolute warrior stands tall with broad shoulders (top long stroke) anchored on the firm ground (bottom short stroke) (士).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un guerrero noble y resuelto se alza firme con anchos hombros y pisada sólida sobre la tierra (士).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictogram depicting two hands 八 holding a battle-axe 斤, directly representing armed martial combat.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Two hands (八) gripping a sharp battle-axe (斤) ready to defend the frontier like a brave soldier (兵).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Dos manos resueltas (八) empuñando un hacha de combate (斤) listas para defender la frontera como un soldado (兵).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 边境线上的哨所高耸入云，呼啸的风雪吞没了漫漫长夜。年轻的士兵手握钢枪，宛如一尊巍然屹立的界碑。为了身后万家灯火的安宁，他们将最美好的青春岁月默默奉献给祖国苍茫的边关。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Biānjìngxiàn shàng de shàosuǒ gāosǒng-rùyún, hūxiào de fēngxuě tūnmò le mànmàn chángyè. Niánqīng de shìbīng shǒuwò gāngqiāng, wǎnrú yì zūn wēirán yìlì de jièbēi. Wèile shēnhòu wànjiā-dēnghuǒ de ānníng, tāmen jiāng zuì měihǎo de qīngchūn suìyuè mòmò fèngxiàn gěi zǔguó cāngmáng de biānguān.
extended_reading_passages.en: The outpost atop the border ridge pierces the clouds as howling blizzards swallow the long night. Clasping his steel rifle, the young soldier stands like a towering milestone. To protect the peaceful hearths behind him, he silently dedicates his youth to the nation's rugged frontier.
extended_reading_passages.es: El puesto fronterizo se eleva entre las nubes mientras la ventisca azota la noche. El joven soldado empuña su fusil erguido como un hito inamovible. Para salvaguardar la paz de miles de hogares, entrega en silencio sus mejores años a la austera linde de la patria.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代信息化战场上，士兵的角色正在经历深刻变革。除了过硬的身体素质与意志力，现代士兵更需要熟练掌握先进的数字化武器系统，具备在复杂电磁环境下独立判断与协同作战的综合素养。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài xìnxīhuà zhànchǎng shàng, shìbīng de juésè zhèngzài jīnglì shēnkè biàngé. Chúle guòyìng de shēntǐ sùzhì yǔ yìzhìlì, xiàndài shìbīng gèng xūyào shúliàn zhǎangwò xiānjìn de shùzìhuà wǔqì xìtǒng, jùbèi zài fùzá diàncí huánjìng xià dúlì pànduàn yǔ xiétóng zuòzhàn de zōnghé sùyǎng.
extended_reading_passages.en: On modern digitalized battlefields, the soldier's role is undergoing profound transformation. Beyond formidable physical fitness and willpower, modern soldiers must master advanced digital weaponry, possessing capabilities for independent judgment and synchronized combat in complex scenarios.
extended_reading_passages.es: En los escenarios bélicos digitalizados de hoy, el cometido del soldado experimenta una honda transformación. Además de temple y resistencia física, requiere dominio de sistemas cibernéticos y armamento avanzado, aunando criterio autónomo y作战 coordinada en entornos complejos.

meanings_summary.en: blind; sightless; groundlessly; foolishly; aimlessly; to go blind
meanings_summary.es: ciego; sin vista; a ciegas; sin fundamento; disparatadamente; cegar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: When a severe harm (害) impairs the physical eye (目), a person becomes blind (瞎) and must navigate blindly (瞎).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Cuando una herida o daño (害) lesiona el ojo (目), sobreviene la ceguera (瞎) y se actúa a ciegas (瞎).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The character 瞎 extends from physical ocular injury (目受害) into widespread colloquial cognitive metaphors for mental blindness, irrationality, and disorderly guesswork (瞎想, 瞎闹, 瞎折腾), portraying rash actions conducted without sight of reality.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone 'xiā' (55). Pronounced with an energetic, flat, unbending acoustic pitch.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 瞎 is intensely colloquial and versatile, denoting both physical sightlessness and adverbial actions done blindly or foolishly.

contrasts.analysis: 盲 is the formal, literary morpheme used in serious vocabulary (盲人, 盲目, 文盲), whereas 瞎 is colloquial, daily, and carries informal behavioral nuances (瞎折腾, 瞎操心).
瞎 emphasizes acting without visual direction or factual ground (瞎说=saying without seeing), whereas 胡 emphasizes acting recklessly against norms or etiquette (胡闹, 胡搞).
瞎 highlights lack of vision or purpose (doing things aimlessly), while 乱 highlights chaotic disorder, messiness, and turmoil (乱七八糟, 扰乱).

Has knife 刂 on the right instead of 目
Has 谷 (valley) on the left instead of 目
Has 目 on the left paired with 害
Has 目 paired with  (mán)

senses.definition_en: sightless; blind; having lost physical eyesight
senses.definition_es: ciego; privado de la vista
senses.example_phrase: 瞎了一只眼 (blind in one eye)

senses.definition_en: groundlessly; foolishly; haphazardly; without reason or direction
senses.definition_es: sin fundamento; a tontas y a locas; disparatadamente; sin tino

example_sentences.hanzi: 事情还没有调查清楚之前，千万不要跟着别人瞎起哄或者瞎猜疑，以免伤害无辜。
example_sentences.pinyin: Shìqing hái méiyǒu diàochá qīngchǔ zhīqián, qiānwàn búyào gēnzhe biérén xiā qǐhòng huòzhě xiā cāiyí, yǐmiǎn shānghài wúgū.
example_sentences.en: Before the matter has been thoroughly investigated, never join in clamoring or suspecting foolishly, lest you harm the innocent.
example_sentences.es: Antes de que los hechos se esclarezcan por completo, no te unas a alborotar ni a sospechar sin fundamento para no dañar a inocentes.

example_sentences.hanzi: 如果缺乏明确的战略规划，企业在多变的市场竞争中就容易像无头苍蝇一样瞎忙活。
example_sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ quēfá míngquè de zhànlüè guīhuà, qǐyè zài duōbiàn de shìchǎng jìngzhēng zhōng jiù róngyì xiàng wútóu cāngyíng yíyàng xiā mánghuo.
example_sentences.en: Lacking clear strategic planning, an enterprise will easily fuss about aimlessly like a headless fly amid turbulent market competition.
example_sentences.es: Si carece de una planificación estratégica clara, una empresa caerá con facilidad en el error de afanarse a ciegas como mosca sin cabeza en un mercado competitivo.

collocations.en: blind in eye but clear in heart

idioms.meaning_en: a blind man on a blind horse; riding headlong into disaster
blind men feeling an elephant; biased, partial view
a blind man lighting a lantern; a futile, pointless effort
talk complete rubbish; babble nonsense

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: eye radical 目 combined with harm 害, literally signifying that damage or injury has afflicted the eye.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An unfortunate injury or harm (害) strikes directly into the delicate eye (目), causing one to go blind (瞎).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un daño o herida grave (害) lesiona el órgano del ojo (目), dejándolo sin visión y sumiéndolo en la ceguera (瞎).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 面对未知的人生旅途，盲目的恐惧往往源于内心的瞎猜。与其在焦虑中胡思乱想、自我内耗，不如脚踏实地去了解真相。唯有擦亮双眼认清方向，才能摆脱在黑暗中瞎转悠的困境。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Miànduì wèizhī de rénshēng lǚtú, mángmù de kǒngjù wǎngwǎng yuányú nèixīn de xiācāi. Yǔqí zài jiāolǜ zhōng húsī-luànxiǎng, zìwǒ nèihào, bùrú jiǎotà-shídì qù liǎojiě zhēnxiàng. Wéiyǒu cāliàng shuāngyǎn rènqīng fāngxiàng, cáinéng bǎituō zài hēi'àn zhōng xiāzhuànyou de kùnjìng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Facing the unknown journey of life, blind fears often stem from groundless guesswork within. Rather than fretting with wild thoughts and draining energy, it is better to seek the facts pragmatically. Only by clearing our vision can we escape wandering aimlessly in the dark.
extended_reading_passages.es: Frente al rumbo ignoto de la vida, los temores ciegos brotan de conjeturas infundadas. En vez de desgastarse en cavilaciones inútiles, conviene pisar tierra y constatar la realidad. Solo aclarando la vista se sortea el tropiezo de dar vueltas a ciegas en la oscuridad.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在复杂的商业决策中，脱离科学调研的瞎指挥往往会给企业带来毁灭性的灾难。现代管理者必须建立在详实数据与市场规律的基础上，杜绝主观臆断，方能在激烈的全球化市场博弈中立于不败之地。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài fùzá de shāngyè juécè zhōng, tuōlí kēxué diàoyán de xiāzhǐhuī wǎngwǎng huì gěi qǐyè dàilái huǐmièxìng de zāinàn. Xiàndài guǎnlǐzhě bìxū jiànlì zài xiángshí shùjù yǔ shìchǎng guīlǜ de jīchǔ shàng, dùjué zhǔguān yìduàn, fāng néng zài jīliè de quánqiúhuà shìchǎng bóyì zhōng lìyú-búbàizhīdì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In complex business decisions, arbitrary directives detached from scientific research often bring ruinous disaster to firms. Modern executives must base moves on solid data and market laws, eliminating wild whims to remain invincible in global competition.
extended_reading_passages.es: En las decisiones corporativas complejas, las órdenes arbitrarias huérfanas de rigor analítico causan estragos irreparables. Los directivos han de afianzar sus planes en datos fidedignos y tendencias de mercado, desterrando caprichos para prevalecer en la liza internacional.

meanings_summary.en: separately; respectively; to part; to distinguish; difference
meanings_summary.es: por separado; respectivamente; despedirse; separarse; diferenciar; diferencia

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Cutting into distinct parts with a blade (分) and going separate divergent ways (别) captures both parting in life and acting separately (分别).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Dividir con filo cortante (分) y tomar caminos distintos (别) resume tanto la despedida como obrar por separado (分别).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Chinese poetic aesthetics, 分别 carries profound emotional resonance for the sorrow of parting (离别, 惜别) across vast geographical distances. In logical discourse, it serves as the essential cognitive function of differentiation and respective assignment.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone followed by rising 2nd tone: 'fēn bié' (55-35). Start with a level high pitch before sweeping smoothly upward.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 分别 serves as an adverb for doing tasks respectively/separately, and as a verb for emotionally parting company.

contrasts.analysis: 分别 emphasizes acting separately or itemizing two or more specific targets (分别向A和B汇报), whereas 各自 emphasizes individual subjectivity or each party minding their own affairs (各自回家).
分别 can function as a verb for parting or an adverb for separately, whereas 区别 is purely a noun or verb for distinguishing differences between concepts (两者的区别).
分别 emphasizes the mutual separation of paths (同窗分别), while 告别 emphasizes the explicit formal ceremony or action of bidding farewell (举行告别仪式).

senses.definition_en: separately; respectively; individually taking actions or itemizing components
senses.definition_es: por separado; respectivamente; de manera independiente

senses.definition_en: to part company; to separate from someone after being together
senses.definition_es: despedirse; separarse; apartarse tras una estancia común

senses.definition_en: difference; distinction; disparity between two or more things
senses.definition_es: diferencia; distinción; disparidad
senses.example_phrase: 没有很大分别 (no big difference)

example_sentences.hanzi: 大学毕业典礼结束后，朝夕相处四年的同窗好友们含着热泪分别，奔赴天南海北打拼前程。
example_sentences.pinyin: Dàxué bìyè diǎnlǐ jiéshù hòu, zhāoxī-xiāngchǔ sì nián de tóngchuāng hǎoyǒu men hánzhe rèlèi fēnbié, bēnfù tiānnán-hǎiběi dǎpīn qiánchéng.
example_sentences.en: After the college commencement ceremony, classmates who had shared four years of daily life parted with warm tears to pursue careers across the country.
example_sentences.es: Tras la graduación universitaria, los entrañables compañeros que compartieron cuatro años se despidieron con lágrimas, partiendo a todos los rincones del país en pos de su porvenir.

example_sentences.hanzi: 会议闭幕后，三个专业考察小组分别前往不同省份开展实地调研，以确保数据的全面真实。
example_sentences.pinyin: Huìyì bìmù hòu, sān gè zhuānyè kǎochá xiǎozǔ fēnbié qiánwǎng bùtóng shěngfèn kāizhǎn shídì diàoyán, yǐ quèbǎo shùjù de quánmiàn zhēnshí.
example_sentences.en: After the conference adjourned, three expert inspection teams went separately to different provinces to conduct fieldwork, ensuring comprehensive, authentic data.
example_sentences.es: Al clausurarse el congreso, tres comisiones técnicas partieron por separado hacia distintas provincias para realizar estudios de campo y recabar datos integrales.

idioms.meaning_en: categorize and arrange orderly in distinct groups
become an entirely different person; marked change
clearly distinct as the Jing and Wei rivers
each goes their separate way to pursue their future

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictogram showing a sharp knife 刀 cutting something in half into two parts 八, signifying partition.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A sharp blade (刀) cleanly slices an item into two separate sections (八), causing them to divide (分).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una hoja afilada (刀) hiende un objeto en dos mitades (八), dividiéndolo con exactitud (分).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictogram depicting a knife 刂 dismembering or cleaving bones 另, representing parting of connected entities.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Cleaving a bond with a knife (刂) forces friends into separate paths, leaving them to part (别).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un filo cortante (刂) disgrega las partes unidas (另), marcando una despedida y divergencia de caminos (别).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 人生的大部分时光，都在相聚与分别中悄然流逝。昔日的同窗挚友如今分别在各自的岗位上拼搏，虽关山阻隔、音讯渐稀，但每当夜深人静想起那段青春岁月，心底依然洋溢着温暖与感动。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Rénshēng de dàbùfen shíguāng, dōu zài xiāngjù yǔ fēnbié zhōng qiǎorán liúshì. Xīrì de tóngchuāng zhìyǒu rújīn fēnbié zài gèzì de gǎngwèi shàng pīnbó, suī guānshān zǔgé, yīnxùn jiàn xī, dàn měidāng yèshēn-rénjìng xiǎngqǐ nà duàn qīngchūn suìyuè, xīndǐ yīrán yángyì zhe wēnnuǎn yǔ gǎndòng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Most of life's hours flow silently between reunions and partings. Close companions of bygone school days are now striving respectively at their own posts; though separated by mountains, memories of those youthful years still stir deep warmth.
extended_reading_passages.es: El curso de la vida discurre entre encuentros y despedidas. Los entrañables amigos de antaño batallan hoy por separado en sus propios destinos; pese a la distancia, el recuerdo de aquella dorada juventud sigue inundando el corazón de gratitud.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在统筹区域经济协同发展的进程中，各城市群应当根据自身的资源禀赋分别制定差异化产业政策。避免同质化恶性竞争，在分工协作中实现优势互补，是推动经济高质量发展的必由之路。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài tǒngchóu qūyù jīngjì xiétóng fāzhǎn de jìnchéng zhōng, gè chéngshìqún yīngdāng gēnjù zìshēn de zīyuán bǐngfù fēnbié zhìdìng chāyìhuà chǎnyè zhèngcè. Bìmǐan tóngzhìhuà èxìng jìngzhēng, zài fēngōng xiézuò zhōng shíxiàn yōushì hùbǔ, shì tuīdòng jīngjì gāozhìliàng fāzhǎn de bìyóuzhīlù.
extended_reading_passages.en: In coordinating regional economic synergy, urban agglomerations must formulate differentiated industrial policies respectively based on their resources. Avoiding homogenous rivalry and achieving complementary advantages is essential for high-quality growth.
extended_reading_passages.es: Al coordinar el desarrollo económico regional, cada conurbación urbana ha de trazar respectivamente políticas industriales acordes con sus recursos propios. Evitar pugnas homogéneas y sumar ventajas mediante la colaboración es senda inexcusable hacia el progreso cualitativo.

meanings_summary.en: to search for; to seek; to look for; to pursue an objective or answer
meanings_summary.es: buscar; rastrear; indagar; procurar hallar un objeto, respuesta o ideal

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Measuring every inch (寻) with an outstretched hand (找) captures the relentless human drive to seek and search (寻找).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Medir palmo a palmo (寻) con la mano extendida (找) encarna el perseverante empeño humano por buscar (寻找).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient metrology, an ancient Chinese fathom was a 'xún' (寻 = 8 chi). From pacing out and surveying distances with arms outstretched evolved the cognitive sense of deep searching and philosophical inquiry into truth (寻道, 探寻).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by dipping 3rd tone: 'xún zhǎo' (35-214). Glide the first syllable upward before allowing the second syllable to dip down.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 寻找 is the formal, literary, and contemplative term for searching for both concrete objects and abstract ideals, contrasted with colloquial 找.

contrasts.analysis: 找 is the common daily oral verb (找钥匙, 找人), whereas 寻找 has a much higher, contemplative literary register suited for books, research, and life goals (寻找真理, 寻找灵魂).
寻找 is broad and gentle, while 搜寻 emphasizes an intensive, systematic, or police sweep through a physical grid (搜寻幸存者, 搜寻坠机地点).
寻找 assumes the target object or truth already exists and needs to be located, whereas 探索 means pioneering into uncharted territory to uncover new knowledge (探索宇宙).
