Has 巳 (snake) above 寸 instead of 彐
Has 丿 at top left and curved hook rather than 扌
Has 又 on the left instead of 扌
Has metal radical 钅 on the left

senses.definition_en: to make an active, deliberate effort to locate someone, discover something lost, or pursue an ideal or truth
senses.definition_es: esforzarse activamente por dar con algo extraviado, localizar a alguien o perseguir la verdad

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对突发的技术瓶颈，研发团队夜以继日地查阅文献，全力寻找切实可行的替代方案。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì tūfā de jìshù píngjǐng, yánfā tuánduì yèyǐjìrì de cháyuè wénxiàn, quánlì xúnzhǎo qièshí-kěxíng de tìdài fāng'àn.
example_sentences.en: Facing an unexpected technical bottleneck, the R&D team consulted literature day and night, making every effort to search for feasible alternatives.
example_sentences.es: Ante un imprevisto cuello de botella técnico, el equipo de I+D consultó bibliografía día y noche para buscar afanosamente una alternativa viable.

example_sentences.hanzi: 许多年轻人在快节奏的现代生活中感到迷茫，渴望通过旅行去寻找内心的宁静与生活的真谛。
example_sentences.pinyin: Xǔduō niánqīngrén zài kuàijièzòu de xiàndài shēnghuó zhōng gǎndào mímáng, kěwàng tōngguò lǚxíng qù xúnzhǎo nèixīn de níngjìng yǔ shēnghuó de zhēndì.
example_sentences.en: Many youths feel disoriented in fast-paced modern life, yearning to search through travel for inner serenity and life's genuine essence.
example_sentences.es: Muchos jóvenes se sienten desorientados en la vida moderna y anhelan buscar en los viajes la serenidad del alma y el sentido auténtico del vivir.

idioms.meaning_en: seek perfection and censure shortcomings harshly
trace to the root and probe the bottom of a matter
search for someone amidst a vast multitude
bring vexation and trouble upon oneself unnecessarily

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Originally depicted two outstretched hands measuring eight ancient cubits (a fathom), representing pacing off distance to search carefully.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Pacing forward and measuring every inch (寸) of the ground beneath the eaves (彐) to search for what was lost (寻).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Medir palmo a palmo cada rincón (寸) bajo la techumbre (彐) para buscar con paciencia lo extraviado (寻).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: hand 扌 grasping a martial weapon 戈, portraying searching for one's arms during an alert.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: With an anxious hand (扌) one reaches out into the rack searching for one's reliable weapon (戈) to find it (找).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Con mano presurosa (扌) se tantea en la armería buscando la fiel lanza (戈) para dar con ella (找).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 漫漫人生旅途，我们总在不断寻找。寻找理解自己的知己，寻找安放灵魂的港湾，更在迷茫中寻找生命的价值与意义。即便前路云雾缭绕，只要心中尚有明灯，那份执着的寻找就永远不会停歇。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Mànmàn rénshēng lǚtú, wǒmen zǒng zài búduàn xúnzhǎo. Xúnzhǎo lǐjiě zìjǐ de zhījǐ, xúnzhǎo ānfàng línghún de gǎngwān, gèng zài mímáng zhōng xúnzhǎo shēngmìng de jiàzhí yǔ yìyì. Jíbiàn qiánlù yúnwù liáorào, zhǐyào xīnzhōng shàng yǒu míngdēng, nà fèn zhízhuó de xúnzhǎo jiù yǒngyuǎn bú huì tíngxiē.
extended_reading_passages.en: On the long voyage of life, we are perpetually searching. Searching for a confidant who understands us, a haven to anchor our soul, and the meaning of existence amid confusion. Even if fog veils the path, as long as an inner lamp burns, this devoted seeking will never cease.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la prolongada travesía de la vida, andamos en constante búsqueda. Buscamos un alma afín que nos comprenda, un puerto donde reposar el espíritu y el sentido del existir en la incertidumbre. Aunque la bruma nuble el sendero, mientras arda una luz interior, jamás cesará el empeño de buscar.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 科学研究的本质，正是人类在浩瀚宇宙中不断寻找真理的崇高历程。面对无数次的实验失败与假设推翻，科学家们凭借严谨的逻辑与坚韧的毅力，在微观与宏观世界中寻找支配自然运转的终极法则。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Kēxué yánjiū de běnzhì, zhèng shì rénlèi zài hàohàn yǔzhòu zhōng búduàn xúnzhǎo zhēnlǐ de chónggāo lìchéng. Miànduì wúshù cì de shíyàn shībài yǔ jiǎshè tuīfān, kēxuéjiāmen píngjiè yánjǐn de luóji yǔ jiānrèn de yìlì, zài wēiguān yǔ hóngguān shìjiè zhōng xúnzhǎo zhīpèi zìrán yùnzhuǎn de zhōngjí fǎzé.
extended_reading_passages.en: The essence of scientific research is humanity's noble quest to seek truth in the vast cosmos. Confronting countless failed experiments and overturned hypotheses, scientists rely on rigorous logic and perseverance to search for fundamental laws governing nature.
extended_reading_passages.es: La esencia de la ciencia es la noble epopeya humana en pos de la verdad en el cosmos. Ante innumerables fracasos y desmentidos, los científicos se apoyan en la lógica rigurosa y la tenacidad para buscar en lo micro y lo macroscópico las leyes eternas que rigen el universo.

meanings_summary.en: tooth; teeth; dental structures
meanings_summary.es: diente; dientes; dentadura; piezas dentales

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: The sharp curved tusks (牙) combined with the neat rows of biting teeth in the mouth (齿) form human dental teeth (牙齿).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Los afilados colmillos (牙) combinados con la hilera de piezas dentales (齿) componen la dentadura (牙齿).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In classical Chinese anatomy, 牙 originally denoted large rear molars and animal tusks (象牙), while 齿 denoted the front incisors and human teeth. Together, 牙齿 forms the modern collective noun for human and animal dentition.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by dipping 3rd tone: 'yá chǐ' (35-214). Elevate the pitch on 'yá' before letting 'chǐ' dip into low vocal fry.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 牙齿 is the complete, standard noun for physical human or animal teeth, while 牙 alone is used in set compounds and idioms.

contrasts.analysis: 牙齿 is the formal and full anatomical noun (刷牙齿, 保护牙齿), whereas 牙 is a flexible monosyllable used in compound terms and daily verbs (刷牙, 牙医, 门牙).
牙齿 refers generally to ordinary teeth, whereas 象牙 designates the valuable, curved ivory tusks of an elephant.
牙齿 is biological dentition, whereas 齿轮 refers to mechanical gearwheels with interlocking cog teeth.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has two horizontal strokes connected by an S-like spine
Has a dot inside and different radical structure
Has 山 (mountain) at the top above 夕
Has 止 at top with a different bottom stroke
Has 上 and 卜 merged together

senses.definition_en: the hard, calcified structures rooted in the jaws used for biting and chewing food
senses.definition_es: estructuras duras y calcificadas en las mandíbulas para masticar y triturar los alimentos

example_sentences.hanzi: 养成早晚按时认真刷牙的好习惯，对于预防龋齿、保持牙齿洁白健康至关重要。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yǎngchéng zǎowǎn ànshí rènzhēn shuāyá de hǎo xíguàn, duìyú yùfáng qǔchǐ, bǎochí yáchǐ jiébái jiànkāng zhìguān zhòngyào.
example_sentences.en: Cultivating the habit of thoroughly brushing morning and evening is crucial for preventing cavities and keeping teeth white and healthy.
example_sentences.es: Adquirir el hábito de cepillarse con esmero mañana y noche resulta decisivo para prevenir la caries y conservar una dentadura blanca y sana.

example_sentences.hanzi: 摸象的盲人中有人摸到了大象坚硬锋利的牙齿，便断言大象长得如同一根光滑圆润的萝卜。
example_sentences.pinyin: Mō xiàng de mángrén zhōng yǒurén mōdào le dàxiàng jiānyìng fēnglì de yáchǐ, biàn duànyán dàxiàng zhǎng de rútóng yì gēn guānghuá yuánrùn de luóbo.
example_sentences.en: Among the blind men feeling the elephant, one touched its hard, sharp tusk, and promptly asserted that an elephant resembled a smooth, rounded radish.
example_sentences.es: Uno de los ciegos palpó los colmillos duros y afilados del paquidermo, y de inmediato aseveró que un elefante era idéntico a un rábano liso y cónico.

idioms.meaning_en: as close as lips and teeth; mutually interdependent
bite teeth tightly; grit teeth and endure hardship
if lips are gone teeth get cold; when one falls the other suffers
clever tongue and sharp teeth; eloquent and glib

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient bronze pictogram representing interlocking animal molars or curved ivory tusks with interlocking hooks.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: The curved, interlocking ivory tusk of a great wild beast hooks upward into view (牙).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: El colmillo curvado y entrelazado de una bestia milenaria que se curva con fuerza (牙).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from traditional 齒. Ancient oracle bone pictogram showing a gaping mouth with an exposed row of teeth.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Open the mouth wide to reveal a neat, sturdy row of biting white teeth (齿).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Abrir la boca de par en par para mostrar la hilera de dientes blancos y firmes (齿).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 洁白健康的牙齿不仅关乎个人的形象与自信，更直接影响着食物的消化吸收与身体健康。在日常生活中注重口腔卫生，定期进行牙科检查，是在岁月的流转中留住灿烂笑容与健康体魄的最好方式。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Jiébái jiànkāng de yáchǐ bùjǐn guānhū gèrén de xíngxiàng yǔ zìxìn, gèng zhíjiē yǐngxiǎng zhe shíwù de xiāohuà xīshōu yǔ shēntǐ jiànkāng. Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng zhùzhòng kǒuqiāng wèishēng, dìngqī jìnxíng yákē jiǎnchá, shì zài suìyuè de liúzhuǎn zhōng liúzhù cànlàn xiàoróng yǔ jiànkāng tǐpò de zuì hǎo fāngshì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Gleaming white, healthy teeth not only influence personal image and confidence, but directly impact digestion, nutrient absorption, and bodily health. Caring for oral hygiene and scheduling regular dental checkups is the best way to preserve bright smiles across passing years.
extended_reading_passages.es: Unos dientes blancos y sanos no solo realzan la imagen y la seguridad en uno mismo, sino que condicionan la digestión y el bienestar general. Cuidar la higiene bucal y acudir con regularidad al odontólogo es la mejor forma de conservar una sonrisa radiante a lo largo de los años.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在古生物学研究中，动物的牙齿化石是最能经受岁月侵蚀的珍贵地质凭证。通过微观结构分析与同位素测定，科学家能够从细小的古生物牙齿中精准推断出千万年前古气候变迁以及动物的演化谱系。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài gǔshēngwùxué yánjiū zhōng, dòngwù de yáchǐ huàshí shì zuì néng jīngshòu suìyuè qīnshí de zhēnguì dìzhì píngzhèng. Tōngguò wēiguān jiégòu fēnxī yǔ tóngwèisù cèdìng, kēxuéjiā nénggòu cóng xìxiǎo de gǔshēngwù yáchǐ zhōng jīngzhǔn tuīduàn chū qiānwàn nián qián gǔqìhòu biànqiān yǐjí dòngwù de yǎnhuà pǔxì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In paleontology, fossilized teeth are the most resilient geological evidence enduring millennia of erosion. Through microstructure and isotopic analysis, scientists can accurately deduce paleoclimate shifts and evolutionary lineages from ancient animal teeth.
extended_reading_passages.es: En paleontología, los dientes fosilizados son los testimonios geológicos más resistentes a la erosión del tiempo. Mediante el análisis microscópico e isotópico de estas piezas, los científicos infieren con exactitud cambios climáticos remotos y linajes evolutivos milenarios.

meanings_summary.en: to talk nonsense; to drivel; to speak rubbish without factual basis
meanings_summary.es: decir tonterías; hablar disparates; hablar sin ton ni son; desvariar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Speaking (说) in a wild, ungrounded, reckless fashion (胡) amounts to talking pure nonsense (胡说).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Hablar (说) de forma salvaje y sin fundamento (胡) equivale a decir disparates (胡说).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Han Chinese records, nomadic tribes from northern frontiers were termed 胡 (Hú). Because their languages and customs were unfamiliar to central plains dwellers, words prefixed with 胡 (胡说, 胡思乱想, 胡闹) came to designate speech or actions deemed chaotic, irregular, or absurd.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by high level 1st tone: 'hú shuō' (35-55). Glide up with 'hú', then produce a steady, unvarying high pitch on 'shuō'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 胡说 is an emphatic colloquial verb expressing that statements are completely fictitious, absurd, or groundless.

contrasts.analysis: Both mean talking nonsense, but 瞎说 emphasizes speaking without having seen the facts (blind guesswork), while 胡说 emphasizes speaking absurdly, outrageously, or offensively.
胡说 can be casual exaggeration or foolish talk, whereas 造谣 is a deliberate, malicious criminal act of manufacturing false rumors to mislead the public.
胡说 highlights that the words are bizarre, illogical, or unfounded nonsense, whereas 撒谎 specifically means telling a conscious, deliberate lie to deceive.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has water radical 氵 on the left
Has insect radical 虫 on the left
Has rice radical 米 on the left
Has 月 on the left and 兑 on the right
Has heart radical 忄 next to 兑

senses.definition_en: to utter statements that are completely untrue, absurd, groundless, or irrational
senses.definition_es: decir cosas absurdas, falsas, descabelladas o desprovistas de fundamento

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对毫无事实依据的网络谣言，当事人严正声明这完全是在胡说，并保留法律追责的权利。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì háowú shìshí yījù de wǎnglù yáoyán, dāngshìrén yánzhèng shēngmíng zhè wánquán shì zài húshuō, bìng bǎoliú fǎlǜ zhuīzé de quánlì.
example_sentences.en: Facing internet rumors with zero factual basis, the party solemn declared this was sheer nonsense, reserving the right to seek legal accountability.
example_sentences.es: Ante los infundados bulos propagados por internet, el afectado declaró con firmeza que se trataba de meras calumnias y se reservó el derecho a emprender acciones legales.

example_sentences.hanzi: 盲人们因各执己见而彼此斥责对方在胡说，这则寓言深刻揭示了主观片面性如何导致无谓的争吵。
example_sentences.pinyin: Mángrénmen yīn gèzhíjǐjiàn ér bǐcǐ chìzé duìfāng zài húshuō, zhè zé yùyán shēnkè jiēshì le zhǔguān piànmiànxìng rúhé dǎozhì wúwèi de zhēngchǎo.
example_sentences.en: Because each clung to their own view, the blind men rebuked each other for talking nonsense, revealing how one-sidedness incites futile discord.
example_sentences.es: Al aferrarse cada cual a su juicio, los ciegos se reprocharon hablar disparates, mostrando cómo la parcialidad subjetiva desata disputas estériles.

idioms.meaning_en: talk complete drivel; spout unadulterated nonsense
make irresponsible remarks; change words arbitrarily
talk at random; speak without restraint or facts
catch at wind and shadows; make groundless accusations

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictogram depicting the hanging dewlap of flesh beneath an ox's chin. Later borrowed phonetically for northern nomads, and figuratively for wild/reckless behavior.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An ancient (古) beast with a loose flap of flesh (月) beneath its neck babbles wildly (胡).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una criatura con piel colgante (月) y trazas arcaicas (古) que profiere sonidos desordenados (胡).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: speech radical 讠 combined with joyous mouth 兑, expressing exchanging thoughts through verbal words.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Exchanging words (讠) through a smiling, expressive mouth (兑) conveys human speech (说).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Palabras (讠) que brotan gozosas de una boca abierta (兑) para comunicar el pensamiento hablado (说).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在人际沟通中，无端的胡说与猜忌最容易摧毁彼此历经岁月建立的深厚信任。遇事多一份理性的求证，少一点轻信与传讹，用真诚的倾听化解误解，人与人之间的交往才能真正回归坦荡与温存。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài rénjì gōutōng zhōng, wúduān de húshuō yǔ cāijì zuì róngyì cuīhuǐ bǐcǐ lìjīng suìyuè jiànlì de shēnhòu xìnrèn. Yùshì duō yí fèn lǐxìng de qiúzhèng, shǎo yìdiǎn qīngxìn yǔ chuán'é, yòng zhēnchéng de qīngtīng huàjiě wùjiě, rén yǔ rén zhījiān de jiāowǎng cáinéng zhēnzhèng huíguī tǎndàng yǔ wēncún.
extended_reading_passages.en: In interpersonal communication, groundless rubbish and suspicion most easily destroy mutual trust built over years. Seeking rational verification, minimizing credulity, and dissolving misunderstandings through sincere listening allows relationships to remain candid.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el trato humano, los infundios y sospechas destruyen con facilidad la confianza forjada durante años. Aportar rigor racional, desterrar la ligereza y disolver malentendidos mediante la escucha leal devuelve a la convivencia su noble franqueza.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 融媒体时代的网络舆论场极其敏感脆弱，个别自媒体为了追求流量眼球往往信口胡说、扭曲事实真相。建立健全的互联网法治监管机制与事实核查体系，对于净化网络生态空间具有深远意义。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Róngméitǐ shídài de wǎnglù yúlùnchǎng jíqí mǐngǎn cuìruò, gèbié zìméitǐ wèile zhuīqiú liúliàng yǎnqiú wǎngwǎng xìnkǒu-húshuō, niǔqū shìshí zhēnxiàng. Jiànlì jiànquán de hùliánwǎng fǎzhì jiānguǎn jīzhì yǔ shìshí héchá tǐxì, duìyú jìnghuà wǎnglù shēngtài kōngjiān jùyǒu shēnyuǎn yìyì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In the convergence media era, online public opinion is fragile; certain creators spout drivel and distort truth merely to chase clicks. Establishing robust legal oversight and fact-checking systems carries profound significance for purifying cyberspace.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la era digital, la opinión pública en redes es vulnerable; creadores irresponsables vierten falsedades distorsionando la realidad por ganar clics. Erigir un marco regulatorio eficaz y mecanismos de verificación es crucial para sanear el ecosistema informativo en línea.

meanings_summary.en: tail (of animal, aircraft, comet); rear end; shadow or follower
meanings_summary.es: cola; rabo; extremidad posterior; parte final o rastro

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Animal hair trailing behind the body (尾) curves tenaciously like a snake (巴) to form an animal's expressive tail (尾巴).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: El pelaje tras el cuerpo (尾) que se curva como una sierpe (巴) da forma a la cola (尾巴).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The character 尾 dates back to ancient sacrificial dancers who tied animal tails to their hips. In modern Mandarin, 巴 functions as a phonetic nominalizing suffix (as in 嘴巴, 下巴, 尾巴). Figuratively, 尾巴 symbolizes concealable flaws or overconfidence (夹着尾巴做人, 尾巴翘上天).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone followed by neutral tone: 'wěi ba' (214-neutral). Pronounce 'wěi' fully, then deliver 'ba' with a light, unstressed release.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 尾巴 is the full colloquial and anatomical noun for an animal's tail or rear trail, whereas 尾 alone is used in compound morphemes.

contrasts.analysis: 尾巴 is the standalone spoken and written noun for a tail (狗尾巴), whereas 尾 is a bound morpheme in compounds and formal written phrases (车尾, 结尾, 年尾).
尾巴 is concrete and biological or figurative for a tracker, whereas 后端 is technical and spatial, used for engineering, software backends, or structural rear ends.
尾巴 describes a physical extension or tracker, while 痕迹 refers to left-behind impressions, footprints, or abstract traces of past events.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 比 inside 尸 instead of 毛
Has 水 (water) inside 尸 instead of 毛
Has 米 (rice) inside 尸 instead of 毛
Has 刀 above 巴 instead of standalone 巴
Has hand radical 扌 next to 巴

senses.definition_en: the flexible appendage extending from the rear of an animal's body; the posterior end of an object
senses.definition_es: apéndice articulado en la parte posterior del cuerpo de los animales; extremo trasero

senses.definition_en: a person tracking, tailing, or shadowing someone from behind
senses.definition_es: persona que sigue o vigila a otra de cerca; rastro o cola
senses.example_phrase: 甩掉尾巴 (shake off a tail/tracker)

example_sentences.hanzi: 小狗看见主人推门进屋，立刻兴奋地飞奔过来，欢快地不停摇晃着毛茸茸的尾巴。
example_sentences.pinyin: Xiǎogǒu kànjiàn zhǔrén tuīmén jìnwū, lìkè xīngfèn de fēibēn guòlái, huānkuài de bùtíng yáohuàng zhe máorōngrōng de wěiba.
example_sentences.en: Seeing its owner push open the door and enter, the puppy immediately bounded over excitedly, joyfully wagging its fluffy tail without stopping.
example_sentences.es: Al ver a su dueño abrir la puerta y entrar, el perrito corrió entusiasmado hacia él, moviendo sin cesar su peluda cola con alegría.

example_sentences.hanzi: 摸象的第四个盲人抓住了大象细长的尾巴，便十分确信地大喊大象其实就像一根粗糙的绳子。
example_sentences.pinyin: Mō xiàng de dì sì gè mángrén zhuāzhù le dàxiàng xìcháng de wěiba, biàn shífēn quèxìn de dàhǎn dàxiàng qíshí jiù xiàng yì gēn cūcāo de shéngzi.
example_sentences.en: The fourth blind man grabbed the elephant's slender tail and shouted with absolute certainty that an elephant was actually like a coarse rope.
example_sentences.es: El cuarto ciego asió la delgada cola del elefante y gritó con total convicción que el animal se asemejaba exactamente a una soga áspera.

collocations.en: with tail between one's legs; humbled

idioms.meaning_en: the tail is too big to wag; subordinate too strong to manage
tiger's head and snake's tail; start with a flourish but end weakly
hide head and expose tail; act slyly and deceitfully
fear head and fear tail; excessively timid and hesitant

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient oracle bone pictogram showing a human body 尸 wearing a long hairy tail 毛 hanging from behind.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: From behind the rear of the physical body (尸) hangs a long strand of animal fur (毛), forming a tail (尾).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Tras la silueta del cuerpo (尸) desciende un mechón de pelo y cerdas (毛), dibujando la cola (尾).

character_decomposition.meaning_en: cling to; eager; crust; tail suffix
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient bronze pictogram of a giant coiled python or serpent with its tail hooked upward.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A giant creeping serpent curves its scaly body and hooks its tail upward with tenacity (巴).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una serpiente gigante enrosca su cuerpo con el rabo curvado hacia lo alto con tenacidad (巴).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在广袤的大自然中，动物的尾巴具有极其奇妙的生理功能。鸟类的尾巴在翱翔中调节平衡，袋鼠的尾巴宛如强有力的第三条腿，而松鼠蓬松的尾巴则在凛冽寒冬中化作温暖的毛毯。大自然造物的精巧令人叹为观止。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài guǎngmào de dàzìrán zhōng, dòngwù de wěiba jùyǒu jíqí qímiào de shēnglǐ gōngnéng. Niǎolèi de wěiba zài áoxiáng zhōng tiáojié pínghéng, dàishǔ de wěiba wǎnrú qiángyǒulì de dì-sān tiáo tuǐ, ér sōngshǔ péngsōng de wěiba zé zài lǐnliè hándōng zhōng huàzuò wēnnuǎn de máotǎn. Dàzìrán zàowù de jīngqiǎo lìng rén tànwéiguānzhǐ.
extended_reading_passages.en: In vast nature, animal tails possess marvelous physiological adaptations. A bird's tail regulates balance during flight, a kangaroo's tail acts as a powerful third leg, and a squirrel's fluffy tail becomes a cozy blanket in winter. The ingenuity of creation is breathtaking.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la vasta naturaleza, las colas de los animales desempeñan admirables funciones biológicas. Las aves equilibran su vuelo con ellas, el canguro las usa como un tercer pie y la ardilla las convierte en mullida manta invernal. El prodigio de la creación animal colma de asombro.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在管理心理学中，“翘尾巴”常被用来警示团队在取得阶段性成绩后滋生的盲目自满。保持谦逊谨慎的清醒头脑，杜绝麻痹大意，才能在日趋激烈的市场竞争中行稳致远，避免重蹈虎头蛇尾的覆辙。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài guǎnlǐ xīnlǐxué zhōng, 'qiào wěiba' cháng bèi yònglái jǐngshì tuánduì zài qǔdé jiēduànxìng chéngjì hòu zīshēng de mángmù zìmǎn. Bǎochí qiānxùn jǐnshèn de qīngxǐng tóunǎo, dùjué mábì dàyì, cáinéng zài rìqū jīliè de shìchǎng jìngzhēng zhōng xíngwěn-zhìyuǎn, bìmǐan chóngdǎo hǔtóu-shéwěi de fùzhé.
extended_reading_passages.en: In management psychology, 'raising one's tail' warns against complacency following initial victories. Maintaining humble lucidity and rooting out carelessness allows an organization to advance steadily in fierce competition, avoiding the pitfall of beginning well but ending poorly.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la psicología directiva, la advertencia de no ufanarse previene la autocomplacencia tras un éxito inicial. Mantener la prudencia y la mente despierta permite navegar con paso firme en mercados voraces, evitando el descalabro de empezar con bríos y fenecer con desgana.

meanings_summary.en: rope; cord; string; twine; cordage
meanings_summary.es: cuerda; soga; cordel; maroma; lazo de cáñamo o fibra

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Twisted strands of durable fiber (绳) form the everyday household cord and rope (绳子).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Hebras de fibra trenzadas con firmeza (绳) forman la soga o cuerda cotidiana (绳子).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Chinese civilization prior to written characters, 结绳记事 (knotting cords to record transactions) was the primal mnemonic system. In carpentry, the ink-marker rope (墨绳) symbolized unbending moral standards and legal restraint (绳之以法).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by neutral tone: 'shéng zi' (35-neutral). Rise smoothly on 'shéng' and pronounce 'zi' with a light, clipped release.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 绳子 is the standard everyday noun for cord or rope made of braided fibers.

contrasts.analysis: 绳子 refers to thick, load-bearing braided ropes or cords, whereas 线 denotes thin, fine sewing thread, string, or electrical wire (缝衣线, 电线).
绳子 is generic and everyday, while 缆绳 refers specifically to heavy-duty industrial or maritime steel cables and mooring hawsers.
绳子 is colloquial and common (跳绳子, 绑绳子), while 绳索 is formal, technical, and literary, frequently used in mountaineering and rescue reports.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has insect radical 虫 on the left instead of 纟
Has water radical 氵 on the left instead of 纟
Has 色 on the right instead of 黾
Has 𢀖 on the right instead of 黾
Has 戋 on the right instead of 黾

senses.definition_en: a strong, thick cord made by twisting together strands of hemp, sisal, nylon, or other fibers
senses.definition_es: cuerda resistente fabricada retorciendo filamentos de cáñamo, nailon u otras fibras
senses.example_phrase: 系紧绳子 (tie the rope tightly)

example_sentences.hanzi: 登山队员将坚固的绳子牢牢系在崖壁的岩石扣上，确保下撤过程万无一失。
example_sentences.pinyin: Dēngshān duìyuán jiāng jiāngù de shéngzi láoláo jì zài yábì de yánshí kòu shàng, quèbǎo xiàchè guòchéng wànwú-yìshī.
example_sentences.en: The mountaineer tied the sturdy rope securely to the rock carabiner on the cliff face, ensuring flawless safety during the descent.
example_sentences.es: El alpinista aseguró la recia cuerda al mosquetón de roca en la pared del risco, garantizando la máxima seguridad durante el descenso.

example_sentences.hanzi: 摸到象尾巴的盲人断言大象不过是一根绳子，这种各执一词的武断正是狭隘认知的真实写照。
example_sentences.pinyin: Mōdào xiàng wěiba de mángrén duànyán dàxiàng búguò shì yì gēn shéngzi, zhè zhǒng gèzhíyìcí de wǔduàn zhèng shì xiá'ài rènzhī de zhēnshí xièzhào.
example_sentences.en: The blind man who touched the elephant's tail asserted an elephant was merely a rope; such dogmatic insistence is a true portrait of narrow cognition.
example_sentences.es: El ciego que palpó la cola del paquidermo afirmó que el elefante no era más que una soga; tal terquedad dogmática retrata fielmente las limitaciones de la mente estrecha.

idioms.meaning_en: rope saws through wood with persistent friction; perseverance wins
compass, rope, carpenter's square and chalk line; strict standards
tie knots in cords to record events (ancient mnemonic practice)
restrain by law; bring a criminal to justice

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: twisted silk threads 纟 combined with 黾, portraying thick cordage braided like sinuous amphibians.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Strands of strong woven silk (纟) braided with the tenacity of a water toad (黾) form an unbreakable rope (绳).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Hebras de seda resistente (纟) trenzadas con la tenacidad de un anfibio (黾) forjan una recia soga (绳).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient oracle bone pictogram of an infant waving arms with swaddled legs. Used universally as a nominalizing noun suffix.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An energetic young baby (子) waves its tiny arms happily above its swaddling blanket.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un infante despierto (子) mueve los bracitos con alegría sobre su pañal de abrigo.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 一根看似平凡的绳子，在劳动者的手中却能化作连接重物与希望的纽带。无论是在崇山峻岭间攀援，还是在田间地头捆扎丰收的麦穗，结实的绳子始终默默承受着巨大的拉力，见证着人类勤劳质朴的岁月。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Yì gēn kànsì píngfán de shéngzi, zài láodòngzhě de shǒuzhōng què néng huàzuò liánjiē zhòngwù yǔ xīwàng de niǔdài. Wúlùn shì zài chóngshān-jùnlǐng jiān pānyuán, háishì zài tiánjiān-dìtóu kǔnzā fēngshōu de màisuì, jiēshi de shéngzi shǐzhōng mòmò chéngshòu zhe jùdà de lālì, jiànzhèng zhe rénlèi qínláo zhìpǔ de suìyuè.
extended_reading_passages.en: A seemingly ordinary rope in the hands of laborers transforms into a bond linking heavy burdens and hope. Whether ascending rugged peaks or bundling golden wheat in autumn fields, the sturdy rope silently bears immense tension, witnessing human diligence.
extended_reading_passages.es: Una cuerda en apariencia modesta se convierte en manos de los trabajadores en lazo de esperanza y esfuerzo. Ya sea trepando riscos escarpados o atando gavillas doradas de trigo, la recia soga resiste en silencio la tensión, dando fe del fecundo quehacer humano.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: “绳锯木断，水滴石穿”，这句古老的格言借由柔软的绳子能锯断坚硬木料的自然现象，阐明了持之以恒的深刻哲理。只要锚定目标并日积月累地付出心血，哪怕微不足道的力量也能创造出令人惊叹的奇迹。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: 'Shéng jù mù duàn, shuǐ dī shí chuān', zhè jù gǔlǎo de gèyán jièyóu róuruǎn de shéngzi néng jùduàn jiānyìng mùliào de zìrán xiànxiàng, chǎnmíng le chízhīyǐhéng de shēnkè zhélǐ. Zhǐyào máodìng mùbiāo bìng rìjī-yuèlěi de fùchū xīnxuè, nǎpà wēibùzúdào de lìliàng yě néng chuàngzào chū lìngrén jīngtàn de qíjì.
extended_reading_passages.en: 'A rope saws through wood and dripping water penetrates stone'—this ancient proverb utilizes the phenomenon of soft cords sawing timber to demonstrate the power of perseverance. Anchoring goals and exerting continuous effort transforms minuscule forces into miracles.
extended_reading_passages.es: 'La cuerda corta el madero y la gota horada la piedra': esta sabia máxima se vale de la soga para ilustrar el poder de la perseverancia. Fijando un rumbo y aunando desvelos día tras día, las fuerzas en apariencia insignificantes acaban engendrando admirables portentos.

meanings_summary.en: flat; level; smooth; even; peaceful; equal; tied (score)
meanings_summary.es: plano; llano; liso; nivelado; pacífico; igual; empatado

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Balancing weight equally across a horizontal beam creates an even, calm, and perfectly flat surface (平).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Equilibrar los pesos en una balanza horizontal crea una superficie llana, equilibrada y en calma (平).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Chinese cosmology, 平 symbolizes harmony and equilibrium (天平, 和平). Physically it means flat terrain, socially it stands for justice and egalitarian fairness (公平, 平等), and psychologically it reflects a tranquil, unruffled mind (平心静气).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone 'píng' (35). The voice glides upward smoothly and evenly from the middle pitch to the high contour.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 平 conveys the fundamental absence of unevenness, tilt, friction, or mental agitation.

contrasts.analysis: 平 means flat and horizontal in spatial relief without slopes or hills (平坦), whereas 直 means straight without curves or bending (笔直).
平 describes a surface that has no bumps or grade changes (平整), while 滑 emphasizes sleek slipperiness with low surface friction (光滑).
平 highlights stillness, serenity, and emotional tranquility (心平), while 和 emphasizes social harmony, cordiality, and unity among differing factions (和谐).

look_alikes.distinction_note: Lacks the two slanted dots/strokes 八
Has 丷 above horizontal stroke and crosses down through line
Has grass radical 艹 above 平
Has speech radical 讠 next to 平
Has earth radical 土 next to 平

senses.definition_en: having a flat, level, smooth horizontal surface without bumps, slopes, or irregularities
senses.definition_es: que tiene una superficie horizontal lisa, sin desniveles, asperezas ni pendientes

senses.definition_en: peaceful; tranquil; calm; free from danger, turmoil, or anxiety
senses.definition_es: pacífico; sosegado; tranquilo; libre de peligro o zozobra

senses.definition_en: equal; on the same plane; to tie in a contest or match
senses.definition_es: igual; empatado; quedar en tablas
senses.example_phrase: 打成平局 (end in a draw)

example_sentences.hanzi: 经过市政工人的连续连夜抢修，门前坑洼不平的道路终于被修缮得既平整又宽敞。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò shìzhèng gōngrén de liánxù liányè qiǎngxiū, ménqián kēngwā-bùpíng de dàolù zhōngyú bèi xiūshàn de jì píngzhěng yòu kuānchǎng.
example_sentences.en: Following workers' continuous overnight repairs, the potholed road in front of our gate was finally restored to a flat, spacious condition.
example_sentences.es: Tras la continua labor nocturna de los operarios municipales, la calzada bacheada frente a casa quedó al fin lisa, nivelada y espaciosa.

example_sentences.hanzi: 摸到象身侧面的盲人摸到了平滑厚实的皮肤，便理直气壮地宣称大象明明就是一面平平整整的墙。
example_sentences.pinyin: Mōdào xiàng shēn cèmiàn de mángrén mōdào le pínghuá hòushí de pífū, biàn lǐzhí-qìzhuàng de xuānchēng dàxiàng míngmíng jiùshì yí miàn píngpíng-zhěngzhěng de qiáng.
example_sentences.en: The blind man who felt the flank of the elephant touched its flat, thick hide, and proclaimed with full conviction that an elephant was simply a flat wall.
example_sentences.es: El ciego que palpó el costado del paquidermo rozó su piel lisa y recia, y declaró con aplomo que el elefante era idéntico a una pared completamente plana.

collocations.en: tie a match; end in a draw

idioms.meaning_en: amiable and approachable; easy to get along with
calm winds and tranquil waves; serene and untroubled
calm and good-tempered; composed in mind and breath
ascend rapidly in one's career; skyrocket smoothly

character_decomposition.sound_component: 八 (bā, dividing equally to both sides)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient bronze pictogram of a balance beam or aquatic weed floating evenly across the water surface, dividing balance equally.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A horizontal level beam divides balance equally to both left and right (八), producing perfect flatness (平).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una barra horizontal equilibra la balanza hacia ambos lados (八), logrando un estado perfectamente llano y calmo (平).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 漫步在古城平整的青石板路上，雨后的空气中弥漫着泥土的清香。抛开城市的喧嚣与浮躁，静静注视着水面上泛起的微波，内心慢慢归于平淡与宁静。平平淡淡的寻常岁月，往往蕴藏着最动人的诗意。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Mànbù zài gǔchéng píngzhěng de qīngshíbǎn lù shàng, yǔ hòu de kōngqì zhōng mímàn zhe nítǔ de qīngxiāng. Pāokāi chéngshì de xuāoxiāo yǔ fúzào, jìngjìng zhùshì zhe shuǐmiàn shàng fànqǐ de wēibō, nèixīn mànmàn guīyú píngdàn yǔ níngjìng. Píngpíng-dàndàn de xúncháng suìyuè, wǎngwǎng yùncáng zhe zuì dòngrén de shīyì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Strolling on the flat bluestone paths of the ancient town, post-rain breezes carry the fragrance of earth. Cast aside urban tumult and gaze at ripples upon the water; inner calm settles into serene simplicity. The most ordinary life cradles poetry.
extended_reading_passages.es: Paseando sobre las losas llanas de la villa antigua, el aire tras la lluvia huele a tierra pura. Desechado el bullicio mundano, contemplar el suave oleaje devuelve al alma la calma y la sobriedad. La vida sencilla y apacible custodia la más honda poesía.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在构建现代法治社会的过程中，维护社会公平与司法正义是凝聚公众共识的坚固基石。唯有保证各项制度在阳光下运行，让每一位公民都能享有平等的发展机遇，才能推动国家治理体系迈向更高水平。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài gòujiàn xiàndài fǎzhì shèhuì de guòchéng zhōng, wéihù shèhuì gōngpíng yǔ sīfǎ zhèngyì shì níngjù gōngzhòng gòngshí de jiāngù jīshí. Wéiyǒu bǎozhèng gè xiàng zhìdù zài yángguāng xià yùnxíng, ràng měi yí wèi gōngmín dōu néng xiǎngyǒu píngděng de fāzhǎn jīyù, cáinéng tuīdòng guójiā zhìlǐ tǐxì màixiàng gèng gāo shuǐpíng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In constructing a rule-of-law society, safeguarding fairness and justice is the foundation for public consensus. Ensuring transparent institutions and equal development opportunities for all citizens elevates national governance to higher standards.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la consolidación del Estado de derecho, salvaguardar la equidad social y la justicia procesal constituye un pilar innegociable. Solo garantizando la transparencia institucional y la igualdad de oportunidades para cada ciudadano podrá elevarse la gobernanza a nuevas cotas.

meanings_summary.en: wall; vertical masonry structure; barrier; partition
meanings_summary.es: pared; muro; muralla; tabique; barrera arquitectónica

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Packing rammed earth (土) firmly around stored granaries creates a protective barrier and domestic wall (墙).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Apisonar tierra y barro (土) alrededor de las provisiones crea un muro protector inexpugnable (墙).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In traditional Chinese vernacular architecture, rammed-earth walls (夯土墙) sheltered courtyards (四合院) and delineated sacred domestic boundaries from external disorder. Walls also served defense (万里长城), symbolizing both physical security and cognitive barriers.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone 'qiáng' (35). The pitch ascends smoothly and clearly without wavering.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 墙 is the universal word for vertical dividing walls and boundary fences, concrete or metaphorical.

contrasts.analysis: 墙 is the common standalone noun for any indoor or outdoor wall, whereas 壁 is a formal morpheme often describing sheer precipices (绝壁) or interior lining surfaces (壁纸, 隔壁).
墙 is a solid opaque structural masonry mass, while 栏杆 is a waist-high open protective railing or balustrade.
墙 is a permanent architectural load-bearing or enclosing structure, whereas 屏风 is a lightweight movable decorative folding screen.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has grass radical 艹 above 啬
Lacks the earth radical 土 on the left
Has 𠃓 on the right instead of 啬
Has 方 on the right instead of 啬
Has 者 on the right instead of 啬

senses.definition_en: a vertical masonry or wooden structure enclosing or dividing an area of land or a building
senses.definition_es: estructura vertical de ladrillo, piedra o madera que delimita o sostiene un edificio

example_sentences.hanzi: 祖父在老院子的砖墙上种植了绿意盎然的爬山虎，夏天给整间屋子带来宜人的凉爽。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zǔfù zài lǎoyuànzi de zhuānqiáng shàng zhòngzhí le lǜyì-àngrán de páshānhǔ, xiàtiān gěi zhěng jiān wūzi dàilái yírén de liángshuǎng.
example_sentences.en: Grandfather planted lush green ivy along the old courtyard's brick wall, bringing pleasant coolness to the whole house in summer.
example_sentences.es: El abuelo plantó hiedra verde sobre el muro de ladrillo del viejo patio, refrescando gratamente toda la estancia en verano.

example_sentences.hanzi: 摸象寓言中那位摸到象身的盲人笃信大象是一堵坚不可摧的墙，生动折射出偏听偏信的认知迷局。
example_sentences.pinyin: Mō xiàng yùyán zhōng nà wèi mōdào xiàng shēn de mángrén dǔxìn dàxiàng shì yì dǔ jiānbùkěcuī de qiáng, shēngdòng zhéshè chū piāntīng-piānxìn de rènzhī míjú.
example_sentences.en: In the fable, the blind man who touched the body believed the elephant was an impregnable wall, reflecting the cognitive trap of partial impressions.
example_sentences.es: En la fábula, el ciego que rozó el cuerpo del animal juró que era un muro infranqueable, reflejando el laberinto cognitivo de juzgar por impresiones parciales.

collocations.en: scale or climb over a perimeter wall
flowers and plants in the corner of a wall

idioms.meaning_en: walls have ears; beware of eavesdroppers
bronze wall and iron bastion; an impenetrable defense
trouble originates from within one's own screen wall; internal strife
turn back only after hitting a brick wall; stubborn until blocked

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 墻/牆. Ancient pictogram of earthen soil 土 packed around granaries 啬 to protect harvests and domestic boundaries.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Rammed earth and clay (土) stacked high to guard stored grain inside granaries creates a solid wall (墙).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Tierra apisonada y arcilla (土) levantadas para proteger las reservas de grano forman un muro sólido (墙).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 斑驳古旧的青砖墙上，岁月的风雨雕刻出沧桑的痕迹。几株野草顽强地从墙缝中探出新绿，在微风中轻轻摇曳。这堵沉默的老墙宛如一位阅尽千帆的长者，在时光深处无声守候着历史的沧海桑田。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Bānbó gǔjiù de qīngzhuānqiáng shàng, suìyuè de fēngyǔ diāokè chū cāngsāng de hénjì. Jǐ zhū yěcǎo wánqiáng de cóng qiángfèng zhōng tànchū xīnlǜ, zài wēifēng zhōng qīngqīng yáoyè. Zhè dǔ chénmò de lǎoqiáng wǎnrú yí wèi yuèjìn-qiānfān de zhǎngzhě, zài shíguāng shēnchù wúshēng shǒuhòu zhe lìshǐ de cānghǎi-sāngtián.
extended_reading_passages.en: Upon mottled antique blue brick walls, passing years carved traces of vicissitude. Wild grasses poke tenaciously through mortar cracks, swaying gently in the breeze. This silent wall stands like an elder who has witnessed thousands of sails, silently cradling the epochal changes of history.
extended_reading_passages.es: Sobre el viejo muro de ladrillos azulados, el viento y la lluvia tallaron huellas de añoranza. Briznas de hierba silvestre asoman tercas entre las grietas mecidas por la brisa. Este añoso muro en silencio asemeja a un sabio anciano que custodia el fluir callado de los siglos.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在全球化深入发展的今天，国与国之间应当打破贸易壁垒与心理隔阂，多修沟通的桥梁，少筑排他的高墙。唯有坚持开放包容与合作共赢，才能凝聚应对全球性挑战的强大合力，共同开创人类美好的未来。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài quánqiúhuà shēnrù fāzhǎn de jīntiān, guó yǔ guó zhījiān yīngdāng dǎpò màoyì bìlěi yǔ xīnlǐ géhé, duō xiū gōutōng de qiáoliáng, shǎo zhù páitā de gāoqiáng. Wéiyǒu jiānchí kāifàng bāoróng yǔ hézuò gòngyíng, cáinéng níngjù yìngduì quánqiúxìng tiǎozhàn de qiángdà hélì, gòngtóng kāichuàng rénlèi měihǎo de wèilái.
extended_reading_passages.en: In today's interconnected global landscape, nations should dismantle trade barriers and psychological divides, building bridges of dialogue instead of exclusive high walls. Openness, inclusivity, and mutual benefit alone unite strength against planetary crises.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el mundo globalizado de hoy, los países han de derribar barreras arancelarias y muros de recelo psicológico, tendiendo puentes de entendimiento. Solo la apertura integradora y el beneficio compartido concitarán voluntades firmes para afrontar los retos globales y abrir un futuro venturoso.

meanings_summary.en: fan (handheld folding or round fan); device creating cool breezes
meanings_summary.es: abanico; pai-pai; abano; instrumento de mano para refrescarse

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A door flap (户) adorned with fluttering feathers (羽) creates the refreshing breeze of a summer fan (扇子).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Una batiente de puerta (户) guarnecida de plumas (羽) agita el aire fresco del abanico tradicional (扇子).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In classical Chinese literati culture, fans (折扇, 团扇) were not merely functional cooling tools, but canvas mediums for calligraphy, landscape painting, and poetry, carried as essential emblems of scholastic poise (文人雅士之信物).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone followed by neutral tone: 'shàn zi' (51-neutral). Articulate 'shàn' with crisp downward momentum and pronounce 'zi' lightly.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 扇子 is the standard handheld cooling implement, distinguished from mechanized electric fans.

contrasts.analysis: 扇子 is a manual, handheld fan made of bamboo, paper, or silk, whereas 电风扇 is an electrical motor-driven rotary appliance.
扇子 is the general umbrella noun, while 团扇 specifies a traditional circular, rigid silk fan favored by ancient palace ladies.
扇子 covers all fan typologies, whereas 折扇 refers specifically to the accordion-folding fan invented for portability.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has flesh radical 月 inside 户 instead of 羽
Has 方 inside 户 instead of 羽
Has 隹 (bird) inside 户 instead of 羽
Has 犬 (dog) inside 户 instead of 羽
Has 口 inside 户 instead of 羽

senses.definition_en: a handheld device made of paper, silk, bamboo, or feathers used to agitate the air and generate a cooling breeze
senses.definition_es: instrumento de mano de papel, seda, bambú o plumas para agitar el aire y refrescarse

example_sentences.hanzi: 盛夏的傍晚，老人们喜欢坐在弄堂的大槐树下，一边摇着蒲扇，一边惬意地闲话家常。
example_sentences.pinyin: Shèngxià de bàngwǎn, lǎorénmen xǐhuan zuò zài lòngtáng de dà huáishù xià, yìbiān yáo zhe púshàn, yìbiān qièyì de xiánhuà-jiācháng.
example_sentences.en: On midsummer evenings, elders like sitting beneath the alley's large locust tree, comfortably chatting about daily life while waving palm leaf fans.
example_sentences.es: Al atardecer en pleno estío, los ancianos gustan de sentarse bajo las acacias del callejón, charlando plácidamente de la vida cotidiana mientras agitan sus abanicos de palma.

example_sentences.hanzi: 摸象故事中摸到大象宽大耳朵的盲人，立刻斩钉截铁地大呼大象明明就是一把随风摇摆的扇子。
example_sentences.pinyin: Mō xiàng gùshì zhōng mōdào dàxiàng kuāndà ěrduo de mángrén, lìkè zhǎndīng-jiètiě de dàhū dàxiàng míngmíng jiùshì yì bǎ suífēng yáobǎi de shànzi.
example_sentences.en: In the fable, the blind man who touched the elephant's broad ear immediately shouted unequivocally that an elephant was simply a fan swaying in the wind.
example_sentences.es: En la fábula, el ciego que rozó las anchas orejas del elefante exclamó tajante que el animal era a todas luces un abanico que ondeaba al viento.

collocations.en: fold or put away a fan

idioms.meaning_en: feather fan and silk kerchief; poised, graceful demeanor of a strategist
a fan discarded in autumn breeze; neglected after outliving utility
wave a fan to enjoy the cool breeze
fan the flames; incite trouble and stir up discord

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogram combining door leaf 户 and wings/feathers 羽, representing a swinging leaf that beats breezes like birds' wings.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Under the door frame (户), feathered wings (羽) flutter back and forth to create a cooling handheld fan (扇).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Bajo el marco de la puerta (户), un haz de plumas (羽) se bate con suavidad para engendrar la brisa del abanico (扇).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Universal noun suffix designating everyday utensils and household objects.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A lively infant (子) waves its hands happily in the cool summer breeze.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un niño vivaz (子) mueve las manitas alegre al sentir la brisa del verano.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 一柄轻巧的竹骨折扇，不仅是夏日驱赶暑热的实用器物，更是承载文人雅趣的艺术珍品。名家在扇面上题诗作画，摇曳间清风徐来，散发着淡淡的墨香，在方寸之间尽显东方古典审美的从容与洒脱。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Yì bǐng qīngqiǎo de zhúgǔ zhéshàn, bùjǐn shì xiàrì qūgǎn shǔrè de shíyòng qìwù, gèng shì chéngzài wénrén yǎqù de yìshù zhēnpǐn. Míngjiā zài shànmiàn shàng tíshī-zuòhuà, yáoyè jiān qīngfēng xúlái, sànfà zhe dàndàn de mòxiāng, zài fāngcùn zhījiān jìnxiǎn dōngfāng gǔdiǎn shěnměi de cóngróng yǔ sǎtuō.
extended_reading_passages.en: A nimble bamboo folding fan is not merely a practical utensil dispelling summer heat, but an artistic treasure carrying literati poise. Master painters brush poetry and landscapes on its silk; waving it brings gentle breezes and ink fragrances, showing classical oriental aesthetics.
extended_reading_passages.es: Un grácil abanico plegable de varillas de bambú trasciende su utilidad para combatir el bochorno, erigiéndose en joya artística de la estética letrada. Maestros de la caligrafía ilustran sus varillajes, trayendo en cada vaivén aromas a tinta y la serena soltura del arte oriental.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在传统非物质文化遗产传承中，手工制扇工艺凝聚了选竹、排骨、糊面等数十道精细工序。年轻一代手艺人将现代极简设计融入古老扇艺，使历经千年的传统扇子在当代生活美学中重新焕发出蓬勃生机。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài chuántǒng fēiwùzhì wénhuà yíchǎn chuánchéng zhōng, shǒugōng zhìshàn gōngyì níngjù le xuǎnzhú, páigǔ, húmiàn děng shùshí dào jīngxì gōngxù. Niánqīng yídài shǒuyìrén jiāng xiàndài jíjiǎn shèjì róngrù gǔlǎo shànyì, shǐ lìjīng qiānnián de chuántǒng shànzi zài dāngdài shēnghuó měixué zhōng chóngxīn huànfā chū péngbó shēngjī.
extended_reading_passages.en: In intangible cultural heritage preservation, crafting artisanal fans crystallizes dozens of meticulous steps like selecting bamboo and mounting paper. Young artisans infuse minimalist modern designs, revitalizing thousand-year-old traditional fans in contemporary lifestyle aesthetics.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la salvaguardia del patrimonio inmaterial, la confección artesanal de abanicos condensa decenas de primorosas fases, desde la selección del bambú hasta el entelado. Nuevas generaciones de artífices fusionan diseño minimalista y tradición milenaria, insuflándoles renovada vitalidad.

meanings_summary.en: one-sided; unilateral; partial; biased; lacking comprehensive overview
meanings_summary.es: unilateral; parcial; sesgado; que atiende solo a una faceta; incompleto

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Gazing at only one sliced fragment (片) of a multifaceted surface (面) yields a narrow, one-sided perspective (片面).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Mirar únicamente una lámina aislada (片) de una superficie compleja (面) engendra un juicio unilateral (片面).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In dialectical Chinese philosophy (especially Mao's 《矛盾论》/ On Contradiction), 片面性 (one-sidedness) is contrasted against 全面性 (comprehensiveness). It reflects the cognitive hazard of evaluating problems from an isolated angle without grasping systemic dialectical connections.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dual falling 4th tones: 'piàn miàn' (51-51). Pronounce each syllable with firm, crisp descending pitch.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 片面 describes thinking or judgment that considers only one isolated angle while ignoring the organic whole.

contrasts.analysis: 片面 is viewing only one aspect (antonym), whereas 全面 means comprehensive, all-round, and thorough across every dimension.
片面 emphasizes incompleteness of perspective (lacking other sides), whereas 主观 emphasizes distortion by personal emotional bias and ego rather than objective facts.
片面 focuses on narrow horizontal scope (ignoring other facets), while 肤浅 refers to superficial vertical depth (failing to penetrate beneath the surface).

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 片 on the left and 卑 on the right
Has 片 on the left and 反 on the right
Has different stroke order and curved left swoop
Has vertical side strokes instead of enclosed box 面
Has 一 at top with 自/贝 structure below

senses.definition_en: considering only one side or aspect of an issue while neglecting the whole; unilateral; partial
senses.definition_es: que considera únicamente un aspecto o faceta de un problema descuidando el conjunto; parcial

example_sentences.hanzi: 仅凭片面的传言就对一个人的品行妄下定论，既不公平，也极易造成难以挽回的深深误解。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jǐn píng piànmiàn de chuányán jiù duì yí gè rén de pǐnxìng wàngxià dìnglùn, jì bù gōngpíng, yě jíyì zàochéng nányǐ wǎnhuí de shēnshēn wùjiě.
example_sentences.en: Jumping to conclusions regarding someone's moral character based merely on one-sided hearsay is both unfair and prone to irreversible misunderstandings.
example_sentences.es: Precipitarse a juzgar la rectitud moral de una persona fundándose en rumores unilaterales resulta tan injusto como proclive a forjar graves agravios.

example_sentences.hanzi: 《盲人摸象》之所以能成为千古传颂的哲学寓言，正是因为它生动讽刺了以片面认知替代客观整体的思维误区。
example_sentences.pinyin: 《Mángrén Mō Xiàng》 zhīsuǒyǐ néng chéngwéi qiāngǔ chuánsòng de zhéxué yùyán, zhèng shì yīnwèi tā shēngdòng fěngcì le yǐ piànmiàn rènzhī tìdài kèguān zhěngtǐ de sīwéi wùqū.
example_sentences.en: Why 'The Blind Men and the Elephant' has remained an immortal allegory is precisely because it vividly satirizes the fallacy of mistaking partial impressions for the objective whole.
example_sentences.es: El motivo de que la fábula de los ciegos y el elefante haya perdurado es su certera sátira contra el desatino cognitivo de suplantar la realidad integral por una visión sesgada.

idioms.meaning_en: blind men feeling an elephant; take a part for the whole
take a part for the whole; generalize from the particular
look at a leopard through a bamboo tube; narrow, limited view
sit in a well and gaze at the sky; narrow-mindedness

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 片 (half of a split tree trunk 木)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictogram representing the right half of a split log of timber (木 split vertically into 爿 on the left and 片 on the right).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A tree trunk split cleanly down the center leaves a thin, single side of sliced wood (片).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un tronco de leña hendido por el eje longitudinal deja al descubierto una lámina parcial de madera (片).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 面 (human countenance with eyes framed by outline)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient bronze pictogram showing the outline of a human head and face enclosing the central eye 目.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An outlined profile framing the central eye represents a single visible surface and face (面).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: El contorno de la cabeza humana que enmarca el ojo representa un semblante y una superficie visible (面).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 世界上许多纷争与偏见，往往源于人们看问题时的片面与固执。每个人都习惯于站在自己的狭窄视角评判他人，将局部现象误当作全貌。唯有学会换位思考，跳出自我认知的局限，我们才能真正走向理智与宽容。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Shìjiè shàng xǔduō fēnzhēng yǔ piānjiàn, wǎngwǎng yuányú rénmen kàn wèntí shí de piànmiàn yǔ gùzhí. Měi gè rén dōu xíguàn yú zhàn zài zìjǐ de xiázhǎi shìjiǎo píngpàn tārén, jiāng júbù xiànxiàng wù dàngzuò quánmào. Wéiyǒu xuéhuì huànwèi-sīkǎo, tiàochū zìwǒ rènzhī de júxiàn, wǒmen cáinéng zhēnzhèng zǒuxiàng lǐzhì yǔ kuānróng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Many disputes and prejudices in the world stem from one-sidedness and stubbornness when evaluating issues. People habitually judge others from narrow perspectives, confusing localized details with reality. Empathy and stepping outside ego limits foster sanity and tolerance.
extended_reading_passages.es: Gran parte de las disputas nacen de juicios sesgados y obstinados. Las personas tienden a juzgar a los demás desde su propia atalaya, tomando la parte por el todo. Solo aprendiendo a ponerse en el lugar del prójimo y trascendiendo prejuicios se avanza hacia la madurez y la concordia.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在制定宏观公共政策时，必须坚决摒弃片面追求单一经济指标的政绩观。只有统筹兼顾经济增长、生态保护、民生福祉与社会公平等多重维度，才能实现经济社会的全面协调与永续健康发展。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài zhìdìng hóngguān gōnggòng zhèngcè shí, bìxū jiānjué bìngqì piànmiàn zhuīqiú dānyī jīngjì zhǐbiāo de zhèngjìguān. Zhǐyǒu tǒngchóu-jiāngù jīngjì zēngzhǎng, shēngtài bǎohù, mínshēng fúzhǐ yǔ shèhuì gōngpíng děng duōchóng wéidù, cáinéng shíxiàn jīngjì shèhuì de quánmiàn xiétóng yǔ yǒngxù jiànkāng fāzhǎn.
extended_reading_passages.en: In formulating public policies, one must firmly abandon the one-sided pursuit of isolated economic indices. Only by balancing economic growth, ecological preservation, public welfare, and equity can comprehensive, sustainable development be achieved.
extended_reading_passages.es: Al trazar políticas públicas, es imperativo desterrar la búsqueda unilateral de índices puramente cuantitativos. Solo conjugando el crecimiento económico, la preservación ecológica, el bienestar ciudadano y la equidad social se alcanzará un progreso integral y perdurable.

meanings_summary.en: conclusion; final verdict; outcome; logical deduction drawn from premises
meanings_summary.es: conclusión; veredicto final; deducción lógica; dictamen razonado

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Tying together all the loose threads (结) of a reasoned discourse (论) yields the final logical conclusion (结论).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Atar los cabos sueltos (结) de una argumentación meditada (论) conduce a la conclusión final (结论).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In classical epistemology, 结 represents the solid knot tying together disparate threads of evidence, while 论 represents systematic discourse and debate. Hence 结论 is not an arbitrary opinion, but the bound fruit of exhaustive inquiry.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by falling 4th tone: 'jié lùn' (35-51). Lift the vocal pitch smoothly on 'jié' before a sharp, decisive downward strike on 'lùn'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 结论 denotes a deductive finding or verdict arrived at after systematic inquiry or logical argumentation.

contrasts.analysis: 结论 is a rational intellectual judgment or deduction reached through analysis, whereas 结果 is the concrete physical or situational aftermath brought about by an event.
结论 is a cognitive finding about truth or reality (what is true), whereas 决定 is an executive choice or commitment to future action (what to do).
结论 is the reasoned end-point of an investigation, while 观点 is an individual's ongoing perspective, stance, or viewpoint.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has water radical 氵 on the left instead of 纟
Has speech radical 讠 on the left instead of 纟
Has vehicle radical 车 on the left instead of 讠
Has person radical 亻 on the left instead of 讠
Has water radical 氵 on the left instead of 讠

senses.definition_en: a final judgment, verdict, or deduction reached after reasoning, investigation, or experimentation
senses.definition_es: juicio final, dictamen o deducción razonada a la que se llega tras indagar, deliberar o investigar

example_sentences.hanzi: 经过数月严密细致的对照实验，科研小组终于得出了令人信服的实验结论。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò shù yuè yánmì xìzhì de duìzhào shíyàn, kēyán xiǎozǔ zhōngyú déchū le lìngrén xìnfú de shíyàn jiélùn.
example_sentences.en: After months of rigorous and meticulous controlled trials, the research team finally reached a compelling experimental conclusion.
example_sentences.es: Tras meses de minuciosos y rigurosos ensayos de control, el equipo científico alcanzó al fin una conclusión experimental convincente.

example_sentences.hanzi: 盲人们摸到大象身体的不同部位便匆忙下结论，结果谁的答案都不准确，这启示我们调查研究切不可仓促武断。
example_sentences.pinyin: Mángrénmen mōdào dàxiàng shēntǐ de bùtóng bùwèi biàn cōngmáng xià jiélùn, jiéguǒ shuí de dá'àn dōu bù zhǔnquè, zhè qǐshì wǒmen diàochá-yánjiū qiè bùkě cāngcù wǔduàn.
example_sentences.en: The blind men rushed to conclusions after touching different parts of the elephant, with none being accurate; this reminds us that investigations must never be hasty or dogmatic.
example_sentences.es: Los ciegos extrajeron conclusiones apresuradas tras palpar partes distintas del animal, errando todos; ello enseña que ninguna indagación debe ser precipitada ni dogmática.

collocations.en: jump to or pass a conclusion

idioms.meaning_en: pass final verdict on a person's life only after the coffin lid is sealed
final judgment is made after death
groundless statement; unfounded opinion
long-winded speech or writing; lengthy harangue

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: silk thread 纟 tied into an auspicious knot 吉, signifying sealing, binding, or bearing firm fruit.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Weaving strong silk threads (纟) into an auspicious, unbreakable knot (吉) binds the final outcome (结).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Trenzar hebras de seda (纟) en un lazo de buena ventura (吉) anuda y sella el resultado definitivo (结).

character_decomposition.sound_component: 仑 (lún, bamboo scrolls bound in logical order)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 論. Words 讠 deliberating upon bamboo tablets bound in orderly scrolls 仑, denoting reasoned discourse.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Articulating spoken words (讠) according to an organized scroll of logic (仑) produces rational discourse (论).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Pronunciar palabras (讠) ateniéndose a un rollo ordenado de argumentos (仑) da vida al razonamiento (论).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在探求真理的道路上，得出科学的结论从来都不是轻而易举的事。真正的智者懂得在证据不足时克制断言的冲动，以谦逊严谨的态度面对复杂事物。经得起历史检验的真知灼见，往往孕育在长久的审慎与求证之中。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài tànqiú zhēnlǐ de dàolù shàng, déchū kēxué de jiélùn cónglái dōu bùshì qīng'éryǐjǔ de shì. Zhēnzhèng de zhìzhě dǒngdé zài zhèngjù bùzú shí kèzhì duànyán de chōngdòng, yǐ qiānxùn yánjǐn de tàidù miànduì fùzá shìwù. Jīngdeqǐ lìshǐ jiǎnyàn de zhēnzhī-zhuójiàn, wǎngwǎng yùnyù zài chángjiǔ de shěnshèn yǔ qiúzhèng zhīzhōng.
extended_reading_passages.en: On the path of seeking truth, arriving at scientific conclusions is never trivial. True sages restrain the impulse to assert when evidence is incomplete, facing complexity with humility. Insight that weathers time is nurtured in prolonged prudence.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la búsqueda de la verdad, alcanzar una conclusión científica jamás es tarea baladí. El auténtico sabio contiene el impulso de juzgar cuando faltan pruebas y afronta lo complejo con mesura. Las ideas que superan la prueba del tiempo se forjan en la paciente verificación.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 学术界关于历史事件的定论往往需要经历多代学者的反复考辨与实证补充。随着新出土文物的重见天日，以往看似无懈可击的历史结论有时会被修正，这恰恰展现了人文科学自我革新与无限逼近真相的严谨魅力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xuéshùjiè guānyú lìshǐ shìjiàn de dìnglùn wǎngwǎng xūyào jīnglì duō dài xuézhě de fǎnfù kǎobiàn yǔ shízèng bǔchōng. Suízhe xīn chūtǔ wénwù de chóngjiàn-tiānrì, yǐwǎng kànsì wúxièkějī de lìshǐ jiélùn yǒushí huì bèi xiūzhèng, zhè qiàqià zhǎnxiàn le rénwén kēxué zìwǒ géxīn yǔ wúxiàn bījìn zhēnxiàng de yánjǐn mèilì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Final academic verdicts on history demand generations of verification. As ununearthed artifacts see light, seemingly unassailable conclusions are revised, illustrating the rigorous charm of the humanities constantly drawing nearer to truth.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los dictámenes historiográficos definitivos exigen generaciones de cotejo empírico. Al desenterrarse nuevos vestigios, conclusiones antaño incuestionables se revisan, revelando la admirable vocación de las humanidades de renovarse y aproximarse a la verdad objetiva.

meanings_summary.en: general; high-ranking military commander; to check (in chess); to put someone on the spot
meanings_summary.es: general; alto mando militar; dar jaque (ajedrez); poner en aprietos

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: An authoritative commander holding the battle baton (将) directing a mighty armored army (军) serves as a commanding general (将军).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un noble caudillo que empuña el bastón de mando (将) al frente de un aguerrido ejército (军) es un general (将军).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Chinese statecraft, 将军 (literally 'leader of the army') was the supreme martial post appointed by the emperor to defend the realm. Renowned generals like Li Guang (李广) symbolized consummate martial prowess, unflinching focus, and stoic loyalty.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dual high level 1st tones: 'jiāng jūn' (55-55). Maintain a clear, steady, elevated pitch across both syllables without falling.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 将军 is the prestigious title and rank of an army's top commanding officer, distinct from ordinary commanders or ministers.

contrasts.analysis: 将军 is the top commanding general devising battle strategies, whereas 士兵 are the frontline enlisted troops executing combat tactics.
军官 is a broad administrative title covering all commissioned officers (lieutenants, captains, colonels), while 将军 is specifically a flag-rank general.
元帅 is the supreme marshal overseeing multiple field armies and national theaters, higher than a single divisional or corps 将军.

Has 水 (water) at the bottom instead of 寸
Has 酉 (wine jar) at the bottom instead of 寸

senses.definition_en: a high-ranking military officer who commands an army or major armed division
senses.definition_es: oficial superior que ostenta el mando supremo de un ejército o división militar

senses.definition_en: to deliver a check in chess (xiangqi); figuratively to challenge or put someone in an embarrassing predicament
senses.definition_es: dar jaque en el ajedrez; figuradamente poner a alguien en un aprieto dialéctico
senses.example_phrase: 将了他一军 (put him on the spot)

example_sentences.hanzi: 汉代著名将军李广不仅射箭技艺出神入化，更以爱兵如子、赏罚分明的崇高军纪深受士兵爱戴。
example_sentences.pinyin: Hàndài zhùmíng jiāngjūn Lǐ Guǎng bùjǐn shèjiàn jìyì chūshén-rùhuà, gèng yǐ àibīng-rúzǐ, shǎngfá-fēnmíng de chónggāo jūnjì shēnshòu shìbīng àidài.
example_sentences.en: The famous Han general Li Guang not only possessed godlike archery skills, but was deeply beloved by troops for treating soldiers like sons with clear discipline.
example_sentences.es: El ilustre general Li Guang de la dinastía Han dominaba el tiro con arco y era venerado por sus soldados gracias a su disciplina recta y su cariño paternal hacia la tropa.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在复杂的棋局对弈中，老棋手凭借敏锐的战场直觉走出一记妙招，瞬间反客为主将军成功。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài fùzá de qíjú duìyì zhōng, lǎo qíshǒu píngjiè mǐnruì de zhànchǎng zhíjué zǒuchū yí jì miàozhāo, shùnjiān fǎnkè-wéizhǔ jiāngjūn chénggōng.
example_sentences.en: In the complex chess match, the veteran player made a brilliant move with sharp battlefield intuition, instantly turning the tables to deliver check.
example_sentences.es: En la reñida partida de ajedrez, el veterano jugador ejecutó una jugada magistral con agudo instinto bélico, invirtiendo la iniciativa y dando jaque con éxito.

collocations.en: the Flying General (epithet of Li Guang)

idioms.meaning_en: a defeated general; a vanquished commander
remnant troops and defeated commanders; shattered remnants

idioms.pinyin: yǒng jiàng shǒu xià wú ruò bīng
idioms.meaning_en: under a brave general there are no cowardly soldiers
deploy troops and dispatch generals; mobilize resources

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 將. Ancient bronze pictogram of a commander's hand 寸 offering sacrificial meat 丬 before marching into battle.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An authoritative hand (寸) raises the ceremonial military baton beside the troop muster post (丬) to command as a general (将).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una mano firme (寸) empuña el estandarte de mando junto al poste de reunión (丬) para liderar las tropas como general (将).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 軍. Ancient pictogram showing a circle of war chariots 车 bivouacked beneath camp covers 冖 to form a fortification.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: War chariots (车) circled securely beneath an encampment canopy (冖) assemble a mighty military army (军).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Carros de combate (车) agrupados en orden defensivo bajo la lona del campamento (冖) forjan un ejército (军).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 飞将军李广夜巡山林，见草丛深处有白虎蹲伏，便引弓发箭一击即中。次日清晨前去查验，才惊觉所中之物并非猛虎，而是一尊被利箭深深贯穿的巨石。将军纯一不杂的专注力，成就了传颂千古的传奇佳话。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Fēijiāngjūn Lǐ Guǎng yèxún shānlín, jiàn cǎocóng shēnchù yǒu báihǔ dūnfú, biàn yǐngōng-fājiàn yījī-jízhòng. Cìrì qīngchén qiánqù cháyàn, cái jīngjué suǒzhòng zhī wù bìng fēi měnghǔ, érshì yì zūn bèi lìjiàn shēnshēn guànchuān de jùshí. Jiāngjūn chúnyī-bùzá de zhuānzhùlì, chéngjiù le chuánsòng qiāngǔ de chuánqí jiāhuà.
extended_reading_passages.en: Patroling mountains by night, Flying General Li Guang saw a tiger crouching in the grass and drew his bow, striking true. At dawn, inspection revealed not a beast, but an arrow buried deep in solid rock. The general's absolute focus birthed an immortal legend.
extended_reading_passages.es: En patrulla nocturna, el general Li Guang vio un tigre agazapado en la maleza y disparó su arco con certera puntería. Al alba descubrió que no era una fiera, sino una roca atravesada por la flecha. La inquebrantable concentración del general forjó una leyenda inmortal.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代国防与联合指挥体系中，将军的战略眼光与跨域协同能力是夺取胜利的决定性因素。面对瞬息万变的多维电磁与太空态势，现代高级将领必须兼备前沿科技素养与深邃的军事哲学，方能运筹帷幄之中。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài guófáng yǔ liánhé zhǐhuī tǐxì zhōng, jiāngjūn de zhànlüè yǎnguāng yǔ kuàyù xiétóng nénglì shì duóqǔ shènglì de juédìngxìng yīnsù. Miànduì shùnxī-wànbiàn de duōwéi diàncí yǔ tàikōng tàishì, xiàndài gāojí jiànglǐng bìxū jiānbèi qiányán kējì sùyǎng yǔ shēnsù de jūnshì zhélǐ, fāng néng yùnchóu-wéiwò zhīzhōng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In modern joint command systems, a general's strategic vision and cross-domain synergy decide victory. Facing volatile multi-dimensional electromagnetic and space scenarios, flag officers must blend cutting-edge technological literacy with deep military philosophy.
extended_reading_passages.es: En los sistemas de mando conjunto contemporáneos, la visión estratégica del general y su capacidad de coordinación multidominio deciden la victoria. Ante la volatilidad cibernética y espacial, los altos mandos deben aunar pericia tecnológica y hondura doctrinal para triunfar.

meanings_summary.en: to be good at; to be adept in; to excel in; to be skilled at
meanings_summary.es: ser bueno en; ser diestro en; destacar por su habilidad; ser hábil en

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Possessing virtue and excellence (善) in relation to (于) a craft means you are thoroughly adept in it (善于).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Reunir excelencia y pericia (善) con respecto a (于) una disciplina significa ser diestro en ella (善于).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In classical Chinese grammar, 于 is a versatile preposition indicating location, direction, or comparison. Combining it with 善 (moral excellence and technical mastery) yields the formal verbal predicate 善于, synonymous with 'excelling at'.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone followed by rising 2nd tone: 'shàn yú' (51-35). Drop firmly on 'shàn', then glide upward melodiously on 'yú'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 善于 is a formal, dignified verb followed by a verbal action phrase, expressing high competence or disposition.

contrasts.analysis: 善于 is commonly followed by behavioral or cognitive actions (善于思考, 善于观察), whereas 擅长 often takes concrete skills, academic subjects, or sports disciplines (擅长书法, 擅长游泳).
善于 denotes competence and aptitude (being good at), while 习惯于 denotes acquired behavioral routine without implying skill (being used to).
善于 indicates skillful proficiency, while 精通 conveys complete, authoritative mastery of an entire academic field or technology.

Has 吉 above 丷 and 口

Has 龴 at top above 亅

senses.definition_en: having high proficiency, natural talent, or developed competence in doing something
senses.definition_es: tener gran destreza, inclinación o pericia para realizar una actividad con solvencia

example_sentences.hanzi: 李广将军善于骑射，每次拉弓射箭都能全神贯注，因此在军中赢得了神射手的美誉。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Guǎng jiāngjūn shànyú qíshè, měi cì lāgōng-shèjiàn dōu néng quánshén-guànzhù, yīncǐ zài jūnzhōng yíngdé le shénshèshǒu de měiyù.
example_sentences.en: General Li Guang was adept at riding and archery, concentrating fully whenever drawing his bow, thus earning renown as a master archer in the army.
example_sentences.es: El general Li Guang era diestro en la equitación y el tiro con arco; al templar su arco concentraba todo su ser, ganándose fama de arquero prodigioso en el ejército.

example_sentences.hanzi: 卓越的企业领导者往往善于倾听来自基层的建设性意见，并能在危机中化被动为主动。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhuóyuè de qǐyè lǐngdǎozhě wǎngwǎng shànyú qīngtīng láizì jīcéng de jiànshèxìng yìjiàn, bìng néng zài wēijī zhōng huà bèidòng wéi zhǔdòng.
example_sentences.en: Outstanding business leaders are often adept at listening to constructive grassroots input, turning passivity into initiative during crises.
example_sentences.es: Los líderes empresariales preclaros suelen ser hábiles en escuchar las propuestas constructivas de sus bases, sabiendo convertir la adversidad en iniciativa fecunda.

collocations.en: good at rallying and uniting others

idioms.meaning_en: leave the matter at that willingly (usually in negative)
start well and finish well; see things through to the end
resourceful and decisive; quick to make sound judgments
choose what is good and follow it; adopt best practices

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient bronze pictogram of an auspicious sheep 羊 flanked by words of praise 言, signifying moral goodness and refined competence.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An auspicious sheep (羊) whose praises are proclaimed with wise words (口) embodies moral virtue and excellence (善).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una oveja propicia (羊) ensalzada con palabras benévolas (口) encarna la virtud moral y la alta pericia (善).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 於. Originally depicted a soaring bird or musical breath rising effortlessly outward.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A hook (亅) curves smoothly upward through two horizontal planes (二) to direct movement toward a destination (于).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un gancho fluido (亅) asciende cruzando dos planos (二) para orientar el movimiento hacia un fin (于).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 真正有智慧的人，往往善于在喧嚣的日常中保持内心的清明。他们善于倾听他人的心声，善于在逆境中发现转机。不被浮名虚利所累，在从容与豁达中体味生活的真谛，这才是立身处世的大智慧。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng yǒu zhìhuì de rén, wǎngwǎng shànyú zài xuāoxiāo de rìcháng zhōng bǎochí nèixīn de qīngmíng. Tāmen shànyú qīngtīng tārén de xīnshēng, shànyú zài nìjìng zhōng fāxiàn zhuǎnjī. Bú bèi fúmíng-xūlì suǒ lèi, zài cóngróng yǔ huòdá zhōng tǐwèi shēnghuó de zhēndì, zhè cái shì lìshēn-chǔshì de dà zhìhuì.
extended_reading_passages.en: People of genuine wisdom are adept at preserving inner clarity amid bustling daily routines. They excel at listening to others' hearts and discovering opportunities in adversity. Unburdened by vain fame, savoring truth in composure is wisdom.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los sabios auténticos destacan por conservar la serenidad del alma entre el ruido cotidiano. Son diestros en escuchar el sentir ajeno y en hallar salidas a la adversidad. Libres de vanas ambiciones, saborean la vida con templanza y nobleza.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在知识迭代日益加速的数字时代，青年科技工作者唯有善于吸收跨学科前沿成果，善于在交叉融合中激发原创灵感，才能突破传统思维定式，为攻克国家关键核心技术难题贡献青年力量。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài zhīshi diédài rìyì jiāsù de shùzì shídài, qīngnián kējì gōngzuòzhě wéiyǒu shànyú xīshōu kuà-xuékē qiányán chéngguǒ, shànyú zài jiāochā rónghé zhōng jīfā yuánchuàng línggǎn, cáinéng tūpò chuántǒng sīwéi dìngshì, wèi gōngkè guójiā guānjiàn héxīn jìshù nándí gòngxiàn qīngnián lìliàng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In a digital era of rapid knowledge iteration, young technologists must excel at absorbing interdisciplinary frontiers and sparking original inspiration through convergence, breaking dogmas to solve critical technological bottlenecks.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la era digital, los jóvenes investigadores deben ser hábiles para asimilar saberes interdisciplinarios y desatar su creatividad en la convergencia científica, quebrando inercias para resolver con éxito los nudos tecnológicos del país.

meanings_summary.en: to call; to name; to praise; to state or claim; to weigh
meanings_summary.es: llamar; denominar; alabar; proclamar o declarar; pesar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Weighing a bundle of golden grain (禾) upon a scale allows you to accurately assess its merit, praise it, and give it a name (称).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Pesar una gavilla de grano (禾) en la balanza permite calcular su mérito, alabarlo y darle un justo nombre (称).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient agriculture, weighing grain (禾) on a steelyard was the basis of fair trade and taxation. From calculating physical weight (秤重), 称 evolved into moral appraisal (称许, 称赞), giving social titles (称号), and naming things (称谓).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone 'chēng' (55) for verbs of naming, praising, and weighing. (Note 4th tone 'chèn' in idioms like 称心如意).

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 称 functions as a formal verb for naming/calling a person or thing by a title, or praising their merit.

contrasts.analysis: 叫 is the everyday colloquial verb for calling someone by name (叫什么名字), whereas 称 is formal, literary, and polite, often used for official designations and honorifics (被称为, 尊称).
称 (in 称赞) is dignified and formal public commendation, while 夸 is casual oral praise or flattery (夸奖, 夸夸其谈).
称赞 expresses admiration and acclaim for an achievement, whereas 赞成 means agreeing with or voting in favor of a proposal.
