senses.definition_en: to call, name, or address someone or something by a particular title or designation
senses.definition_es: llamar, denominar o designar a alguien o algo con un apelativo o título

senses.definition_en: to praise, commend, or extol laudable achievements or qualities
senses.definition_es: elogiar, encomiar o alabar cualidades o hazañas
senses.example_phrase: 称赞他的勇敢 (praise his courage)

senses.definition_en: to weigh an object with a scale or balance (also pronounced chèng in noun contexts)
senses.definition_es: pesar un objeto con una balanza o báscula

example_sentences.hanzi: 李广将军英勇善战、箭无虚发，匈奴军队闻风丧胆，纷纷尊称他为汉朝的飞将军。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Guǎng jiāngjūn yīngyǒng shànzhàn, jiànwúxūfā, Xiōngnú jūnduì wénfēng-sàngdǎn, fēnfēn zūnchēng tā wéi Hàncháo de Fēijiāngjūn.
example_sentences.en: General Li Guang was brave and skilled in battle, never missing a shot; terrified, Xiongnu troops respectfully called him the Flying General of Han.
example_sentences.es: El general Li Guang era valeroso y certero; sus enemigos, sobrecogidos de pavor, lo llamaban respetuosamente el General Volador de la dinastía Han.

example_sentences.hanzi: 这项具有里程碑意义的科学突破被国际学术界广泛称赞为当代材料科学领域的重大飞跃。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhè xiàng jùyǒu lǐchéngbēi yìyì de kēxué tūpò bèi guójì xuéshùjiè guǎnfàn chēngzàn wéi dāngdài cáiliào kēxué lǐngyù de zhòngdà fēiyuè.
example_sentences.en: This landmark scientific breakthrough was widely praised by the international academic community as a major leap in contemporary materials science.
example_sentences.es: Este hito científico fue unánimemente elogiado por la comunidad académica internacional como un avance formidable en la ciencia de materiales.

collocations.en: weigh the weight on a scale

idioms.meaning_en: gratify one's heart and fulfill desires; thoroughly satisfying
call each other brothers; on intimate, chummy terms
clap hands and rejoice; applaud with satisfaction
click one's tongue in unceasing admiration

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 稱. Ancient bronze pictogram of a hand holding up a steelyard balance to weigh harvested grain 禾, assessing value.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Holding up a bundle of harvested grain (禾) on a balance scale to measure its true weight and proclaim its value (称).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Sostener una gavilla de grano (禾) sobre la balanza para comprobar su peso exacto y proclamar su valía (称).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在浩瀚的中华历史长卷中，无数为国为民奋勇拼搏的仁人志士被后世广为传颂。他们不仅赢得了当世百姓由衷的称赞，更被尊称为民族的脊梁，其高尚品格宛如璀璨星辰，在岁月的长河中永远熠熠生辉。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài hàohàn de Zhōnghuá lìshǐ chángjuàn zhōng, wúshù wèi guó wèi mín fènyǒng pīnbó de rénrén-zhìshì bèi hòushì guǎngwéi chuánsòng. Tāmen bùjǐn yíngdé le dāngshì bǎixìng yóuzhōng de chēngzàn, gèng bèi zūnchēng wéi mínzú de jǐliáng, qí gāoshàng pǐngé wǎnrú cuǐcàn xīngchén, zài suìyuè de chánghé zhōng yǒngyuǎn yìyì-shēnghuī.
extended_reading_passages.en: In the vast scrolls of Chinese history, countless devoted patriots who fought for the nation are sung by posterity. They not only won sincere praise from common folk, but are revered as the backbone of the nation, their noble character shining like stars.
extended_reading_passages.es: En los anales de la historia china, incontables patriotas que lucharon con abnegación por el pueblo son recordados con devoción. Merecieron el elogio sincero de sus gentes y fueron llamados pilares de la nación, fulgurando eternamente como constelaciones.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 所谓匠人精神，正是数十年如一日对技艺精益求精的执着坚守。那些被行业内外一致公称为一代宗师的手艺人，无不是在默默无闻的漫长岁月中千锤百炼，以近乎苛求的态度成就了登峰造极的传世作品。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suǒwèi jiàngrén jīngshén, zhèng shì shùshí nián rù yírì duì jìyì jīngyìqiújīng de zhízhuó jiānshǒu. Nàxiē bèi hángyè nèiwài yízhì gōngchēng wéi yí dài zōngshī de shǒuyìrén, wúbúshì zài mòmò-wúwén de màncháng suìyuè zhōng qiānchuí-bǎiliàn, yǐ jìnhū kēqiú de tàidù chéngjiù le dēngfēng-zàojí de chuánshì zuòpǐn.
extended_reading_passages.en: The artisan spirit is devotion to perfecting craft across decades. Those publicly hailed by their craft as grandmasters underwent arduous tempering in obscurity, achieving pinnacle masterpieces through relentless striving.
extended_reading_passages.es: El espíritu artesanal consiste en consagrarse a la excelencia día tras día. Quienes son reconocidos unánimemente como grandes maestros forjaron su temple en años de humilde faena, alumbrando con rigor y desvelo obras inmortales que rozan la perfección.

meanings_summary.en: to go hunting; to chase and catch wild animals; venery
meanings_summary.es: cazar; ir de cacería; perseguir y abatir presas o piezas de caza

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Striking with armed hands (打) alongside fierce hunting dogs tracking wild game (猎) captures the thrill of hunting (打猎).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Golpear con presteza (打) junto a lebreles de caza que persiguen a la fiera (猎) recrea la faena de cazar (打猎).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient China, imperial spring and autumn hunting expeditions (田猎) were sacred rituals testing martial readiness and horsemanship. Classical military strategy was intimately linked to tracking quarry in the wild, explaining why generals like Li Guang were consummate hunters.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone followed by falling 4th tone: 'dǎ liè' (214-51). Dip the pitch on 'dǎ' before striking firmly downward on 'liè'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 打猎 is the everyday verb phrase for hunting wildlife in forests and mountains.

contrasts.analysis: 打猎 focuses on terrestrial game, birds, and forest mammals using bows, guns, or traps, whereas 捕鱼 refers specifically to catching aquatic fish and crustaceans.
打猎 is a neutral historical or permitted sporting activity, whereas 盗猎 refers specifically to illegal poaching in violation of environmental laws.
打猎 is generic hunting, whereas 围猎 denotes a large-scale collective battue or cordon hunt where troops encircle game.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 者 on the right instead of 昔
Has 苗 on the right instead of 昔
Has person radical 亻 on the left instead of 犭
Has heart radical 忄 on the left instead of 犭
Has metal radical 钅 on the left

senses.definition_en: to pursue, chase, and shoot or capture wild animals or game for food, sport, or protection
senses.definition_es: perseguir y disparar a animales salvajes o presas para alimento, deporte o defensa
senses.example_phrase: 上山打猎 (go up the mountain to hunt)

example_sentences.hanzi: 天色渐晚，李广将军率领随从在山林深处打猎，忽然发现前方草丛中似乎有一只猛虎正虎视眈眈。
example_sentences.pinyin: Tiānsè jiàn wǎn, Lǐ Guǎng jiāngjūn shuàilǐng suícóng zài shānlín shēnchù dǎliè, hūrán fāxiàn qiánfāng cǎocóng zhōng sìhū yǒu yì zhī měnghǔ zhèng hǔshì-dāndān.
example_sentences.en: As dusk deepened, General Li Guang led his retinue to hunt deep in mountain woods, when he suddenly spotted what seemed to be a fierce tiger glaring intently.
example_sentences.es: Caía la tarde cuando el general Li Guang y su séquito cazaban en la espesura del bosque, cuando divisó de improviso lo que parecía un tigre acechando entre la maleza.

example_sentences.hanzi: 为了保护珍稀濒危野生动物资源，国家自然保护区内严禁任何形式的非法打猎与盗伐林木行为。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎohù zhēnxī bīnwēi yěshēng dòngwù zīyuán, guójiā zìrán bǎohùqū nèi yánjìn rènhé xíngshì de fēifǎ dǎliè yǔ dàofá línmù xíngwéi.
example_sentences.en: To protect rare and endangered wildlife resources, all forms of illegal hunting and unauthorized timber poaching are strictly banned in national reserves.
example_sentences.es: Para salvaguardar la fauna en peligro de extinción, en las reservas naturales nacionales queda tajantemente prohibida toda forma de caza furtiva o tala ilegal de árboles.

collocations.en: go into the mountains to hunt

idioms.meaning_en: hunt and patrol the mountain forests
lead a wolf into the house; invite disaster unwittingly
like wolves and tigers; ferocious and menacing
every bush and tree looks like an enemy soldier; state of extreme panic

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: hand 扌 striking a nail or tool 丁. Extensively grammaticalized as a dynamic verb prefix.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A determined hand (扌) strikes down firmly like hammer on nail (丁) to perform an action (打).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una mano decidida (扌) golpea con firmeza como martillo sobre clavo (丁) para emprender la acción (打).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 獵. Ancient pictogram of hunting hounds 犭 racing through wild terrain to seize meat 昔.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An alert hunting dog (犭) dashes through golden autumn fields tracking game for dinner (昔) to hunt (猎).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un fiel perro lebrel (犭) corretea ágil entre el matorral siguiendo el rastro de la caza (昔) para abatirla (猎).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 深秋的山林层林尽染，落叶在脚下发出沙沙的声响。猎人身背弓箭穿行在崇山峻岭之间，敏锐的双耳倾听着林间风吹草动的细微变化。古老的打猎生活不仅是对体魄的考验，更需要人与自然生态达成某种心照不宣的默契。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Shēnqiū de shānlín cénglín-jìnrǎn, luòyè zài jiǎoxià fāchū shāshā de shēngxiǎng. Lièrén shēnbēi gōngjiàn chuānxíng zài chóngshān-jùnlǐng zhījiān, mǐnruì de shuāng'ěr qīngtīng zhe línjiān fēngchuī-cǎodòng de xìwēi biànhuà. Gǔlǎo de dǎliè shēnghuó bùjǐn shì duì tǐpò de kǎoyàn, gèng xūyào rén yǔ zìrán shēngtài dáchéng mǒuzhǒng xīnzhào-bùxuān de mòqì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Late autumn woods glow with red leaves rustling underfoot. The hunter treks between rugged peaks with bow and arrow, ears alert to subtle changes in the breeze. Ancient hunting tested physical endurance and required tacit understanding with the mountain.
extended_reading_passages.es: En otoño, las hojas caídas crujen bajo las pisadas en el bosque teñido de ocres. El cazador cruza riscos con su arco, atento al leve crujido de la hojarasca. Aquella ancestral vida de caza templaba el cuerpo y exigía una callada sintonía con las leyes del monte.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 随着生态保护意识的不断增强，传统游猎民族的生活方式正在经历深刻转变。许多曾经世代依靠打猎为生的猎民主动收起猎枪，转而成为保护区里的护林员，用深沉的爱心守望着祖祖辈辈生活的莽莽林海。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suízhe shēngtài bǎohù yìshí de búduàn zēngqiáng, chuántǒng yóuliè mínzú de shēnghuó fāngshì zhèngzài jīnglì shēnkè zhuǎnbiàn. Xǔduō céngjīng shìdài yīkào dǎliè wéishēng de lièmín zhǔdòng shōuqǐ lièqiāng, zhuǎn'ér chéngwéi bǎohùqū lǐ de hùlínyuán, yòng shēnchén de àixīn shǒuwàng zhe zǔzǔ-bèibèi shēnghuó de mǎngmǎng línhǎi.
extended_reading_passages.en: With burgeoning ecological awareness, nomadic hunting traditions are undergoing transformation. Many hunters who once subsisted on game voluntarily surrendered firearms to become rangers, safeguarding ancestral mountain forests with deep affection.
extended_reading_passages.es: Al despertar la conciencia ecológica, los pueblos que vivían de la caza han transformado su modo de vida. Muchos cazadores han depuesto sus escopetas para convertirse en guardabosques de reservas naturales, custodiando con cariño la inmensidad forestal de sus ancestros.

meanings_summary.en: suddenly; abruptly; all of a sudden; unexpectedly
meanings_summary.es: de repente; de pronto; súbitamente; de forma inesperada

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Something passing before the mind can react (忽) unfolds in that immediate state (然) all of a sudden (忽然).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un suceso que cruza la mente sin previo aviso (忽) manifestándose en su estado vivo (然) irrumpe de pronto (忽然).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The character 忽 conveys the instantaneousness of a breath or fleeting vision (如忽微). Combined with the state-affirming particle 然, 忽然 functions as the quintessential temporal adverb marking an abrupt, unheralded shift in narrative reality.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone followed by rising 2nd tone: 'hū rán' (55-35). Start with a level high pitch before ascending smoothly on 'rán'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 忽然 is purely an adverb indicating that an event happened unexpectedly and abruptly in time.

contrasts.analysis: 忽然 is strictly an adverb placed before verbs (忽然下雨), whereas 突然 can function as both an adverb and a full predicate adjective (事情很突然, 突然的决定).
忽然 emphasizes unexpectedness in timing, whereas 猛然 emphasizes ferocious, startling physical momentum (猛然回头, 猛然一跃).
忽然 is common in narrative prose, while 骤然 is a formal literary term indicating a drastic, cliff-like shift in weather, temperature, or fortunes (气温骤然下降).

senses.definition_en: happening quickly, unexpectedly, and without prior indication or warning
senses.definition_es: que ocurre de forma rápida, imprevista y sin previo aviso

example_sentences.hanzi: 李广将军正勒马缓行，忽然看到前方幽暗的草丛中有一只斑斓猛虎正弓身蹲伏。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Guǎng jiāngjūn zhèng lèmǎ huǎnxíng, hūrán kàndào qiánfāng yōu'àn de cǎocóng zhōng yǒu yì zhī bānlán měnghǔ zhèng gōngshēn dūnfú.
example_sentences.en: General Li Guang was riding at a slow pace when he suddenly saw a striped fierce tiger crouching in the gloomy thicket ahead.
example_sentences.es: El general Li Guang cabalgaba al paso cuando de pronto divisó entre la umbría espesura a un feroz tigre atigrado agazapado.

example_sentences.hanzi: 正当大家为实验僵局一筹莫展时，实验室外忽然传来一阵欢呼，最新的化验结果终于水落石出。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhèngdāng dàjiā wèi shíyàn jiāngjú yìchóu-mòzhǎn shí, shíyànshì wài hūrán chuánlái yí zhèn huānhū, zuìxīn de huàyàn jiéguǒ zhōngyú shuǐluò-shíchū.
example_sentences.en: Just as everyone was at their wits' end over the experimental deadlock, a sudden cheer rang out outside, and the latest analysis was finally resolved.
example_sentences.es: Cuando todos se hallaban desconcertados ante el estancamiento del ensayo, de repente resonó una salva de vítores fuera del laboratorio, esclareciendo los resultados.

idioms.meaning_en: neglect one's official duties; dereliction
alternately hot and cold; moody and erratic
suddenly see the light; sudden enlightenment
calm and collected; completely poised in crisis

character_decomposition.sound_component: 勿 (wù, do not / flags waving swiftly)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: swift waving flags 勿 above the heart 心, portraying an event flitting past before the mind can register it.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Flags waving swiftly in the wind (勿) cause the mindful heart (心) to overlook things, leaving events to happen suddenly (忽).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Estandartes que se agitan veloces al viento (勿) sorprenden al corazón desprevenido (心), trayendo lo repentino (忽).

character_decomposition.sound_component: 肰 (rán, dog meat roasting over fire)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient ideogram: roasted dog meat 肰 sizzling over flames 灬, meaning 'authentically so', later grammaticalized as an adverbial suffix.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Fresh meat seasoned over licking flames of fire (灬) cooks naturally into an authentic state (然).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Carne sazonada al rescoldo de las brasas (灬) que cuece en su punto justo para adoptar un estado natural (然).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 独自漫步在寂静的林间小道，头顶浓密的枝叶遮蔽了天光。忽然，一阵清凉的山风吹散了林间的薄雾，明媚温暖的阳光如瀑布般倾泻而下。那一瞬间的美好，忽然拂去了心头郁积多日的烦闷与疲惫。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Dúzì mànbù zài jìjìng de línjiān xiǎodào, tóudǐng nóngmì de zhīyè zhēbì le tiānguāng. Hūrán, yí zhèn qīngliáng de shānfēng chuīsàn le línjiān de bówù, míngmèi wēnnuǎn de yángguāng rú pùbù bān qīngxiè-érxià. Nà yí shùnjiān de měihǎo, hūrán fúqù le xīntóu yùjī duō rì de fánmèn yǔ píbèi.
extended_reading_passages.en: Walking alone on quiet forest paths, dense foliage overhead shaded the sky. Suddenly, a cool mountain breeze dispersed the mist, and warm sunlight cascaded like a waterfall. That instant of beauty suddenly swept away days of fatigue.
extended_reading_passages.es: Paseando a solas por la senda del bosque, el ramaje tupido velaba la luz del cielo. De pronto, un airecillo fresco disipó la neblina y el sol cayó en cascada dorada. La belleza de aquel instante disipó de golpe las fatigas que nublaban el ánimo.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在漫长的科学探索历程中，许多里程碑式的重大发现往往孕育于看似偶然的瞬间。当研究陷入看似无法逾越的迷宫时，灵感的火花忽然闪现，不仅彻底打破了原有的理论僵局，更引领整个学科开辟出崭新的天地。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài màncháng de kēxué tànsuǒ lìchéng zhōng, xǔduō lǐchéngbēi shì de zhòngdà fāxiàn wǎngwǎng yùnyù yú kànsì ǒurán de shùnjiān. Dāng yánjiū xiànrù kànsì wúfǎ yúyuè de mígōng shí, línggǎn de huǒhuā hūrán shǎnxiàn, bùjǐn chèdǐ dǎpò le yuányǒu de lǐlùn jiāngjú, gèng yǐnlǐng zhěnggè xuékē kāipì chū zhǎnxīn de tiāndì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In scientific history, landmark discoveries are often sparked in seemingly fortuitous moments. When research seems trapped in an insurmountable maze, an unexpected flash of inspiration breaks deadlocks and opens new horizons for the discipline.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la prolongada historia de la ciencia, grandes hitos nacieron de instantes aparentemente fortuitos. Cuando la investigación parecía perdida en un laberinto, un chispazo de intuición brotó de pronto, quebrando inercias y abriendo horizontes insospechados a la ciencia.

meanings_summary.en: to squat; to crouch; to stay or idle around; to hunker down
meanings_summary.es: ponerse en cuclillas; acuclillarse; agazaparse; permanecer o quedarse

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Bending both legs and feet (足) into a low, seated stance like resting upon an ancient vessel (尊) means to squat and crouch (蹲).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Doblar pies y piernas (足) con gravedad serena (尊) permite acuclillarse o agazaparse en el suelo (蹲).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient martial arts and hunting lore, 蹲 (especially 蹲伏) describes the coiled potential energy of predators waiting to pounce. In traditional Chinese daily life, the 'Asian squat' (蹲着) is a natural, stable resting posture used while gardening, resting, or dining in agrarian communities.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone 'dūn' (55). Maintain an even, sustained, clear high vocal acoustic.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 蹲 specifically designates bending both knees so that the torso sinks low onto haunches without sitting on a chair.

contrasts.analysis: 蹲 means resting on bent knees/haunches with feet on the ground without a stool, whereas 坐 means resting the buttocks securely on a chair, bed, or bench.
蹲 keeps the soles of the feet planted on the ground, whereas 跪 rests the knees directly upon the floor or cushion in a posture of submission or prayer.
蹲 is an upright crouch on haunches, whereas 趴 means lying completely prone with stomach and chest flat against the surface.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Lacks the foot radical 足 on the left
Has walking radical 辶 around 尊
Has wood radical 木 next to 尊
Has 甬 on the right instead of 尊
Has 舀 on the right instead of 尊

senses.definition_en: to lower oneself by bending knees and resting on haunches or heels; to crouch down
senses.definition_es: doblar las rodillas bajando el cuerpo hasta apoyarse sobre los talones; acuclillarse

senses.definition_en: to stay, hang around, or remain idly in a single place
senses.definition_es: quedarse, apostarse o permanecer en un lugar determinado
senses.example_phrase: 蹲在家里 (stay cooped up at home)

example_sentences.hanzi: 母亲微笑着蹲下身子，平视着哭泣的孩子，轻声安慰并温柔地替他擦去脸颊上的泪珠。
example_sentences.pinyin: Mǔqīn wēixiào zhe dūnxià shēnzi, píngshì zhe kūqì de háizi, qīngshēng ānwèi bìng wēnróu de tì tā cāqù liǎnjiá shàng de lèizhū.
example_sentences.en: The mother smiled and crouched down, meeting the crying child's gaze at eye level, gently consoling him and wiping away tears.
example_sentences.es: La madre sonrió y se puso en cuclillas a la altura de los ojos del niño que lloraba, consolándolo con cariño y enjugando sus lágrimas.

example_sentences.hanzi: 李广定睛一看，只见前方幽暗的草丛中正蹲伏着一尊庞然大物，状如凶猛潜伏的老虎。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Guǎng dìngjīng yí kàn, zhǐ jiàn qiánfāng yōu'àn de cǎocóng zhōng zhèng dūnfú zhe yì zūn pángrán-dàwù, zhuàng rú xiōngměng qiánfú de lǎohǔ.
example_sentences.en: Looking intently, Li Guang saw a colossal shape crouching in the gloomy thicket ahead, resembling a ferocious lurking tiger.
example_sentences.es: Mirando con atención, Li Guang divisó un bulto colosal agazapado en la espesura del matorral, idéntico a un fiero tigre al acecho.

base oneself at the grassroots for field research
stake out and watch a target

hug one's head and scurry like a rat; flee in panic
deep squat and stand up

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: foot radical 足 indicating bending the lower limbs, paired with 尊, portraying a respectful low posture.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Bending the knees and feet (足) low to the ground in a posture of watchful patience (尊) to squat (蹲).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Doblar los pies y las piernas (足) bajando el cuerpo con cautela y respeto (尊) para ponerse en cuclillas (蹲).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 暮色四合的山崖下，一只苍鹰正收敛羽翼，静静蹲伏在嶙峋的岩石顶端。它那双锐利如刀的眼睛一眨不眨地俯瞰着辽阔的原野。这种蓄势待发的沉稳蹲姿，不仅展示了捕食者的从容，更蕴含着随时搏击长空的惊人爆发力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Mùsè-sìhé de shānyá xià, yì zhī cāngyīng zhèng shōuliǎn yǔyì, jìngjìng dūnfú zài línxún de yánshí dǐngduān. Tā nà shuāng ruìlì-rúdāo de yǎnjīng yìzhǎ-bùzhǎ de fǔkàn zhe liáokuò de yuányě. Zhè zhǒng xùshì-dàifā de chénwěn dūnzī, bùjǐn zhǎnshì le bǔshízhě de cóngróng, gèng yùnhán zhe suíshí bójī-chángkōng de jīngrén bàofālì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Beneath cliffs at twilight, a falcon folds its wings, quietly crouching atop craggy boulders. Sharp eyes overlook the vast plain without blinking. This composed crouching posture displays predator calmness while holding explosive energy to strike skyward.
extended_reading_passages.es: Bajo el risco al anochecer, un halcón pliega las alas agazapado en lo alto de la roca viva. Sus ojos afilados otean la llanura sin pestañear. Esta serena postura en cuclillas revela la calma del cazador y su asombrosa potencia para lanzarse al vuelo.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在深入基层调查研究的过程中，年轻干部唯有放下架子，真正蹲下身子走到田间地头，与普通群众坐在同一条板凳上拉家常，才能听到最原汁原味的心里话，掌握第一手真实情况，制定出真正受百姓拥护的好政策。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài shēnrù jīcéng diàochá-yánjiū de guòchéng zhōng, niánqīng gànbù wéiyǒu fàngxià jiàzi, zhēnzhèng dūnxià shēnzi zǒudào tiánjiān-dìtóu, yǔ pǔtōng qúnzhòng zuò zài tóng yí tiáo bǎndèng shàng lā jiācháng, cáinéng tīngdào zuì yuánzhī-yuánwèi de xīnlǐhuà, zhǎngwò dì-yī shǒu zhēnshí qíngkuàng, zhìdìng chū zhēnzhèng shòu bǎixìng yōnghù de hǎo zhèngcè.
extended_reading_passages.en: In conducting grassroots field research, young cadres must step down from high pedestals and crouch down in rural fields, sitting on benches chatting with villagers to hear genuine sentiments and formulate policies truly embraced by the people.
extended_reading_passages.es: Al investigar las bases sociales, los jóvenes funcionarios deben deponer toda altivez y bajar al ras del suelo para sentarse en el mismo banco con los campesinos. Solo así escucharán sus auténticas inquietudes y diseñarán medidas que gocen de respaldo popular.

meanings_summary.en: to shake; to wave; to rock; to sway; to oscillate; to turn (a handle)
meanings_summary.es: agitar; mover; sacudir; menear; mecer; oscilar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Using your agile hand (扌) to sway a jar back and forth causes it to rock, wave, and shake (摇).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Con la mano diestra (扌) se menea un recipiente de izquierda a derecha para agitar y mecer (摇).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese gesture language, 摇头 (shaking head) universally indicates negation, pity, or disbelief. Beyond bodily movement, 摇 conveys ontological instability and cognitive doubt (动摇, 摇摆), contrasted with Confucian unshakeable rectitude (不可动摇).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone 'yáo' (35). The voice glides cleanly upward from mid-pitch to the upper register.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 摇 emphasizes oscillating or swinging movements anchored around a pivot or axis.

contrasts.analysis: 摇 focuses on reciprocating oscillation or shaking (摇头, 摇铃), whereas 摆 can mean swinging like a pendulum (钟摆) but also extensively means placing/arranging items in order (摆放).
摇 is an active, deliberate mechanical action (摇扇子), whereas 晃 describes dizzy, unsteady rocking caused by external waves or loss of balance (车厢摇晃, 晃晃悠悠).
摇 is smooth bilateral swinging, while 甩 is a forceful, centrifugal fling or whip of the arm to cast something away (甩掉包袱).

Has walking radical 辶 around 䍃
Has jade radical 王 on the left instead of 扌
Has 罒 and 去 on the right instead of 䍃
Has 啇 on the right instead of 䍃

senses.definition_en: to move back and forth, from side to side, or up and down; to rock, sway, or wave
senses.definition_es: mover de un lado a otro o de arriba abajo; agitar, menear o sacudir

senses.definition_en: to cause to vacillate or waver (beliefs, determination, status)
senses.definition_es: hacer vacilar o tambalearse (la determinación, la fe o la estabilidad)

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对老虎的潜伏，身旁的随从们吓得面如土色，连连摇头劝说李广将军赶快撤退。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì lǎohǔ de qiánfú, shēnpáng de suícóng men xià de miànrútǔsè, liánlián yáotóu quànshuō Lǐ Guǎng jiāngjūn gǎnkuài chètuì.
example_sentences.en: Facing the lurking tiger, retinue members turned ashen with fear, shaking heads repeatedly urging General Li Guang to withdraw immediately.
example_sentences.es: Ante el tigre al acecho, los aterrados guardias palidecieron de miedo y no cesaron de menear la cabeza instando al general Li Guang a replegarse deprisa.

example_sentences.hanzi: 无论外界的环境多么喧嚣浮躁，真正的智者始终心如磐石，任何诱惑都无法动摇他内心的信念。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wúlùn wàijiè de huánjìng duōme xuāoxiāo fúzào, zhēnzhèng de zhìzhě shǐzhōng xīnrúpánshí, rènhé yòuhuò dōu wúfǎ dòngyáo tā nèixīn de xìnniàn.
example_sentences.en: No matter how noisy and volatile the outside world is, a true sage remains firm as a boulder; no temptations can shake inner conviction.
example_sentences.es: Por ruidoso y frívolo que resulte el mundo exterior, el sabio auténtico permanece firme como roca; ninguna tentación logra hacer tambalear su fe íntima.

idioms.meaning_en: tottering and about to collapse; highly precarious
swagger through streets seeking attention; ostentatious
unsettle the minds of the people; shake morale
earth trembles and mountains shake; titanic upheaval

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 搖. Phono-semantic compound: hand radical 扌 indicating manual shaking or waving, paired with phonetic 䍃.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A hand (扌) reaches out to grasp and vigorously sway a vessel from side to side to shake (摇).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una mano (扌) se extiende para asir y mecer con vigor una vasija de lado a lado para agitarla (摇).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 秋风萧瑟，吹落了一树金黄的银杏叶，枝头的残叶在风中凄楚地微微摇曳。古寺的铜钟在暮色中随风轻摇，发出深沉悠远的钟声。伫立在庭院中，听着钟声与落叶的私语，内心的浮华与喧嚣渐渐平静。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Qiūfēng xiāosè, chuīluò le yí shù jīnhuáng de yínxìng yè, zhītóu de cányè zài fēng zhōng qīchǔ de wēiwēi yáoyè. Gǔsì de tóngzhōng zài mùsè zhōng suífēng qīng yáo, fāchū shēnchén yōuyuǎn de zhōngshēng. Zhùlì zài tíngyuàn zhōng, tīngzhe zhōngshēng yǔ luòyè de sīyǔ, nèixīn de fúhuá yǔ xuāoxiāo jiànjiàn píngjìng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Bleak autumn winds blow down golden ginkgo leaves, lingering foliage swaying in the air. The ancient temple's bronze bell sways gently at dusk, tolling a deep resonance. Standing in the courtyard hearing the chimes, inner vanities gradually quiet down.
extended_reading_passages.es: El viento otoñal derriba hojas doradas de ginkgo que oscilan en las ramas. La campana de bronce del monasterio se mece al ocaso tañendo con gravedad. De pie en el patio escuchando su rumor, las vanidades del mundo se van desvaneciendo en silencio.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在复杂的国际风云变幻面前，保持战略定力是国家行稳致远的关键底气。无论外部风浪如何冲击，只要全国上下万众一心，任何霸权施压都无法动摇中国人民坚定走和平发展道路的坚强决心。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài fùzá de guójì fēngyún-biànhuàn miànqián, bǎochí zhànlüè dìnglì shì guójiā xíngwěn-zhìyuǎn de guānjiàn dǐqì. Wúlùn wàibù fēnglàng rúhé chōngjī, zhǐyào quánguó shàngxià wànzhòng-yìxīn, rènhé bàquán shīyā dōu wúfǎ dòngyáo Zhōngguó rénmín jiāndìng zǒu hépíng fāzhǎn dàolù de jiānqiáng juéxīn.
extended_reading_passages.en: In volatile international arenas, preserving strategic resolve is crucial for steady progress. No matter how fierce external storms rage, if the whole nation stands united, no hegemonic coercion can shake the Chinese people's dedication to peace.
extended_reading_passages.es: Ante los vaivenes del tablero internacional, mantener el aplomo estratégico es clave para avanzar con paso firme. Por recios que sean los vientos externos, ningún acoso hegemónico logrará quebrar la firme voluntad del pueblo de transitar la senda de la paz.

meanings_summary.en: not serious; it doesn't matter; never mind; of no great consequence
meanings_summary.es: no importa; no es grave; no pasa nada; no tiene importancia; no te preocupes

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Something that is not (不) demanding or crucially urgent (要紧) is lighthearted and doesn't matter (不要紧).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Aquello que no (不) reviste una tensión apremiante (要紧) carece de gravedad y no tiene importancia (不要紧).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese colloquial discourse, 要紧 (crucial / tense) derives from 紧 (tight cords pulled to the breaking point). Prefixing with 不 relaxes all existential tension, serving as the quintessential phrase for reassuring anxious peers in crises.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Tone sandhi: 'bú yào jǐn' (35-51-214). 'bù' changes from 4th tone to rising 2nd tone 'bú' because it precedes falling 4th tone 'yào'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 不要紧 is an informal spoken consolation expressing that a mishap, injury, or mistake is harmless and trivial.

contrasts.compared_word: 不要紧 vs. 没关系
contrasts.analysis: 没关系 is polite social etiquette responding to an apology or thanks ('no problem / you're welcome'), whereas 不要紧 specifically addresses health, danger, or injury ('it's not critical / not dangerous').

contrasts.compared_word: 不要紧 vs. 无所谓
contrasts.analysis: 不要紧 is warm and reassuring about low risk, whereas 无所谓 expresses apathy, indifference, or unconcern ('I don't care either way').

contrasts.compared_word: 不要紧 vs. 不碍事
contrasts.analysis: Both mean not hindering, but 不碍事 emphasizes that something does not physically block an action, while 不要紧 focuses on severity of consequences.

Has 如 on top of 糸 instead of 臤
Has 此 on top of 糸 instead of 臤

senses.definition_en: not serious or critical; not a cause for concern or alarm; it doesn't matter
senses.definition_es: no reviste gravedad ni peligro; no tiene mayor trascendencia; no hay de qué preocuparse
senses.example_phrase: 伤势不要紧 (the injury isn't serious)

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对手下随从惊恐万状的劝阻，李广将军只是从容一笑，淡淡地说了声“不要紧”，便稳稳拔出长箭。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì shǒuxià suícóng jīngkǒng-wànzhuàng de quànzǔ, Lǐ Guǎng jiāngjūn zhǐshì cóngróng yíxiào, dàndàn de shuō le shēng 'búyàojǐn', biàn wěnwěn báchū chángjiàn.
example_sentences.en: Facing terrified dissuasion from his retinue, General Li Guang merely smiled with composure, murmured 'it doesn't matter', and drew his long arrow.
example_sentences.es: Ante los asustados ruegos de sus guardias, el general Li Guang sonrió con serenidad, musitó un tranquilo 'no pasa nada' y desenvainó con pulso firme una flecha.

example_sentences.hanzi: 医生仔细检查了伤口后宽慰病人说，只是轻微擦伤，按时换药即可，身体健康完全不要紧。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yīshēng zǐxì jiǎnchá le shāngkǒu hòu kuānwèi bìngrén shuō, zhǐshì qīngwēi cāshāng, ànshí huànyào jíkě, shēntǐ jiànkāng wánquán búyàojǐn.
example_sentences.en: After carefully inspecting the wound, the doctor comforted the patient that it was merely a graze; taking medicine on time, his health was fine.
example_sentences.es: Tras examinar la herida con detenimiento, el médico tranquilizó al paciente diciéndole que solo era una rozadura leve y que su salud no corría riesgo.

collocations.en: failure does not matter; it's okay to fail
console someone saying it doesn't matter

idioms.meaning_en: of no importance; insignificant; immaterial
beating gongs and rolling drums; in intense preparation
wind is harsh so run; slang for beating a swift retreat
appropriate balance between looseness and tightness

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictogram of a seed root or plant shoot unable to sprout above the earth line 一, symbolizing negation.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A seed sprout attempts to burst through the ground line (一) but fails to emerge, expressing negation (不).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un brote que lucha por atravesar la superficie de la tierra (一) sin lograr asomar, indicando negación (不).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictogram depicting a woman 女 with hands resting on her slender waist 覀. Later borrowed for 'crucial, need, essential'.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A woman (女) holding her essential, delicate waist (覀) represents what is most crucial and required (要).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una mujer (女) con las manos ceñidas a su cintura esencial (覀) simboliza lo primordial y perentorio (要).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 緊. Ancient pictogram of a resolute hand 臤 pulling strands of silk thread 糸 taut with tension.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Strong hands pull silk cords (糸) with unyielding force to make them extremely taut and urgent (紧).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Manos enérgicas tensan las hebras de seda (糸) con pulso firme hasta dejarlas prietas y urgentes (紧).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 生活中难免会遇到跌倒与挫折，一句温暖从容的“不要紧”，往往胜过千言万语的劝慰。它不仅能抚平内心的慌乱与沮丧，更能给予前行者重整旗鼓的勇气。学会坦然面对得失，人生才能走得更加宽广从容。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Shēnghuó zhōng nánmiǎn huì yùdào diēdǎo yǔ cuòzhé, yí jù wēnnuǎn cóngróng de 'búyàojǐn', wǎngwǎng shèngguò qiānyán-wànyǔ de quànwèi. Tā bùjǐn néng fǔpíng nèixīn de huāngluàn yǔ jǔsàng, gèng néng jǐyǔ qiánxíngzhě chóngzhěng-qígǔ de yǒngqì. Xuéhuì tǎnrán miànduì déshī, rénshēng cáinéng zǒu de gèngjiā kuānguǎng cóngróng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Stumbles and setbacks are inevitable in life; a warm, tranquil 'it doesn't matter' often outshines thousands of words. It smooths away panic and confers courage to regroup. Facing gains and losses with equanimity broadens one's path.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los tropiezos son inevitables en la vida; un apacible 'no pasa nada' vale más que mil consuelos. Calma el desasosiego y alienta a recomponer fuerzas. Mirar con serenidad las vicisitudes ensancha el horizonte vital.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在危机管理与团队决策中，优秀的领导者既能在战略上洞察全局，又能在战术失误时以“不要紧”的豁达胸襟稳定军心。允许团队在试错中探索成长，恰恰是激发组织内部创新活力与坚韧韧性的关键所在。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài wēijī guǎnlǐ yǔ tuánduì juécè zhōng, yōuxiù de lǐngdǎozhě jì néng zài zhànlüè shàng dòngchá quánjú, yòu néng zài zhànshù shīwù shí yǐ 'búyàojǐn' de huòdá xiōngjīn wěndìng jūnxīn. Yǔnxǔ tuánduì zài shìcuò zhōng tànsuǒ chéngzhǎng, qiàqià shì jīfā zǔzhī nèibù chuàngxīn huólì yǔ jiānrèn rènxìng de guānjiàn suǒzài.
extended_reading_passages.en: In crisis management, great leaders oversee strategy while calming troops with magnanimous equanimity during tactical errors. Allowing teams to learn from trial and error is the catalyst sparking innovation and resilient cohesion.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la gestión de crisis, los líderes eminentes dominan el tablero estratégico y apaciguan ánimos con noble templanza ante los errores tácticos. Permitir aprender del ensayo y error es la clave que desata la creatividad y fortalece a los equipos.

meanings_summary.en: measure word for long thin inflexible objects (arrows, pens, guns), songs, or military units; to support; branch
meanings_summary.es: clasificador para objetos largos y rígidos (flechas, plumas, fusiles), canciones o tropas; sostener; rama

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A hand gripping a slender bamboo branch (支) props up structures and counts arrows and pens as a measure word (支).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Una mano que empuña una varilla de bambú (支) apuntala estructuras y cuenta flechas y plumas como clasificador (支).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient archery and tallying, bamboo arrows and divination reeds (筹策) were counted in bundles held in hand (支). Consequently, 支 evolved from 'hand grasping branch' into both a verb of support (支撑) and the specialized classifier for stiff slender implements and melodies.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone 'zhī' (55). Maintain a sustained, clean, ringing high pitch contour.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 支 is the precise measure word for rigid, slender, rod-like tools (arrows, pens, firearms) and musical pieces.

contrasts.analysis: 支 classifies thin, rigid, manufactured instruments (一支箭, 一支笔, 一支枪), whereas 根 classifies flexible, fibrous, or natural slender items (一根绳子, 一根头发, 一根竹子).
支 is for cylindrical slender tools, while 把 is for items featuring a grasping handle (一把刀, 一把扇子, 一把雨伞).
Both count music/poems, but 支 is often used for instrumental melodies or popular songs (一支歌), while 首 is formal for poetic stanzas and formal anthems (一首诗, 一首国歌).

senses.definition_en: used to count slender, rigid, rod-like items such as arrows, pens, firearms, cigarettes, or candles
senses.definition_es: clasificador para objetos delgados y rígidos como flechas, bolígrafos, fusiles o velas

senses.definition_en: used to count musical melodies, songs, or organized military troop units
senses.definition_es: clasificador para composiciones musicales, canciones o contingentes militares

example_sentences.hanzi: 李广将军面不改色，沉着地从身后的箭袋中抽出一支白羽长箭，搭在弓弦上瞄准猛虎。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Guǎng jiāngjūn miànbùgǎisè, chénzhuó de cóng shēnhòu de jiàndài zhōng chōuchū yì zhī báiyǔ chángjiàn, dā zài gōngxián shàng miáozhǔn měnghǔ.
example_sentences.en: Without turning pale, General Li Guang calmly pulled a white-feathered long arrow from his quiver, nocked it, and aimed at the tiger.
example_sentences.es: Sereno y sin mudar el semblante, el general Li Guang extrajo del carcaj una flecha de plumas blancas, la colocó en la cuerda y apuntó a la fiera.

example_sentences.hanzi: 音乐会上，小提琴演奏家深情地拉响了一支悠扬动听的古典名曲，引得台下观众如痴如醉。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yīnyuèhuì shàng, xiǎotíqín yǎnzòujiā shēnqíng de lāxiǎng le yì zhī yōuyáng dòngtīng de gǔdiǎn míngqǔ, yǐndé táixià guānzhòng rúchī-rúzuì.
example_sentences.en: At the concert, the violinist passionately performed a melodious classical piece, entrancing the audience below.
example_sentences.es: En el concierto, el virtuoso del violín interpretó con honda emoción una melodía clásica tan melodiosa que cautivó al auditorio.

collocations.en: a piece of music; a song

idioms.meaning_en: a single log cannot prop up a falling roof; cannot manage alone
overjoyed beyond control; overwhelmed with joy
broken into pieces; fragmented and disrupted
the dying momentum of an arrow shot from a strong crossbow

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient bronze pictogram of a right hand 又 holding a slender snapped bamboo branch 十, signifying support or counting items.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A firm hand (又) grasps a slender bamboo twig (十) to prop up a tent and count long rods (支).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una mano diestra (又) sostiene una varilla delgada de bambú (十) para apuntalar y contar objetos finos (支).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 案头的一支斑竹毛笔，承载着数代文人墨客的幽微心事。蘸饱浓淡适宜的青墨，笔尖在宣纸上挥洒出崇山峻岭与流云飞瀑。这一支小小的毛笔，不仅记录着岁月的更迭，更传承着中华传统书画艺术的千古神韵。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Àntóu de yì zhī bānzhú máobǐ, chéngzài zhe shù dài wénrén-mòkè de yōuwēi xīnshì. Zhànbǎo nóngdàn shìyí de qīngmò, bǐjiān zài xuānzhǐ shàng huīsǎ chū chóngshān-jùnlǐng yǔ liúyún-fēipù. Zhè yì zhī xiǎoxiǎo de máobǐ, bùjǐn jìlù zhe suìyuè de gēngdié, gèng chuánchéng zhe Zhōnghuá chuántǒng shūhuà yìshù de qiāngǔ shényùn.
extended_reading_passages.en: A speckled bamboo brush on the desk cradles the nuanced musings of literati generations. Dipped in ink, its tip splashes craggy peaks and waterfalls across rice paper. This tiny brush records the passage of years and inherits calligraphy's timeless charm.
extended_reading_passages.es: Una pluma de bambú sobre el escritorio custodia los desvelos de generaciones de letrados. Impregnada en tinta china, su punta traza riscos y cascadas sobre papel de arroz. Este modesto pincel perpetúa el alma imperecedera de la caligrafía clásica.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在抗震救灾的生死关头，一支训练有素、装备精良的国家紧急救援队伍在第一时间抵达灾区核心地带。他们日夜奋战在废墟瓦砾之中，为抢救人民生命财产筑起一道坚不可摧的生命防线，谱写了英雄壮歌。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài kàngzhèn-jiùzāi de shēngsǐ guāntóu, yì zhī xùnliàn-yǒusù, zhuāngbèi-jīngliáng de guójiā jǐnjí jiùyuán duìwù zài dì-yī shíjiān dǐdá zāiqū héxīn dìdài. Tāmen rìyè fènzhàn zài fèixū-wǎlì zhīzhōng, wèi qiǎngjiù rénmín shēngmìng cáichǎn zhùqǐ yí dào jiānbùkěcuī de shēngmìng fángxiàn, pǔxiě le yīngxióng zhuànggē.
extended_reading_passages.en: At the life-or-death juncture of earthquake relief, a well-trained, well-equipped national emergency team arrived at the disaster core. Laboring day and night among ruins, they built an impregnable lifeline, composing a heroic anthem.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la hora crítica del auxilio tras el sismo, un cuerpo de rescate nacional bien adiestrado y pertrechado arribó con presteza al epicentro. Bregando día y noche entre escombros, tendió un escudo salvador en defensa del pueblo, entonando una gesta heroica.

meanings_summary.en: to put; to place; to arrange; to set; to sway; to swing; to wave
meanings_summary.es: colocar; poner; disponer; balancear; oscilar; mecer; menear

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Using an orderly hand (扌) to lay out goods across the market mat sets items in place (摆) or lets them gently swing (摆).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Con mano diestra (扌) se disponen las piezas en la estera para colocarlas con orden (摆) o dejarlas mecerse (摆).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The character 摆 bridges spatial positioning (摆设, 摆放) and rhythmic oscillation (钟摆, 摇摆). In colloquial Chinese, it also describes displaying prestige or attitudes (摆架子, 摆事实讲道理), transforming physical layout into symbolic presentation.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone 'bǎi' (214). Drop the vocal register into a low chest contour before rebounding slightly.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 摆 emphasizes deliberate orderly arrangement for display or posture, as well as rhythmic pendulum swinging.

contrasts.analysis: 放 is the generic oral verb for simply setting down or placing an object anywhere (放在桌上), whereas 摆 implies intentional arrangement, aesthetic alignment, or setting a pose (摆放, 摆姿势).
摆 emphasizes rhythmic arc swinging like a clock pendulum (钟摆) or setting positions, while 摇 focuses on shaking back and forth (摇头).
摆 is concrete physical positioning of tangible items, while 设 is formal and abstract, used for establishing institutions, setting traps, or hypotheses (设立, 假设).

look_alikes.distinction_note: Lacks the hand radical 扌 on the left
Has 䍃 on the right instead of 罢
Has 隹 (bird) on the right instead of 罢
Has 昔 on the right instead of 罢
Has 绎 structure on the right

senses.definition_en: to put, arrange, set, or position objects or one's body in order or display
senses.definition_es: colocar, poner, disponer o arreglar objetos o el propio cuerpo en una postura determinada

senses.definition_en: to sway, swing, or wave gently back and forth like a pendulum or breeze
senses.definition_es: oscilar, mecerse o balancearse rítmicamente como un péndulo o las ramas
senses.example_phrase: 随风摇摆 (sway with the wind)

example_sentences.hanzi: 李广将军翻身下马，稳稳站定，摆好射箭的姿势，眼神如苍鹰般紧紧锁住前方的目标。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Guǎng jiāngjūn fānshēn xiàmǎ, wěnwěn zhàndìng, bǎihǎo shèjiàn de zīshì, yǎnshén rú cāngyīng bān jǐnjǐn suǒzhù qiánfāng de mùbiāo.
example_sentences.en: General Li Guang dismounted, stood firm, set his archery posture, and locked his eyes onto the target ahead like a falcon.
example_sentences.es: El general Li Guang desmontó de su caballo, se plantó con firmeza, cuadró su postura de arquero y clavó la mirada en la presa como un halcón.

example_sentences.hanzi: 会议室的长桌中央整齐地摆放着鲜花与会议材料，展示出主办方细致周到的筹备工作。
example_sentences.pinyin: Huìyìshì de chángzhuō zhōngyāng zhěngqí de bǎifàng zhe xiānhuā yǔ huìyì cáiliào, zhǎnshì chū zhǔbànfāng xìzhì-zhōudào de chóubèi gōngzuò.
example_sentences.en: Fresh flowers and meeting dossiers were arranged neatly in the center of the conference table, demonstrating the host's meticulous preparations.
example_sentences.es: Flores frescas y carpetas de trabajo se hallaban primorosamente dispuestas en el centro de la mesa de conferencias, dando fe de la esmerada organización.

collocations.en: shake off or break free from a predicament

idioms.meaning_en: strut swaggering back and forth; walk with arrogant pomp
vacillate back and forth; waver without settling
manipulate and order others around like pawns
break out of and cast aside a crisis

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 擺. Phono-semantic compound: hand 扌 arranging fishing nets 罒 or spreading goods for display.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An active hand (扌) methodically lays out items across a woven mat (罒) in orderly positions to place and arrange (摆).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una mano ordenada (扌) dispone las piezas sobre la estera (罒) colocándolas con esmero para ordenarlas (摆).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 步入古朴素雅的书斋，案几上错落有致地摆放着文房四宝与几卷线装古籍。窗外芭蕉叶在细雨中轻轻摇摆，雨滴敲打在青石阶上发出清脆的声响。在这样静谧的天地里，尘世的浮躁与功利瞬间消解无形。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Bùrù gǔpǔ-sùyǎ de shūzhāi, ànjǐ shàng cuòluò-yǒuzhì de bǎifàng zhe wénfáng-sìbǎo yǔ jǐ juǎn xiànzhuāng gǔjí. Chuāngwài bājiāoyè zài xìyǔ zhōng qīngqīng yáobǎi, yǔdī qiāodǎ zài qīngshíjiē shàng fāchū qīngcuì de shēngxiǎng. Zài zhèyàng jìngmì de tiāndì lǐ, chénshì de fúzào yǔ gōnglì shùnjiān xiāojiě wúxíng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Stepping into the elegant study, the four treasures of literati and bound classics were arranged in orderly poise across desks. Plantain leaves outside swayed in drizzle, drops tapping bluestone steps; worldliness evaporated into thin air.
extended_reading_passages.es: Al entrar en el sobrio estudio, los cuatro tesoros de la caligrafía y antiguos códices descansaban ordenados sobre el pupitre. Afuera, las hojas de platanero oscilaban con la llovizna; en aquel remanso de paz, las prisas del mundo se desvanecieron.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在复杂的商业战略博弈中，企业不能仅仅满足于将问题摆在桌面上讨论，更需要展现出敢于打破僵局的执行魄力。唯有迅速摆脱对传统路径的过度依赖，主动布局新兴赛道，才能在白热化的市场竞争中抢占发展先机。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài fùzá de shāngyè zhànlüè bóyì zhōng, qǐyè bùnéng jǐnjǐn mǎnzú yú jiāng wèntí bǎi zài zhuōmiàn shàng tǎolùn, gèng xūyào zhǎnxiàn chū gǎnyú dǎpò jiāngjú de zhíxíng pòlì. Wéiyǒu xùnsù bǎituō duì chuántǒng lùjìng de guòdù yīlài, zhǔdòng bùjú xīnxīng sàidào, cáinéng zài báirèhuà de shìchǎng jìngzhēng zhōng qiǎngzhàn fāzhǎn xiānjī.
extended_reading_passages.en: In corporate strategy, firms cannot merely rest content with putting issues on the table; they must execute with daring courage. Shaking off over-dependence on traditional paths and pioneering emerging tracks seizes the competitive vanguard.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el ajedrez corporativo, las empresas no pueden contentarse con poner los problemas sobre el tapete; precisan arrojo ejecutivo. Solo sacudiéndose la inercia del pasado e invirtiendo con audacia en nuevos nichos conquistarán la delantera en el mercado.

meanings_summary.en: posture; pose; carriage; gesture; bodily attitude
meanings_summary.es: postura; pose; porte; gesto corporal; actitud física

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Poised feminine grace (姿) combined with muscular bodily momentum (势) determines a person's balanced physical posture (姿势).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: La grácil compostura (姿) unida al vigor de la fuerza muscular (势) define la correcta postura física (姿势).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Chinese martial arts (武术) and calligraphy, 姿势 is the foundational alignment uniting internal breath (气), muscle mechanics (力), and visual poise (态). The correct stance (如坐如钟, 站如松) is considered the indispensable prerequisite for martial focus and health.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone followed by falling 4th tone: 'zī shì' (55-51). Articulate 'zī' on a steady high register before dropping sharply on 'shì'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 姿势 specifically designates physical bodily stance or gesture (sitting, archery, swimming), concrete and visible.

contrasts.analysis: 姿势 refers to the concrete mechanical physical pose (正确的坐姿姿势), whereas 姿态 frequently extends to metaphorical moral, diplomatic, or political attitudes (展现开放姿态).
姿势 is static or held bodily alignment, while 动作 emphasizes kinetic movement, execution of physical steps, or athletic actions.
姿势 belongs to human body mechanics, whereas 态势 refers to the strategic or geopolitical macro situation of an environment or military conflict.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has cowrie shell 贝 at bottom instead of 女
Has heart 心 at bottom instead of 女
Lacks the muscle radical 力 at the bottom
Has four dots of fire 灬 at bottom instead of 力
Has earth radical 土 at bottom instead of 力

senses.definition_en: the position, carriage, or bearing in which someone holds their body while standing, sitting, or performing an action
senses.definition_es: modo o forma de colocar el cuerpo o de adoptar una actitud física al estar de pie, sentado o en acción

example_sentences.hanzi: 李广将军扎稳马步，摆出了极其标准的射箭姿势，双臂拉满强弓，宛如一尊巍峨挺立的铜像。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Guǎng jiāngjūn zhāwěn mǎbù, bǎichū le jíqí biāozhǔn de shèjiàn zīshì, shuāngbì lāmǎn qiánggōng, wǎnrú yì zūn wēi'é tǐnglì de tóngxiàng.
example_sentences.en: General Li Guang anchored his horse stance firmly, struck a textbook archery posture, and drew the bow full like a towering bronze statue.
example_sentences.es: El general Li Guang afianzó su postura de jinete, adoptó una pose canónica de arquero y tensó el recio arco como estatua de bronce erguida.

example_sentences.hanzi: 舞蹈演员经过长达数年的严格形体训练，在舞台上的每一个旋转跳跃姿势都显得格外优美轻盈。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wǔdǎoyuǎnyuán jīngguò chángdá shù nián de yángé xíngtǐ xùnliàn, zài wǔtái shàng de měi yí gè xuánzhuǎn tiàoyuè zīshì dōu xiǎnde géwài yōuměi qīngyíng.
example_sentences.en: After years of rigorous physical conditioning, every spinning and leaping posture the dancers execute onstage appears exceptionally graceful and light.
example_sentences.es: Tras años de riguroso adiestramiento corporal, cada giro y salto de los bailarines en escena denota una exquisita gracilidad y soltura.

idioms.meaning_en: varied and graceful; rich and colorful in styles
with huge banners and rolling drums; on a grand scale
unstoppable momentum; irresistible force
graceful and charming carriage; elegant posture

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: woman 女 paired with 次, portraying the poised grace and delicate beauty of feminine carriage.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A woman (女) holding herself with poise second to none (次) exhibits natural grace and posture (姿).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una mujer (女) cuyo porte refinado no cede ante nadie (次) destila gracia y bella compostura (姿).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 勢. Ancient pictogram of a hand holding and exerting force 力 to command momentum and posture.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Grasping authority firmly (执) with muscular strength (力) projects formidable outward momentum and poise (势).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Empuñar con firmeza (执) la propia fuerza (力) infunde un ímpetu y una postura imponentes (势).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 舞台上聚光灯亮起，芭蕾舞者挺拔的身姿定格成优雅的弧线。每一个细微的眼神流转，每一个舒展的肢体姿势，都凝结着台下十年如一日的汗水与坚守。这种从容舒展的体态，生动诠释了人类对纯粹身体美学的崇高追求。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Wǔtái shàng jùguāngdēng liàngqǐ, bālěi wǔzhě tǐngbá de shēnzī dìnggé chéng yōuyǎ de húxiàn. Měi yí gè xìwēi de yǎnshén liúzhuǎn, měi yí gè shūzhǎn de zhītǐ zīshì, dōu níngjié zhe táixià shí nián rú yírì de hànshuǐ yǔ jiānshǒu. Zhè zhǒng cóngróng shūzhǎn de tǐtài, shēngdòng quánshì le rénlèi duì chúncuì shēntǐ měixué de chónggāo zhuīqiú.
extended_reading_passages.en: Spotlights illuminate the stage as the ballerina's upright carriage freezes into an elegant arc. Every subtle glance and expansive bodily posture crystallizes a decade of tireless sweat. This relaxed poise interprets humanity's pursuit of pure physical aesthetics.
extended_reading_passages.es: Bajo los focos del escenario, la grácil silueta de la bailarina dibuja un arco soberbio. Cada sutil mirada y cada postura corporal condensan diez años de denodado sacrificio. Este porte sereno encarna la sublime aspiración humana a la belleza plástica.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在快节奏的现代职场生活中，长期面对电脑屏幕往往容易导致颈椎疲劳与不良坐姿。健康医学专家倡导职场人士应当定期起立活动，主动调整日常工作中的坐立姿势，以科学的生活方式远离亚健康隐患，保持充沛的工作精力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài kuàijièzòu de xiàndài zhíchǎng shēnghuó zhōng, chángqī miànduì diànnǎo píngmù wǎngwǎng róngyì dǎozhì jǐngzhuī pílào yǔ bùliáng zuòzī. Jiànkāng yīxué zhuānjiā chàngdǎo zhíchǎng rénshì yīngdāng dìngqī qǐlì huódòng, zhǔdòng tiáozhěng rìcháng gōngzuò zhōng de zuòlì zīshì, yǐ kēxué de shēnghuó fāngshì yuǎnlí yàjiànkāng yǐnhuàn, bǎochí chōngpèi de gōngzuò jīnglì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In fast-paced offices, staring at screens easily causes cervical strain and poor sitting posture. Health experts urge professionals to stand periodically and adjust daily posture, utilizing ergonomic habits to banish fatigue and sustain energy.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la vida laboral moderna, pasar horas ante la pantalla suele provocar fatiga cervical y malas posturas al sentarse. Los médicos aconsejan levantarse a menudo y corregir la higiene postural para eludir dolencias y preservar la vitalidad en el trabajo.

meanings_summary.en: to concentrate with undivided attention; to be completely absorbed or engrossed
meanings_summary.es: concentrarse en cuerpo y alma; estar absorto; prestar atención total y exclusiva

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Pouring (注) your entire, complete (全) spiritual mind (神) like a cord strung through an arrow (贯) achieves undivided concentration (全神贯注).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Verter (注) todo (全) el espíritu (神) como un hilo tenaz que lo atraviesa (贯) cristaliza la concentración total (全神贯注).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Chinese archery lore (射艺), as described in Liezi (列子) and Zhuangzi, marksmanship was not merely physical exertion but a meditative trance of 'unifying spirit' (凝神). When concentration achieves absolute unity, arrows can pierce solid stone.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising, rising, falling, falling: 'quán shén guàn zhù' (35-35-51-51). Lift smoothly across the first two syllables, then strike down emphatically on the final two.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 全神贯注 describes the psychological state where 100% of conscious mental energy is channeled into a single target.

contrasts.compared_word: 全神贯注 vs. 专心致志
contrasts.analysis: Both mean concentrating, but 全神贯注 highlights the intense physiological absorption of senses and mental faculties at a single moment, whereas 专心致志 highlights long-term dedication to a craft or study.

contrasts.compared_word: 全神贯注 vs. 聚精会神
contrasts.analysis: Highly synonymous; 聚精会神 emphasizes gathering dispersed energy together, while 全神贯注 emphasizes pouring that gathered energy outward like a focused beam into an object.

contrasts.compared_word: 全神贯注 vs. 目不转睛
contrasts.analysis: 目不转睛 describes solely the fixed optical gaze of the physical eyes without blinking, whereas 全神贯注 describes the entire mind, spirit, and awareness.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 人 at top above 王 and two dots
Has 见 on the right instead of 申
Has 中 at top above 贝 instead of 毌
Has person radical 亻 on the left instead of 氵
Has wood radical 木 on the left instead of 氵

senses.definition_en: focusing all of one's mental energy, spirit, and faculties on a single task without the slightest distraction
senses.definition_es: concentrar toda la energía anímica, espíritu y atención en una sola labor sin distracción alguna
senses.example_phrase: 全神贯注地听讲 (listen with rapt attention)

example_sentences.hanzi: 李广将军扎稳马步，屏住呼吸，全神贯注地凝视着草丛中的猛虎，拉满弓弦蓄势待发。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Guǎng jiāngjūn zhāwěn mǎbù, bǐngzhù hūxī, quánshén-guànzhù de níngshì zhe cǎocóng zhōng de měnghǔ, lāmǎn gōngxián xùshì-dàifā.
example_sentences.en: General Li Guang planted his stance, held his breath, and gazed at the tiger in the grass with undivided focus, drawing his bow taut.
example_sentences.es: El general Li Guang afianzó su postura, contuvo el aliento y clavó la vista en el tigre con concentración absoluta, tensando el arco al límite.

example_sentences.hanzi: 外科手术台上，主刀医生全神贯注地操作着微创显微仪器，长达八小时未曾有丝毫懈怠。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wàikē shǒushùtái shàng, zhǔdāo yīshēng quánshén-guànzhù de cāozuò zhe wēichuàng xiǎnwēi yíqì, chángdá bā xiǎoshí wèicéng yǒu sīháo xièdài.
example_sentences.en: Over the operating table, the chief surgeon operated micro-instruments with undivided attention, never slacking for eight straight hours.
example_sentences.es: Sobre la mesa de operaciones, el cirujano jefe manejaba los instrumentos microscópicos con concentración total, sin un instante de fatiga durante ocho horas.

collocations.en: read a book with undivided attention

idioms.meaning_en: gather one's spirit and thoughts; concentrate intensely
devote oneself heart and soul; dedicated focus
gaze with fixed eyes without blinking
heart free of worldly distractions; completely dedicated

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictogram of pure, unblemished jade entered beneath a sheltering roof, meaning flawless and complete.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Pure, flawless jade stored under a roof preserves its entire, complete perfection (全).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una gema de jade puro guardada bajo techado conserva su integridad entera y cabal (全).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient bronze pictogram of celestial lightning 申 flashing beside a ritual altar 礻, signifying spiritual energy and consciousness.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Heavenly lightning (申) descends upon the sacred altar (礻) to awaken divine spirit and focus (神).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: El rayo celestial (申) desciende sobre el ara sagrada (礻) iluminando la chispa del espíritu (神).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 貫. Ancient pictogram showing a cord 毌 piercing through cowrie shell currency 贝 to bind them in one line.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A cord pierces right through the center of valuable coins (贝) to string them together into one unified line (贯).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una cuerda atraviesa el centro de monedas valiosas (贝) ensartándolas en un solo hilo continuo (贯).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: water 氵 flowing decisively toward the lamp wick 主, signifying pouring water or pouring mental energy into one focus.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Pouring water (氵) with steady precision directly onto the master wick (主) focuses all flow into one point (注).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Verter agua (氵) con pulso certero sobre la mecha maestra (主) concentra toda la energía en un solo foco (注).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 静谧的书斋里，老画家屏息凝神，全神贯注地落下了长卷上的最后一笔。案头那一方墨砚早已干涸，窗外的夜色不知何时已然深沉。这种沉醉于艺术创作的忘我境界，让心灵彻底脱离了世俗的羁绊与尘劳。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Jìngmì de shūzhāi lǐ, lǎo huàjiā bǐngxī-níngshén, quánshén-guànzhù de luòxià le chángjuàn shàng de zuìhòu yì bǐ. Àntóu nà yì fāng mòyàn zǎoyǐ gānhé, chuāngwài de yèsè bùzhī héshí yǐrán shēnchén. Zhè zhǒng chénzuì yú yìshù chuàngzuò de wàngwǒ jìngjiè, ràng xīnlíng chèdǐ tuōlí le shìsú de jībàn yǔ chénláo.
extended_reading_passages.en: In the serene studio, the veteran painter held his breath, executing the final stroke with rapt attention. The inkstone on the desk had long dried, and night had fallen outside. This selfless immersion in creation freed his soul from worldly shackles.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el sosegado estudio, el veterano pintor contuvo el aliento y trazó la última pincelada con entrega absoluta. La tintero del pupitre se había secado y la noche envolvía ya el ventanal; tal comunión creadora liberó su alma de toda atadura mundana.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在重大科研攻关的紧要关头，全神贯注的专注力往往是激发颠覆性灵感的决定性催化剂。科研团队在长达数周的高强度推演中心无旁骛，排除外界的一切干扰，终于在海量复杂数据中捕捉到了那一丝转瞬即逝的关键规律。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài zhòngdà kēyán gōngguān de jǐnyào guāntóu, quánshén-guànzhù de zhuānzhùlì wǎngwǎng shì jīfā diānfùxìng línggǎn de juédìngxìng cuīhuàjì. Kēyán tuánduì zài chángdá shù zhōu de gāoxiàngdù tuīyǎn zhōng xīnwú-pángwù, páichú wàijiè de yíqiè gānrǎo, zhōngyú zài hǎiliàng fùzá shùjù zhōng bǔzhuō dào le nà yì sī zhuǎnshùn-jíshì de guānjiàn guīlǜ.
extended_reading_passages.en: At critical research junctures, undivided concentration catalyses disruptive breakthroughs. Filtering out external interference through weeks of high-intensity derivation, the team finally captured the fleeting key law hidden inside complex datasets.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la hora decisiva de la investigación puntera, la atención sin fisuras es el catalizador que desata hallazgos revolucionarios. El equipo científico, ajeno a toda distracción en semanas de ardua labor, logró aislar la esquiva clave oculta en los datos.

meanings_summary.en: to try one's best; to do all one can; to exert all of one's strength; to strive hard
meanings_summary.es: esforzarse al máximo; dar lo mejor de sí; hacer todo lo posible; poner todo el empeño

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Draining every last drop from the vessel (尽) by exerting all muscular power (力) means to strive with one's utmost effort (尽力).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Agotar hasta la última reserva (尽) entregando toda la fuerza muscular (力) encarna el deber de esforzarse al máximo (尽力).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Confucian ethics, 尽 (exhausting sincerity / duty) is central: 尽心 (dedicating one's mind), 尽孝 (fulfilling filial piety), 尽力 (striving to one's limit). Traditional moral philosophy measures virtue not by external success, but by whether one has genuinely 'exhausted one's heart and power' (尽心竭力).
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dual falling 4th tones: 'jìn lì' (51-51). Pronounce both syllables with firm, emphatic, downward momentum.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 尽力 means doing one's utmost within the bounds of one's current physical or situational ability.

contrasts.analysis: 努力 is a persistent, ongoing attitude of working hard over time (努力学习), whereas 尽力 is committing 100% of available energy to a specific goal right now (我已经尽力了).
竭力 is a more intense literary term implying exhausting oneself to the very brink of collapse (竭力嘶喊).
尽力 emphasizes physical, practical, or material exertion, whereas 尽心 emphasizes emotional devotion, moral care, and mindfulness (尽心尽责).

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has no dots inside the lower opening
Has a straight top horizontal stroke rather than extending left hook
Has a straight top horizontal stroke with curved hook
Has two dots flanking 力
Has a dot at top with slanted hook

senses.definition_en: to expend every ounce of one's physical energy, mental ability, or resources to achieve an aim
senses.definition_es: dedicar todas las fuerzas, talento o recursos a la consecución de una meta

example_sentences.hanzi: 李广将军屏住呼吸，用尽全身的力气把强弓拉成了一轮圆月，利箭呼啸着破空而出。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Guǎng jiāngjūn bǐngzhù hūxī, yòngjìn quánshēn de lìqi bǎ qiánggōng lāchéng le yì lún yuányuè, lìjiàn hūxiào zhe pòkōng-érchū.
example_sentences.en: Holding his breath, General Li Guang exerted all his bodily strength to pull the strong bow into a full moon, the sharp arrow shrieking into flight.
example_sentences.es: Conteniendo el aliento, el general Li Guang desplegó todas sus fuerzas hasta combar el recio arco como luna llena, lanzando la flecha silbante al aire.

example_sentences.hanzi: 无论最终的比赛结果如何，只要我们在赛场上毫无保留地拼搏过、尽力了，便问心无愧。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wúlùn zuìzhōng de bǐsài jiéguǒ rúhé, zhǐyào wǒmen zài sàichǎng shàng háowú-bǎoliú de pīnbó guò, jìnlì le, biàn wènxīn-wúkuì.
example_sentences.en: Regardless of the final competition outcome, as long as we fought unreservedly on the court and did our best, our conscience is clear.
example_sentences.es: Sea cual fuere el resultado final del torneo, mientras hayamos luchado sin reservas y dado lo mejor de nosotros, tendremos la conciencia tranquila.

collocations.en: do one's utmost according to one's ability
use up all of one's strength
strive one's best to rescue or salvage

idioms.meaning_en: spare no effort; exert every ounce of strength
perfect in every detail; crowning excellence
serve one's country with unyielding loyalty
scrupulously fulfill one's duties

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 盡. Ancient pictogram of a hand holding a brush to scrape the bottom of a bowl dry until empty.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Scraping the very bottom of a vessel until the last two drops (⺀) are completely empty exhausts the limit (尽).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Raspar el fondo de una vasija hasta que caen las dos últimas gotas (⺀), agotando hasta la última reserva (尽).

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 力 (curved arm muscle flexing or ancient plow)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient bronze pictogram of an arm flexing its sinews or a foot pressing down a farm spade, symbolizing physical power.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A flexing arm tendon strains with unyielding muscular power to pull a heavy load (力).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: El tendón de un brazo vigoroso se tensa con firmeza desatando una gran fuerza muscular (力).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 面对不可预知的命运挑战，我们或许无法决定最终的成败，但完全能够决定对待人生的态度。在每一个平凡的日子里尽心尽力，对所热爱的生活倾注全副身心，哪怕前路布满荆棘，也能收获问心无愧的从容与坦荡。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Miànduì bùkě-yùzhī de mìngyùn tiǎozhàn, wǒmen huòxǔ wúfǎ juédìng zuìzhōng de chéngbài, dàn wánquán nénggòu juédìng duìdài rénshēng de tàidù. Zài měi yí gè píngfán de rìzi lǐ jìnxīn-jìnlì, duì suǒ rè'ài de shēnghuó qīngzhù quánfù shēnxīn, nǎpà qiánlù bùmǎn jīngjí, yě néng shōuhuò wènxīn-wúkuì de cóngróng yǔ tǎndàng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Confronting unpredictable fate, we may not determine victory, but can decide our stance toward life. Striving conscientiously in ordinary days and pouring our soul into what we love yields tranquil composure, even on thorn-strewn paths.
extended_reading_passages.es: Ante los caprichos del destino, quizá no podamos decidir el desenlace, pero sí nuestra actitud ante la vida. Esforzándonos al máximo cada día y volcando el alma en lo que amamos, cosecharemos una serena paz de conciencia, aun entre abrojos.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在公共应急救援体系中，“生命至上”始终是最高行动准则。只要一线救援尚存一丝渺茫的希望，全体救援人员便会克服一切极限险阻尽力搜救，这种对生命尊严的坚守生动诠释了人道主义救援的崇高真谛。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài gōnggòng yīngjí jiùyuán tǐxì zhōng, 'shēngmìng zhìshàng' shǐzhōng shì zuì gāo xíngdòng zhǔnzé. Zhǐyào yíxiàn jiùyuán shàng cún yì sī miǎománg de xīwàng, quántǐ jiùyuán rényuán biàn huì kèfú yíqiè jíxiàn xiǎnzǔ jìnlì sōujiù, zhè zhǒng duì shēngmìng zūnyán de jiānshǒu shēngdòng quánshì le réndàozhǔyì jiùyuán de chónggāo zhēndì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In public emergency rescues, 'life above all' is the supreme operational principle. As long as a sliver of hope flickers, rescuers overcome every hazard to search with utmost effort, interpreting humanitarian reverence for life.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el socorro de emergencias, 'la vida ante todo' es la pauta suprema de actuación. Mientras quede un atisbo de esperanza, los rescatistas desafían el peligro para buscar con todo su empeño, enalteciendo la sagrada dignidad de la persona humana.

meanings_summary.en: to react; to respond; reaction; chemical reaction; response; physiological reflex
meanings_summary.es: reaccionar; responder; reacción; reflejo; respuesta a un estímulo; reacción química

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Turning back in reverse (反) to respond to a voice echoing in the hall (应) creates a dynamic physical or mental reaction (反应).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Invertir el curso (反) para corresponder al eco que resuena en la estancia (应) engendra una reacción viva (反应).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Daoist and medical philosophy, 反应 captures the fundamental cosmic principle of resonance (感应): every physical action or cosmic stimulus produces a reciprocal rebound in human consciousness or bodily organs.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone followed by falling 4th tone: 'fǎn yìng' (214-51). Dip low on 'fǎn', then drop decisively on 'yìng'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 反应 describes passive or instinctive chemical, physiological, or perceptual reactions provoked by an external stimulus.

contrasts.analysis: 反应 means physiological or chemical reaction to an external stimulus (毫无反应), whereas 反映 means reflecting light/images or reporting situations upward to superiors (反映情况).
反应 can be involuntary physiological reflex (pupils dilating, chemical fizzing), while 回应 is always an intentional, conscious verbal reply or statement.
反应 describes immediate behavioral feedback, while 态度 is one's persistent moral stance or emotional disposition toward people and matters.

Has a curving tail stroke instead of 厂
Has wood radical 木 inside 广 instead of 丷

senses.definition_en: to exhibit a behavioral, physiological, or emotional response to an external stimulus or situation
senses.definition_es: mostrar una respuesta fisiológica, conductual o anímica ante un estímulo o hecho exterior
senses.example_phrase: 做出灵敏反应 (make an agile reaction)

senses.definition_en: a change or response produced in a person, organism, or chemical compound by an outside agent
senses.definition_es: cambio, respuesta o fenómeno provocado por un agente externo en un organismo o sustancia

example_sentences.hanzi: 李广的长箭如流星般射入深草，然而草丛中却一片死寂，那只所谓的猛虎竟然连一点儿反应也没有。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lǐ Guǎng de chángjiàn rú liúxīng bān shèrù shēncǎo, rán'ér cǎocóng zhōng què yípiàn sǐjì, nà zhī suǒwèi de měnghǔ jìngrán lián yìdiǎnr fǎnyìng yě méiyǒu.
example_sentences.en: Li Guang's arrow shot like a meteor into the deep grass, yet deadly silence hung over the thicket; the tiger showed no reaction at all.
example_sentences.es: La flecha de Li Guang cruzó la maleza como un meteoro, pero un silencio sepulcral envolvió el matorral; el supuesto tigre no mostró la menor reacción.

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对突发公共卫生安全事件，应急指挥中心敏锐研判态势，在半小时内迅速启动了一级响应机制。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì tūfā gōnggòng wèishēng ānquán shìjiàn, yīngjí zhǐhuī zhōngxīn mǐnruì yánpàn tàishì, zài bàn xiǎoshí nèi xùnsù qǐdòng le yījí xiǎngyìng jīzhì.
example_sentences.en: Facing a sudden public health crisis, the emergency center assessed the scenario and swiftly launched a level-one response within thirty minutes.
example_sentences.es: Ante una imprevista crisis de salud pública, el centro de emergencias evaluó la coyuntura e implementó con presteza un protocolo de respuesta de máximo nivel.

idioms.meaning_en: hand responds smoothly to the heart's mind; proficient and effortless
chain reaction; ripple effect
one calls and a hundred respond; widespread rallying
overwhelmed with more calls and events than one can handle

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient oracle bone pictogram of a hand 又 turning itself over beneath a cliff shelter 厂 to oppose or reverse direction.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A flexible hand (又) turns upside down beneath a cliff wall (厂) to reverse momentum and bounce back (反).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una mano diestra (又) gira sobre sí misma bajo el acantilado (厂) invirtiendo el sentido para rebotar (反).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Simplified from 應. Ancient pictogram of a heart 心 answering an echo inside a wide chamber 广 beneath a perched bird 隹.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: In a spacious echoing hall (广), voice calls out and returns an immediate harmonious answer (应).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: En un salón abovedado y espacioso (广), la voz resuena devolviendo un eco fiel que responde a la llamada (应).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 面对突如其来的变故与风浪，一个人的第一反应往往最能映射出其内心的修养与定力。慌乱与暴躁只会加剧局势的失控，而沉着冷静地审视现实，才能在瞬息万变的危机中做出最精准、最理智的应对。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Miànduì tūrúqílái de biàngù yǔ fēnglàng, yí gè rén de dì-yī fǎnyìng wǎngwǎng zuì néng yìngshè chū qí nèixīn de xiūyǎng yǔ dìnglì. Huāngluàn yǔ bàozào zhǐ huì jiājù júshì de shīkòng, ér chénzhuó lěngjìng de shěnshì xiànshí, cáinéng zài shùnxī-wànbiàn de wēijī zhōng zuòchū zuì jīngzhǔn, zuì lǐzhì de yìngduì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Facing unexpected upheavals, a person's first reaction best mirrors their inner poise. Panic and irritability merely escalate chaos, whereas surveying reality calmly empowers accurate, rational responses in volatile crises.
extended_reading_passages.es: Ante los giros imprevistos del destino, la primera reacción de una persona retrata la templanza de su ánimo. El desasosiego solo precipita el descontrol, mientras que serenar el juicio permite calibrar una respuesta certera y prudente en la turbulencia.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在复杂的现代宏观经济调控中，政策出台与市场实际反应之间往往存在一定的滞后效应。决策部门必须通过高频动态监测与大数据模型，精准评估市场各微观主体的敏感度，从而确保调控措施达到预期实效。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài fùzá de xiàndài hóngguān jīngjì tiáokòng zhōng, zhèngcè chūtái yǔ shìchǎng shíjì fǎnyìng zhījiān wǎngwǎng cúnzài yídìng de zhìhòu xiàoyìng. Juécè bùmén bìxū tōngguò gāopín dòngtài jiāncè yǔ dàshùjù móxíng, jīngzhǔn pínggū shìchǎng gè wēiguān zhǔtǐ de mǐngǎndù, cóng'ér quèbǎo tiáokòng cuòshī dádào yùqī shíxiào.
extended_reading_passages.en: In modern macroeconomic management, lags exist between policy rollouts and actual market reactions. Policymakers must employ high-frequency monitoring and big-data models to gauge micro-entity sensitivity, ensuring targeted efficacy.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la política macroeconómica contemporánea, media un inevitable desfase entre la promulgación de medidas y la reacción del mercado. Las autoridades han de valerse de modelos masivos de datos para calibrar la sensibilidad de los agentes y afinar su eficacia.

meanings_summary.en: to determine; to confirm; to make sure; definite; certain; fixed
meanings_summary.es: determinar; confirmar; cerciorarse; fijar; seguro; cierto; definitivo

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Hard and solid as a rock (确) rested peacefully beneath a sheltered home (定) establishes unswerving certainty (确定).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Firme como la roca (确) asentada en el reposo del hogar (定), lo certero queda fijado para siempre (确定).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Chinese epistemological texts (墨经), 确 represents empirical hardness that can be struck without crumbling, while 定 represents spatial repose and social stability. Combining both constructs the concept of definitive confirmation that withstands doubt.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dual falling 4th tones: 'què dìng' (51-51). Articulate both syllables with crisp, unwavering downward pitch momentum.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 确定 denotes verifying facts to remove ambiguity, or finalizing agreements and arrangements.

contrasts.analysis: 确定 emphasizes finalizing, deciding, or settling a plan/date into a fixed state (确定行程), whereas 确认 emphasizes formally acknowledging or verifying that information already presented is accurate (确认密码).
确定 focuses on clarity and certainty of truth or schedule, whereas 决定 focuses on making a volitional choice between alternatives.
确定 can be a transitive verb taking clauses, while 肯定 often functions as an affirmative adverb meaning 'definitely / surely' (他肯定会来) or adjective for positive feedback.

Has 皮 on the right instead of 角
